title: Data Center Facilities Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

Key job responsibilities
Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers

Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career

Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion

Coordinates daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Routinely operate as the after-hour on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s)

A day in the life
We are seeking an energetic Data Center Facility Manager to serve as a technical resource and leader within Amazon data centers. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of data center operations. The Data Center Facility Manager will oversee operations and management of technicians responsible for routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switch gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc. They will assist in maintaining a high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. title: Senior Program Manager - FinOps, FinOps PMO
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalise new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order- to-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Senior Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the APAC region.

This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement. As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make smart trade-offs between competing priorities.
You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle, not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI-augmented program delivery.

You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one-way and two-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results, understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.

Who Are We Looking For?
The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large-scale, highly complex business program implementations in fast-paced, deadline-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.

You will demonstrate:
• Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle: from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post-launch analysis. We do not want someone who knows about AI; we want someone who delivers programs differently because of it.
• The ability to work backwards from the problem: challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.
• High-judgment decision-making: distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.
• A metrics-driven approach that goes beyond tracking numbers to designing measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction), while knowing when to trust judgment over data.
• The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to VPs.
• A track record of force multiplication: creating mechanisms, frameworks, and reusable approaches that deliver value beyond a single program.
• Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross-functional decision making without authority.

Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities will span seven core dimensions:
• Stakeholder & Customer Understanding: Engage systematically with stakeholders across FinOps and partner organisations to understand business problems, constraints, and scaling factors. Gather requirements from diverse personas, distinguish representative signal from isolated requests, and drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions and aligned outcomes.
• Systems & Technical Awareness: Understand the systems landscape deeply — automation limitations, integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing coordination, producing launch readiness assessments, and synthesising post-launch data into actionable recommendations.
• Strategic Thinking & Decision-Making: Work backwards from the problem — questioning proposals and testing
assumptions rather than perpetuating approaches because "that is how it has always been done." Distinguish between one-way and two-way door decisions, develop clear program tenets that guide prioritisation, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and deliverables with measurable success criteria.
• Solution Design & Process Architecture: Design scalable program mechanisms that create predictable process paths and ensure long-term success. Streamline or eliminate excess process, steer teams away from classic failure modes, and continually strengthen FinOps PMO effectiveness by delivering innovative, think-big improvement opportunities.
• Metrics & Judgment: Design measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics from outcome metrics. Identify the highest-leverage input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross-team status inputs and identify leading indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete — using judgment calibrated by experience.
• Execution & Results Delivery: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large-scale programs from initiation through to delivery, on time and with quality. Take calculated risks where bold programmatic moves could deliver disproportionate impact, use AI to amplify personal capacity across the delivery lifecycle, and learn systematically from outcomes.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Effectively communicate with and influence senior, VP-level stakeholders across multiple parts of the organisation. Write effective narratives, influence without authority across organisations with different
priorities, and actively mentor and develop others.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle - not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience designing and embedding AI-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis,
- AI-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
- Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience managing programs in finance operations, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, or payroll domains
- Track record of creating reusable mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond a single program

title: Physical SOC Analyst, AWS Security, AWS Security
descriptionHtml:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information visit www.agsva.gov.au.

G’day! You’ve found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

The Mission — Why This Program, Why Now?
You’re joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programs Australia has ever undertaken.

The architectural decisions being made now — how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale — will shape how Australia’s national security community operates for the next decade. You won’t be inheriting someone else’s design choices. You’ll be making them.

Your Role — The Guardian of AWS Physical Infrastructure

Imagine being the first line of defence for some of the most critical cloud infrastructure on the planet. As an AWS Incident Response Team (IRT) Analyst within the Physical Security Operations Centre (PSOC), you’ll be the vigilant eyes and decisive mind protecting the physical backbone of services that hundreds of thousands of businesses across 190 countries depend on every single day.

This isn’t passive monitoring — this is active, intelligent security operations where your judgment directly safeguards national security assets. You’ll respond to physical security events in real time, coordinate contracted guard forces, administer access control systems, and gather intelligence that keeps our people, operations, and infrastructure safe across the region.

Every shift brings new challenges. Every decision you make matters. And every improvement you identify raises the security bar for an organisation that refuses to stand still.

Why This Team, Why Now?
You’re joining a developing team of physical security professionals who are building something extraordinary. The PSOC is where operational excellence meets national purpose — where your customer service instincts, your communication skills, and your security expertise converge to protect what matters most. Whether your background is in security operations centres, dispatch, military, or law enforcement, your experience has prepared you for this moment.
This is where careers accelerate, where diverse paths are celebrated, and where the appetite to continuously improve isn’t just welcomed — it’s essential.

Benefits
Learning & Development
AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.
Health, Income Protection & Life Cover
Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.
Military Differential Pay
Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.
Employee Assistance Program
Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family — mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.
Family-Building Benefit
Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.
Amazon Extras & Employee Discount
Cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.


Key job responsibilities
You’ll be the operational heartbeat of the AWS Physical Security Operations Centre — the person who turns protocols into protection and intelligence into action.

Protecting Critical Infrastructure in Real Time
Your core mission is incident response. When physical security events threaten AWS infrastructure, associates, or operations, you’re the one who assesses, escalates, and resolves. You’ll monitor physical access control systems with precision, administer access permissions, and ensure only authorised personnel move through our most sensitive spaces.

The Security Ecosystem
You’ll oversee contracted guard forces across the region, ensuring they operate to AWS standards. Your intelligence gathering will feed directly into program-wide notifications that keep teams informed and prepared. When something changes in the threat landscape, you’ll be the one connecting the dots and distributing critical information.

Building the Playbook
You won’t just follow Standard Operating Procedures — you’ll develop them. Your frontline experience will shape how the PSOC operates, creating frameworks that future team members will rely on to protect AWS assets.

Keeping Operations Moving
From triaging trouble tickets to managing internal and external communications, you’ll be the connective tissue between security operations and the broader AWS organisation. You’ll handle incoming queries with professionalism, provide technical support to internal stakeholders, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Every interaction is an opportunity to demonstrate the customer obsession that defines Amazon — and every process you improve raises the bar for the entire program.

At a Glance — Core Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
• Physical access control administration
• Monitor physical security systems
• Monitor and coordinate a contracted guard force
• Incident response — assess, escalate, and resolve physical security events
• Intelligence gathering and distributing program-wide notifications
• Manage internal and external email and phone communications
• Triage trouble tickets and handle incoming queries
• Provide technical support to internal stakeholders




A day in the life
Your day begins with a handover that immediately puts you in the picture — active incidents, ongoing monitoring priorities, and intelligence updates from the previous shift. You settle into the PSOC knowing that today, like every day, your vigilance protects critical national infrastructure.

Morning: Eyes On, Systems Active
You scan physical access control systems, reviewing overnight access logs and flagging anomalies. A contractor’s badge triggers an alert — you verify credentials, cross-reference the access request, and resolve it within minutes. Seamless. You check in with the contracted guard force at multiple sites, confirming shift coverage and addressing a scheduling gap before it becomes a vulnerability.

Midday: Intelligence and Communication
An intelligence report lands requiring your analysis. You assess the relevance to AWS operations, draft a program-wide notification, and distribute it to stakeholders who need to act. Between intelligence tasks, you’re managing the inbox — responding to access requests, fielding queries from internal teams, and updating trouble tickets with precision.

Afternoon: Incident Response in Action
An alarm triggers. Your training kicks in — you follow established procedures, coordinate with on-site security, gather information rapidly, and document everything in real time. The incident resolves cleanly because you were prepared, decisive, and thorough. You update the incident report and identify a process improvement that could shave minutes off future response times.

End of Shift: Raising the Bar
Before handover, you draft a recommendation for a new SOP based on today’s observations. You brief the incoming team with clarity and confidence, knowing that your contributions today made the operation stronger than yesterday.




About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Data Center Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
- Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
- Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
- Developing Career Paths for the employees and to make updates in our internal tools.
- Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
- Ensure effective and efficient management of day to day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
- Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
- Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a fast paced technology company and a leader in the world of data centers. title: Software Security Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs Security Team secures the firmware at the foundation of AWS custom silicon. We work on Graviton processors and the Nitro System — hardware that runs a substantial share of the world's cloud workloads — in close collaboration with the silicon architects and firmware developers who design it. Our engineers operate at the lowest levels of the stack: secure boot chains, hardware root of trust, attestation, cryptographic protocol design, and the boundaries between trust domains within the system.



Key job responsibilities
As a Security Engineer, you will threat model new silicon and firmware architectures, conduct low-level penetration testing against privileged and externally reachable interfaces, review designs and code across multiple firmware components, and build the fuzzing and analysis tooling that makes this work repeatable at silicon scale. You will also help raise the security bar across the wider organization through direct engagement with firmware and hardware teams. We are looking for engineers fluent in C and ARM assembly, with real depth in secure boot, applied cryptography, or embedded exploitation, and the technical credibility to hold a position in a room full of people who designed the system you are testing.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of low-level systems security research and vulnerability testing experience
- Experience developing security tools (fuzzers, scanners, analysis frameworks)
- Security architecture design and threat modeling experience
- Proficiency in C and experience with Python
- Deep knowledge of security aspects of ARM/x86 processor architectures
- Strong understanding of hardware security (secure boot, cryptographic implementations, side-channel attacks)
- Knowledge of security protocols and cryptographic primitives
- Experience in AI usage for security research
- Technical English proficiency

Preferred qualifications

- Background in firmware reverse engineering and vulnerability research
- Experience with fuzzing frameworks (AFL++, libFuzzer, Syzkaller)
- Knowledge of virtualization security or hypervisor technologies
- Familiarity with AWS services
- Technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration
- Security publications (research, CVEs)
- CTF, bug bounty, or competitive security research background

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Live
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Live is building the future of shoppable entertainment — and brands are at the center of it. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager (Tech) to own the product vision and technical strategy for how brands and advertisers create, publish, and succeed with live commerce on Amazon. This role sits at the intersection of advertising technology, the creator economy, and generative AI — and you'll define the products that make live commerce accessible and irresistible to brands of all sizes.

Your north star is brand adoption and retention. You'll own the product charter for Amazon Live's creator and brand tools — including AI-powered content creation, the Live Creator App, Brand Store live integrations, and brand-facing reporting and analytics. You'll define what we build, push the boundaries of generative AI for content creation, partner with engineering to ship at speed, and use data to deeply understand what drives brands to go live, stay active, and grow their investment. You'll also shape how brands connect with influencers through our platform, building features that make creator-brand collaboration seamless and measurable.

You'll write the strategy documents, define the roadmap, make hard tradeoffs, and own what ships. You'll work in deep partnership with Amazon Ads, UX measurement and reporting, and engineering teams — translating complex advertiser needs into elegant, scalable product experiences. You'll be supported by a co-located engineering team, UX designers, and BI resources, and you'll have the autonomy to shape an emerging product category where the right product decisions directly move leadership goals.

If you're a product leader who thinks in terms of customer problems, can toggle between long-term vision and sprint-level execution, and want to define how Amazon approaches live commerce for brands — this is your role.

Key job responsibilities
This candidate sits within Live’s B2B product team, and owns the product charter for the Amazon Live Creator App as well as other creator tools used by thousands of creators. The candidate is expected to work with GTM, content acquisition, BD & sales teams, as well as broader Amazon Ads and Creator orgs, to help setup our brand and influencer creators for success and deliver great live shopping experiences. They will be supported by a large engineering team, UX designers and Business Intelligence team.
The right person would have experience defining long-term product strategy, enjoys being customer obsessed, has technical knowledge and is comfortable with a high-level of ambiguity. They would be equally comfortable ideating on the next set of content creation features with brands and partners, and in delivering those for millions of shoppers with our engineering team. They will craft and communicate a strategic roadmap and see to its execution.
We move fast; and that allows PMs to deliver on a large impact in a short time frame. Our team actively invests in career growth, and we will work with you to chart a strong growth path forward.

A day in the life
You will craft your product strategy, and then bring it to reality. You are comfortable working on products with complex tradeoffs. You will deeply understand and socialize our evolving needs to our customers, with your content, marketing, BD and design partners.

Amazon Shopping Videos (ASV) is an exciting, strategic program that harnesses the power of video to help millions of customers discover product inspiration, learn about items they're interested in, and engage with talented creators and communities. We are a dynamic, startup-like initiative within Amazon, aiming to reinvent the way customers use video to shop. To achieve this bold vision, we are seeking motivated, thoughtful self-starters who can forge effective partnerships across our multi-disciplinary teams to drive continuous innovation.

title: ERP Controls and Security Manager, Accounting Transformation Group
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced ERP Controls and Security Manager to lead the design and implementation of controls, security, and access-governance capabilities as part of a large-scale transformation of Amazon’s Finance ERP platform.
This role sits at the intersection of Accounting, Internal Controls, Security, Finance, and technology, with responsibility for translating controllership, audit, regulatory, and information-security requirements into scalable ERP controls and security capabilities. The scope includes role-based access, segregation of duties, privileged access, automated application controls, access certification, security monitoring, and governance, risk, and compliance solutions.
The successful candidate will partner with Accounting, Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Information Security, Product, Solution Architecture, Engineering, SAP, and implementation partners to define requirements, evaluate design alternatives, and ensure controls and security are embedded throughout design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations.
This role requires an individual who can move between detailed control requirements and broader ERP architecture decisions. You will need to understand how accounting processes, organizational structures, job responsibilities, system integrations, regulatory requirements, and security standards translate into a controlled, auditable, and maintainable ERP environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Define role-based access and authorization requirements that support business responsibilities while maintaining appropriate segregation of duties.
• Establish capabilities for user provisioning, access approvals, privileged access, emergency access, periodic certification, and access removal.
• Partner with Accounting and Internal Controls teams to identify and design automated and configurable application controls across financial processes.
• Define segregation-of-duties rules, evaluate conflicts, establish mitigation controls, and support remediation of access and control risks.
• Partner with Information Security, Solution Architecture, Engineering, ERP product, and implementation partners throughout design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization.

title: Principal Technologist, 6G and AI, Telco Tech, AWS Industries
descriptionHtml:
Description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a world-class Principal Technologist to lead the execution and delivery of AI-native telecommunications solutions for next-generation networks. In this role, you will be the technical execution leader across customer co-design engagements, ecosystem partner integrations, and innovation incubation programs — translating 6G and AI strategy into deployed architectures and measurable customer outcomes.
You will own the end-to-end technical execution of AWS’s 6G and Network AI engagements with Tier-1 telecommunications operators — spanning RAN AI, non-terrestrial networks (NTN), agentic network frameworks, and AI control plane architectures. You will co-design solutions directly with customer engineering teams, lead proof-of-concept delivery, and drive the scaling of successful prototypes into production-ready offerings on the AWS platform.
This is a high-visibility, delivery-oriented role that combines deep hands-on technical expertise with the ability to orchestrate complex multi-stakeholder programs across customers, industry bodies, technology partners, and internal AWS teams. You will also lead crowdsourced innovation and incubation programs that accelerate the 6G and AI ecosystem.




Key job responsibilities

• Lead technical execution of AI-native network solution co-design with Tier-1 telecommunications operators — from architecture definition and proof-of-concept delivery through production scaling.
• Own the architecture and delivery of RAN AI, AI control plane, and agentic network framework solutions in partnership with customer engineering teams and AWS service teams.
• Drive non-terrestrial networks architecture and delivery — including direct-to-device, terrestrial-NTN interworking, and RAN AI control plane integration.
• Lead and scale crowdsourced innovation and incubation programs (hackathons, developer challenges, AI fellowship programs) that accelerate the 6G and AI ecosystem in partnership with industry bodies and technology partners.
• Represent AWS in industry forums and standards bodies (TM Forum, TIP, O-RAN Alliance) — driving contributions to AI-native network architectures and trusted AI frameworks.
• Orchestrate technology partner co-design programs across the semiconductor, RAN, and AI ecosystem — translating joint roadmaps into customer-deployable solutions.
• Build and lead a scaling function of Field Development Engineers (FDEs) and Solutions Architects to deliver 6G and AI customer engagements at scale.
• Author and deliver technical narratives, architecture documents, and solution proposals for AWS leadership and customer executives.
• Drive 1P innovation by partnering with AWS service teams to develop and integrate agentic network capabilities and AI control plane services into the AWS platform.
• Mentor and develop a community of builders — Solutions Architects, FDEs, and partner engineers — on best practices for AI-native network architecture and delivery.


A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing deployment progress on a proof-of-concept with a Tier-1 operator’s engineering team. By mid-morning, you’re leading an architecture review with AWS service team engineers and a technology partner to finalize the AI control plane design. After lunch, you join a working group at a global industry forum to drive consensus on an AI-native network framework. In the afternoon, you review submissions from a developer challenge you launched with an industry partner — scouting the next breakthrough idea. You end the day briefing leadership on a customer milestone, translating technical progress into strategic impact.

About the team
This role sits within AWS’s Telecommunications practice, working at the frontier of AI-Native networking with Tier-1 global operators. The team co-develops next-generation network AI solutions in partnership with the world’s leading telecommunications companies and industry bodies, spanning network intelligence, autonomous operations, and 6G research.
This is a high-impact position with direct access to AWS leadership and senior customer executives. You will shape a multi-year technology and business strategy driving bleeding-edge data and AI research and development for the telecommunications industry.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

title: Sr. Product Designer, Prime Video Experience Design
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video is re-inventing how customers connect with entertainment by combining high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved movies, TV series, and live sports. All from a single service available on the web, mobile, and TV in 240+ countries and territories around the world. And we're just getting started.

The Prime Video Experience Design (PVXD) studio is seeking a customer-obsessed Sr. Product Designer to join our Growth design team. This role will be responsible for defining, articulating, and championing the future vision for how our customers rent, buy, and subscribe to the best entertainment content in their country. The right candidate leads with clarity and empathy, inspires others, and has a passion for solving problems at massive scale. You excel through innovation, creativity, and attention to detail. You are a proven strategic thinker and collaborator who flourishes in a large organization. You sincerely believe that design is more than how something looks, but also how it feels and functions. You enjoy great design debates and thrive on iterating based on customer feedback.

This role requires a designer with strong visual design skills who can elevate the craft and quality of our commerce surfaces. You bring a keen eye for typography, color, layout, motion, and visual hierarchy, and you apply that craft within the context of product design, ensuring our transactional experiences are not only intuitive but visually compelling across living room, mobile, web, and tablet surfaces in global markets. You are equally comfortable defining end-to-end interaction flows and delivering pixel-perfect, high-fidelity UI.

This role is for a hands-on designer who establishes a vision and strategy, scales their impact with proactive collaboration across cross-functional teams, and elevates the design quality of the entire team. You will develop strong relationships with fellow designers and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Business counterparts throughout the organization to launch bar-raising experiences for customers around the world. As a creative lead, you have a passion for solving our customers' problems, always putting their needs first.


Key job responsibilities
You will own the design of commerce experiences across Prime Video's product surfaces, from early problem framing through high-fidelity, visually polished UI. Day to day, that means partnering with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to translate customer needs and business goals into clear interaction flows, wireframes, and detailed visual mockups that communicate both behaviour and craft. You will define and refine UI patterns, typography, iconography, color, and motion within our commerce surfaces, and contribute to scaling Prime Video's visual design language across living room, mobile, web, and tablet in collaboration with the broader PVXD team. You will present and defend your work to stakeholders and senior leadership, and measure the impact of your solutions through data, research, and customer feedback.


A day in the life
The Sr. Product Designer for Prime Video Commerce & Growth will solve some of our most complex customer problems. You are expected to think like an owner, always raise the quality of the CX, and be a relentless advocate for customers. On any given day you might map a complex subscription workflow in the morning and refine the visual design of a checkout surface in the afternoon. You will collaborate with UX Researchers, Product Managers, Engineers, and fellow UX Designers both within Prime Video and across Amazon, using your organisation and communication skills to bring clarity to chaos, working strategically with other team leaders and team members across the organisation.

About the team
You'll join a fun, growing team of UX practitioners who help each other develop and thrive. You will have a mentor and a manager that cares about you, your career, and your skills development and be expected to do the same for your team. You will have autonomy and ownership while contributing to the supportive culture on the team. We gather often to collaborate, ask questions, and grow together, so bring your unique skills and experience and be prepared to share, learn, and grow with us.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience
- Have an available online portfolio
- 5+ years of creating user flows, wire frames, mockups, generating assets and specifications for integration into digital products experience
- Experience presenting designs and collaborating with all levels of the organization
- Strong prototyping skills with the ability to create high-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate design intent beyond static deliverables (using tools such as Figma prototyping, Claude Code, Kiro, Rive, or equivalent)
- Partner with technology teams to ensure we leverage the scale offered by our platform without compromising on core experience principles.
- Measure the success and effectiveness of design innovations.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with UX design of complex workflows
- Experience designing for entertainment, media, or content-rich consumer products across multiple platforms (mobile, web, TV/living room)

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world - from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement globally available distributed cloud architectures
- Actively participate in overall technical strategy and charter expansion
- Design core ETL framework capabilities shaping data from 50+ producers to be accessed by dozens of consumers
- Own the schema evolution system across Iceberg, Glue registry, and DataZone, enforcing platform patterns.
- Solve novel problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and financial domain complexity
- Define reference architectures, templates, blueprints, infrastructure standards, and data quality frameworks for domain teams.
- Partner with domain and consumer teams across Amazon Leo Commerce, Networking, and Satellite teams.
- Own operational excellence for their components: monitoring, alarming, DLQ/retry, and incident root-cause analysis.

A day in the life
Have you wanted an opportunity to develop the software applications and services for an advanced global communications service? This role is for a Software Development Engineer who will design, build, and maintain components and services of Leo Commerce Services.

About the team
This position is for the Data Platform team, which sits within the Amazon Leo Commerce organization. We're part of the exciting Amazon Leo initiative - Amazon's effort to provide global broadband connectivity - and our corner of that world focuses on the commerce experience.

What does Leo Commerce do?
Simply put, we build the services and applications that help Leo customers discover, purchase, and use Leo connectivity services and products. Think of us as the part of Leo behind the customer-facing website and all the features that make the business side of Leo actually work.

What does Data Platform specifically own?
We're the data folks! We build and maintain the tools that propagate and store data from all Leo Commerce systems. This means enabling teams across the org to query data, generate reports, and unlock business insights that drive real decisions. This means we have the important role of understanding the big picture of Leo Commerce systems. We also have recently took on owning SOX Compliance, since financial data fits well within our data charter.

But here's the thing: while "Data Platform" is our name, we're proudly cross-functional engineers. You might see your teammates automating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for our retail websites, implementing features to ensure proper data handling for Accounting, or jumping into whatever challenge needs solving. We're owners in the truest sense: if it helps get Amazon Leo to launch, we're all in.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. title: ICQA Lead
descriptionHtml:
**La posizione è basata a Torrazza ( TORINO)**

Le operazioni sono il cuore e l'anima di tutto ciò che Amazon fa. È grazie a operazioni efficaci che gli articoli vengono elaborati e spediti ai nostri clienti in tempo. Essere un Lead ti dà la possibilità di vedere come funzionano tutte le diverse parti delle operazioni e svolgono un ruolo nel garantire che tutto funzioni senza intoppi.

Sarai il primo punto di contatto per i membri del team durante il loro turno e li aiuterai a seguire i processi messi in atto dai tuoi manager. Questo ruolo ti consentirà di acquisire esperienza nell'uso degli strumenti e dei sistemi che garantiscono il successo delle nostre operazioni.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizioni. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

Key job responsibilities
- Misura e monitora i flussi di lavoro, monitora le prestazioni in loco e fornisce importanti informazioni sui turni alla gestione in prima linea per garantire l'eccellenza operativa in tutti i turni
- Supporta e forma i dipendenti per fornire un servizio eccellente e li supervisiona nelle loro attività quotidiane
- Supporta il Shift/Area Manager con progetti per migliorare i processi, coltiva un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e aumenta il coinvolgimento della forza lavoro
- Collabora con altri reparti per trovare soluzioni per risolvere problemi comuni o esigenze di supporto in aree di prestazioni chiave
- Utilizza l'analisi dei dati per identificare i modi per ottimizzare la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività

A day in the life
In qualità di responsabile ICQA, avrai sede in uno dei nostri siti operativi. Supporterai il tuo Shift/Area Manager nell'esecuzione del piano per il turno. Ciò comporterà l'assistenza nelle riunioni con il team prima del turno e le procedure di monitoraggio per assicurarsi che tutti seguano le regole di sicurezza, i processi di qualità e il piano di priorità per la giornata.

Segnalerai eventuali problemi al tuo manager, ma a volte sarai la persona più anziana del turno e fornirai alle persone le indicazioni di cui hanno bisogno per portare a termine i loro compiti. Altre volte, aiuterai il tuo Shift/Area Manager nella pianificazione dei turni per assicurarti di avere un numero sufficiente di membri del team che lavorano nelle ore di punta.

Basic qualifications

- Esperienza lavorativa pertinente nella risoluzione dei problemi e nell'identificazione dei problemi utilizzando metriche e dati
- Esperienza rilevante di lavoro con la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) in un ambiente professionale
- Conoscenza avanzata in Italiano nella comunicazione scritta e verbale (C1 Quadro comune europeo di riferimento, QCER)

Preferred qualifications

- Conoscenza di base della metodologia Lean
- Possiede un livello meticoloso di costante attenzione ai dettagli
- Capacità di approfondire il processo operativo e sviluppa idee per le sfide del processo
- Esperienza nella gestione dell'inventario e della garanzia della qualità

title: Seller Manager II, Amazon Grocery
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager (Instock) to drive selection and in-stock for Amazon Now. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.

The Seller Manager (Instock) will be responsible for executing inventory strategies to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in-stock rates in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep core drivers of in-stock performance, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and work flows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.

The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.

Key job responsibilities

Maintain excellent in-stock rates for owned category and/or region
Execute inventory strategies to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health
Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and turns
Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory
Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually.

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate with product leaders to gather insights, ensuring alignment and making informed product selections.
Analyze market trends and competitor activities to provide data-driven insights that shape strategic decisions.
Ensure top-quality input gathering by developing frameworks and validating stakeholder contributions for the selection process.
Coordinate cross-functional efforts to maintain project timelines, streamline communication, and achieve program objectives.

About the team
-

Basic qualifications

- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
- 5+ years of professional experience in supply chain, inventory management, project/program management, or buying/account management.
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis and interpretation, specifically using data to drive business recommendations.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience influencing C-level executives
- MBA

title: Senior Account Manager, Policing, AWS UK Central Government Team
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing adoption of Amazon Web Services across UK Policing? Do you have the business acumen and technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider for law enforcement?

As an Account Manager in Policing, you will have the exciting opportunity to promote the growth and shape the future of cloud technology across UK policing bodies.

The ideal candidate will possess both a business and technical background that enables them to engage at Chief Constable, PCC, and CXO level, as well as with software developers and IT architects. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a territory coverage plan aligned to national policing strategies.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions

Experience with pipeline management including utilisation of Salesforce or other CRM tools

Experience in account management, sales, or business development within policing, law enforcement, or public safety

Demonstrated experience working with UK police forces, the Home Office, NCA, College of Policing, or equivalent law enforcement bodies

A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles typical of policing and public sector procurement

We’d love it if you also bring:

An understanding of the UK policing landscape, including funding models (Home Office grants, PCC precepts), national programmes, and digital transformation drivers

Familiarity with decision-making structures across policing — Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners, the NPCC, Home Office, CIOs, and procurement bodies

Awareness of sector challenges such as data-led policing, digital evidence management, cross-force interoperability, cloud migration, hybrid working, and operational efficiency

Knowledge of relevant procurement routes (Crown Commercial Service, BlueLight Commercial, G-Cloud, Digital Marketplace)

SC (Security Check) clearance or willingness to undergo clearance

The ability to navigate long, consensus-driven procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders across forces and national bodies

Experience developing account plans aligned to policing strategies (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030, force-level digital transformation programmes)

The ability to articulate technology value propositions in the context of policing outcomes — operational efficiency, data-led decision making, and citizen safety

Key job responsibilities
Promote AWS services across a defined territory of UK policing accounts

Develop and execute a comprehensive account and territory plan aligned to national policing priorities (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030)

Create and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services in the context of policing outcomes — including data-led policing, digital evidence management, and interoperability

Facilitate customer adoption of AWS services, navigating complex multi-stakeholder and cross-force procurement processes

Maintain a robust projects pipeline across new and existing policing accounts

Work with partners, systems integrators, and ISVs to extend reach and promote adoption

Contribute to a positive customer experience and build long-term trusted relationships across the policing ecosystem

Engage at senior levels including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, CIOs, CTOs, and Home Office officials

A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the Policing territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with a Regional Police leadership team on their cloud-first Digital Policing Platform programme, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for a next-generation intelligence and analytics capability.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within police forces, national law enforcement agencies, Police and Crime Commissioners’ offices. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, secure data sharing across forces, digital evidence management, data-led operational policing, and enabling the sector’s ambition to deliver safer communities through technology.

About the team
Policing is one of the most meaningful verticals in UK Public Sector. The customers you’ll work with are on the front line of keeping people safe, and the technology decisions they make have real-world impact. You’ll be joining a team that cares deeply about getting this right — and you’ll have the backing of the entire AWS ecosystem to help you do it.

We offer a collaborative, high-trust environment where you’ll have genuine ownership of your accounts and the freedom to build your territory your way. If you want to do work that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar

Preferred qualifications

- Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

title: Software Development Engineer, (Level 5)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Software Development Engineer for our AWS Networking organization to join a team designing and developing software and services required to configure and automate networking devices. The successful candidate will help us scope, design, build and operate services that exceed our customer expectations.

We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, detail oriented, possessing strong written and verbal communication skills and has significant experience working at scale. Software Development Engineers work hand-in-hand with System and Network Development Engineers, Network Operations and peer software teams to ensure designs are scalable, reduce operational burden, integrate with the existing tooling and maintain our customer focus.


AWS Networking is part of AIS
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

title: Controls Technician, Controls Team
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees."

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Data Science Platform
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to build and scale the services/cloud layer of VirtSat, Leo's virtual satellite simulation platform. VirtSat lets developers and automated pipelines across Leo create, provision, and test virtual satellites, ground gateways, customer terminals, and TT&C antennas on demand — replacing scarce physical hardware benches with cloud infrastructure that scales with the constellation.

You will own the simulation control plane: the APIs, orchestration workflows, and health systems that turn a single request into a fully provisioned, flight-software-running virtual satellite. Every Leo satellite software release is validated on this platform before launch, which means the availability and latency of the services you own directly set the pace at which the constellation ships software.

This is a distributed systems role on a platform with an unusual property: your dependencies are physical. You will build APIs whose correctness depends on certificate provisioning, hardware emulation, radio link simulation, and the flight software itself — and you will make that stack behave like a reliable, self-service service.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the entity lifecycle APIs — create, provision, power-on, and tear down virtual satellites, gateways, customer terminals, and antennas — and drive them to and past a 99.9% availability bar
* Design and evolve the orchestration layer: long-running state machines that coordinate provisioning across distributed dependencies where any step can fail on physics rather than code, and where partial failure must be recoverable rather than restart-from-scratch
* Own the service-side plugin framework — the published contract, registration, delegation, and result aggregation that lets subsystem owner teams define their own initialization, health validation, and provisioning logic without our team in the loop
* Build the health check aggregation API: a single call that returns per-subsystem health with every failure attributed to the team that owns it, so customers self-diagnose instead of paging an on-call
* Build and own continuous canaries that validate the full stack against a pre-production constellation on a fixed schedule, wired so that a failure cuts a ticket and pages automatically with no human in the detection path
* Integrate with certificate, identity, and entity-registry services — device identity generation at constellation scale, certificate lifecycle, namespace registration, and the calibration data that makes a virtual entity behave like its physical twin
* Drive down provisioning latency, currently measured in minutes at p90, through parallelization, image pre-baking, and eliminating serialized dependencies
* Own observability end to end — structured logging, embedded metrics, distributed tracing, and log centralization — with the specific goal that a customer can root-cause a failed run from logs alone without recreating it
* Scale the platform for concurrent multi-tenant use: capacity management across bare-metal pools, fleet-wide provisioning throughput, and cost per simulated entity
* Partner closely with the virtualization and emulation team that owns the host layer, with subsystem owner teams who build against your plugin contract, and with the test frameworks and release pipelines that are your highest-volume customers

A day in the life
This role is for a Software Development Engineer who will build new cloud services and APIs that manage customer devices such as applying software updates, telemetry, and self-healing. You will be building low-latency, highly scalable architecture that are critical to getting high quality internet service to customers.

About the team
You will join the VirtSat Platform team within Leo Developer Experience. The team owns VirtSat end to end — the simulation service control plane, the virtualization host layer, fidelity of the emulated subsystems, and adoption across Leo.

This role sits on the services side of that boundary. You will own the simulation service: its public APIs, its provisioning workflows, its plugin framework, its canaries and health checks, and its availability and latency posture. A sibling role owns the bare-metal virtualization layer beneath you; you own the contract between them.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- Experience designing and evolving APIs, including backward compatibility and versioning

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with workflow orchestration for long-running, failure-prone processes — AWS Step Functions, Temporal, Airflow, or similar — including checkpointing and resume semantics
