私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をAmazonのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シニアエリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
■生産・業務計画の立案、進捗・実績・各種指標管理、人員・労務管理
想定物量を予測する部署と連携し、生産・業務計画を立案します。
配送ルートや人員配置の全体計画を立てます。
具体的には、物量に応じて必要となる人員数を算出し外部協力会社（派遣会社や業務委託会社など）との連携。
また社内システムを用いて各種計画の進捗・実績管理などを実施。現場と連携し、生産性向上を実現していきます。

■各種プロジェクト・改善活動の取りまとめ、人員育成・チームビルディング
今の生産性を維持するのではなく、改善を図って向上させるのがAmazonのシニアエリアマネージャーです。
業務改善プロジェクトなどの進行・取りまとめ役となり、最新テクノロジーの導入や工程の見直し等検討し、教育プランの策定も行います。
ミーティングはオペレーションマネージャーやエリアマネージャーと定期的に実施します。

■業務上で発生したトラブルや問題の解決
例えば、コンベアが停止した際のリカバリープランの立案・実施など。
商品が物流拠点内で滞留しないよう、トラブルに合わせて人員配置や対応方法などを検討します。

title: Finance Transformation Lead, Inbound Transportation FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a highly analytical and resourceful Finance Manager to lead financial transformation across the Global Logistics Network. Amazon continuously innovates on behalf of customers to deliver faster and at lower cost. In this role, you will drive profitability and customer experience by directly shaping the development, planning, and execution of the Inbound supply chain network.

This is a build role. You will not inherit a mature P&L with established cadences. You will stand one up. You will carve out multi-billion-dollar business lines, define the financial architecture, and create the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility for the first time. The right candidate thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and communicates with precision.

You will work closely with the Inbound Reporting, Planning and Execution team as a strategic finance business partner. You will take a practical, grounded approach to understanding operations, identifying cost savings opportunities, and owning the process for securing financial entitlements. Through deep dives into data and regular engagement with business leaders, you will translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations that influence decisions and drive profitability for the Inbound supply chain network.

Key job responsibilities
What You Will Do

Own the P&L for a newly carved-out business unit within the Inbound network, building the financial model from scratch

Design and run the planning and forecasting cadence for your scope, including WBR, MBR, and OP cycles

Partner directly with Ops, Tech, and network planning leaders to identify cost drivers, size opportunities, and own the financial story

Deep dive data to root cause variances, build strategy models, and surface insights that would otherwise stay buried in operational noise

Communicate findings clearly and succinctly to senior leadership, providing level-headed guidance during unexpected events

Build the reporting infrastructure your business partners need, not the reports they already have

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of multiple finance and accounting roles experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a highly analytical field (e.g., Engineering, Math, and Computer Science)
- 5+ years of finance experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Manager Operations, Fulfillment & Operations Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's MEX1 Fulfillment Center in Mexico City seeks a frontline Operations Manager to lead a team in our Outbound area the part of the warehouse where customer orders are packed, sorted, and shipped. You will supervise a team of 30-80+ hourly warehouse associates, drive daily productivity and quality targets, and ensure every package leaves the building safely, accurately, and on time. This role operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where hands-on leadership, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement are critical to success.

Key job responsibilities
- Safety & compliance: Own your team's safety culture. Conduct daily safety walks, ensure all associates follow personal protective equipment and ergonomic standards, and address hazards immediately. Lead initiatives to reduce product damage and shipping defects.
- Shift management: Plan and assign work across your team to meet daily volume targets and shipping deadlines. Monitor real-time performance dashboards, adjust staffing levels, and reassign resources to close productivity gaps during your shift.
- Quality assurance: Audit packing accuracy, labeling compliance, and truck-loading standards. When defects arise, identify the root cause and implement corrective actions on the same shift.
- People leadership:Supervise, coach, and develop a team of hourly warehouse associates. Manage attendance, schedules, and timesheets. Conduct regular one-on-one conversations focused on strengths, development goals, and career growth.
- Hiring & onboarding: Participate in recruiting and interviewing to build a high-performing team. Design onboarding plans that accelerate new hires' learning and integration.
- Communication: Run daily pre-shift meetings to align the team on priorities and safety reminders. Write clear shift-handoff reports and present operational updates to senior leadership.

- Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and standard operating procedures. Participate in structured problem-solving events to eliminate waste and improve efficiency.
- Cross-functional collaboration:Coordinate with receiving, inventory control, and transportation teams to ensure a smooth end-to-end order fulfillment flow.

A day in the life
You start your shift by reviewing the daily plan: expected order volume, available headcount, and shipping deadlines. In a quick pre-shift meeting you align your team on priorities, safety reminders, and quality focus areas. Throughout the shift you walk the warehouse floor observing packing stations, checking throughput, and coaching associates in real time. When a shipping deadline is at risk, you reallocate labor, remove bottlenecks, and communicate the recovery plan to your manager. You hold brief one-on-one conversations with associates about their performance and growth. At the end of the shift you hand off key metrics and open issues to the incoming manager. Your key stakeholders are the associates on your team, the senior manager you report to, and the downstream transportation network that depends on accurate, on-time shipments.

About the team
The MEX1 Outbound Operations team is responsible for the final stages of order fulfillment — packing, sorting, and shipping customer orders from one of Amazon's largest fulfillment centers in Mexico City. We operate in a high-volume environment where every unit matters. Our culture values ownership, speed of action, delivering results, and building trust. We put safety above everything, invest in our associates' development, and continuously raise the bar on quality and efficiency. You will join a team that is passionate about delighting customers while building a great workplace.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience with six sigma tools and Lean techniques
- MBA, or Master's degree

title: Team Manager, RBKS AI Data
descriptionHtml:
Interested in improving the technology and features powering Amazon Devices? Come work on it. We are building the speech and language solutions behind Ring and other Alexa-enabled products and services.

Key job responsibilities
Manages team size of 20 to 25 ML Data Associates.
· Executes plans for team to perform tasks related to multiple ML workflows in a well-defined process area.
· Ensures ML data workflows are quality compliant. Analyzes ML data, SIM issues, and metrics. Highlights trends, gaps, etc. Provides status reports.
· Identifies risks and ensures escalations reach the right people. Adherence to confidentiality and compliance requirements
· Responsible for known SLAs and task completion targets (within provided capacity) for specific customers.
· Works with internal/ external teams and uses his/her knowledge and expertise to execute business goals
· Uses data to set/revisit operational goals and manage activities
· Manages escalation/ complex tickets; analyzes data; highlights trends, gaps, etc.; and reports key metrics
· Presents data in business meetings/reviews
· Design and implement process improvement projects that impact team level performance. Participates in new workflow roll out projects teams.
· Coaches direct reports on demonstrating leadership principles in their role.
· Assigns appropriate challenging work to employees to develop & prepare them for larger roles.
· Provides team guidance on work types and prioritization. Work of team primarily focuses on straightforward, well-defined objectives, but may take on ad hoc and ill-defined requests.
· Devises and implements performance improvement plans for associates. Provides regular coaching and feedback to direct reports with regard to quality, performance, behavior and career development.
· Performance manages team based on metrics & deliverables on a regular basis, and make decisions on hiring & firing.
· Holds team members accountable for performance based on metrics and adherence to rules and guidelines.

A day in the life
Amazon is seeking an experienced team manager to manage team of 20-25 annotation experts. The Team Manager will lead the annotations effort in India and partner closely with the Operations Manager. S/he will become an expert in the annotation processes, train and support the team, maintain accuracy and throughput standards.

Connect with our stakeholders to understand the key annotation requirements and train associates to deliver efficient annotations. He/she conduct close-loop sessions with research team members to know more about the ML model KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) and propose scalable solutions to improvise the efficiency.

Basic qualifications

- BE, BSC candidates, B tech - Mtech, Msc , IT, ECE, ELECTRICAL ELECTRONIC ENGIEERING · Comes with an industry experience of 5 to 7 years with at-least 1 to 2 years in team lead/people management role. · A graduate in any field of study. Quantitative fields such as science and engineering preferred but not mandatory · Good familiarity with the Windows desktop environment and use of Word, Excel, IE, Firefox etc. are required · Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills · Good project management skills · Strong judgment and instincts and able to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment · Strong people management skills and ability to lead by example · Ability to adapt to dynamic project requirements · High level of energy and proactive nature. A sense of ownership and drive and a willingness to accept the challenge of daily deadlines is essential

title: Solutions Architect, AWS Denmark & Iceland
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Denmark and empower large enterprises across industries to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.

Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.

They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.

Amongst others you will be part of design and building reference architectures, proof of concepts and deploy production workloads on AWS. Provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.

Come build the future with us.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Key job responsibilities
- Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
- Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
- Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features tailored for the industry.
- Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
- Evangelize and educate customers about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
- Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organization.
- Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to outcomes.


About the team
The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will have the support to grow your expertise. Every day you will learn something new from your customers, your peers and your own experiments. At AWS you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Background in Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps across industries.
- Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience
- Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product and technical challenges
- English business level communication skills written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- Prior domain experience in enterprise cloud adoption and operating production workloads on AWS
- Knowledge of cloud native design patterns, DevOps practices and AWS services
- Experience with or understanding of common enterprise regulations, security and compliance standards
- Experience in working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Public speaking experience or passion for creating technical content

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Capture Manager, Amazon Leo Government
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The mission of Amazon Leo Government (ALG) is to leverage Amazon Leo and provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite broadband services to United States and allied government customers.

We have an immediate opening for a Capture Manager to support the ALG team focusing on U.S. Government customers in the Defense, National Security, and Federal Civilian areas. As a Capture Manager, you will perform a pivotal role in defining and implementing customer-oriented services for Amazon Leo satellite communication services serving government customers. You will work with the ALG Business development teams to close business at a rapid rate and scale to include improved RFI responses, pre-RFP customer education and shaping, and even unsolicited proposal initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess appropriate experience and the necessary clearances to work with the defense and intelligence communities. They will possess a deep industry background that enables them to engage and communicate effectively in a wide range of technical and business discussions with internal ALG colleagues, aerospace/satellite partner organizations, and end customers. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across multiple geographies. Successful members of this team collaborate effectively to solve data and operational problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high operational standards.

The best candidates will have foundational knowledge of capture process related to U.S. Government. They will be able to lead development of a strategic ALG Capture strategy and ensure required investments are reflected in the business plan and meet long-term ALG goals and objectives. They must have expertise and experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) using tools like cloud-based Salesforce or similar relevant tools.

Key job responsibilities
As a Capture Manager for Amazon LEO focusing on government customers, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build broad use of Amazon’s Leo broadband communication systems for government users. Your responsibilities will include working with the internal Amazon LEO Public Sector team to develop and maintain a multi-year pipeline of Amazon Leo related opportunities, develop and oversee implementation of bid strategies, proposal approaches and technical solutions, and manage written proposals for RFI/RFQ/RFP/BAA and IDIQ Contracts for customers and partners. In addition, you will be responsible for delivering actionable, objective insights to Sales team leadership leaders to inform the strategic ALG capture approach. You must possess expertise and experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) using tools like cloud-based Salesforce or similar relevant tools.

In this role you will:
• Develop and utilize an integrated, data-driven customer relationship management (CRM) software solution, like Salesforce, to help manage, track, and store information related to ALG current and potential customers.
• Maintain and monitor the ALG opportunity pipeline; generate needed reports to support strategic planning and go-to-market campaigning
• Provide ALG leadership with CRM data to monitor opportunity pipeline health
• Identify bid opportunities through direct interactions with existing and prospective DoD and national security customers, as well as, through a wide range of industry forums and procurement resources
• Develop a plan for understanding the customer’s requirements, issues, and needs during the pursuit and capture phases and lead planning sessions with core team
• Develop and execute a plan for shaping customer opportunities
• Own the pursuit of ALG opportunities, linking Business Development activities into the Proposal activities
• Serve as a key member of the Amazon Leo Government team identifying and responding to pursuit opportunities, leveraging knowledge of U.S. government acquisition guidelines and experience with government RFP/BAA compliance requirements
• Gather, assess, and validate customer requirements leveraging knowledge of government contracting, to create a targeted, differentiated win strategy
• Ensure timely development of final win themes, win strategies, value propositions, and differentiators
• Manage opportunity validation and maturation to assist ALG in determining Pursue/ No pursue and Bid / No Bid decisions
• Lead internal opportunity problem-solving, gate review discussions and RFI response
• Partner with ALG program, sales, and Product teams to identify process improvement opportunities and implement solutions
• Develop, manage, and execute the proposal response plan while working with key internal ALG stakeholders (e.g., sales teams, service teams, legal, contracts, and proposal support) to understand and navigate government procurement processes and procedures.
• Be a thought leader with respect to customer program pursuit, proposal responses, win themes, ROI analyses, technical discriminators, innovative business solutions and strategies, and price-to-win
• Create consensus on overall opportunity capture strategy
• Analyze capture performance, measure capture productivity, create dashboards, and report insights
• Maintain and develop capture related tools or reports that align, and simplify, monthly business reviews, annual planning, and forecasting processes

Security Clearance: This position requires that the selected candidate be a US Citizen and must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.

This position is in Arlington, VA. Some travel, both domestic and international, will be required.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent
- 5+ years of responding to requests for proposals (e.g., determining requirements, matching requirements to technical approach and solutions, developing solutions against requirements) experience
- 6+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
- 10 years of full lifecycle Sales/Capture and acquisition leadership experience for the US Government
- 7+ years of Capture Manager experience, managing all aspects of capture management, leveraging expertise using Salesforce and/or relevant contract management tools.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
- Knowledge of government contracting laws, rules and regulations including, but not limited to, commercial items contracting requirements, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation (DFAR)
- Experience managing technical sales, leveraging analytical skills, and demonstrated improvement to customer experience.

title: Software Development Manager, Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary
Kubernetes only gets useful once you add things to it: networking, storage, DNS, observability, cert management, AWS resource control. Our team is how Amazon EKS customers get all of that without operating any of it: EKS add-ons and EKS capabilities, installed, upgraded, healed, and security-scanned by us, on live clusters, in every AWS region and partition.

We're hiring a Manager III, Software Development in Seattle to lead that team. You'll own three connected problems: the operator that reconciles add-ons onto customer clusters and repairs them when they drift; the release supply chain that takes an add-on from a partner team's commit to a globally available, CVE-scanned version; and the newest layer: Managed AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK) and kro, where AWS runs the controllers so customers can manage AWS resources from Kubernetes without babysitting the controllers themselves.

- High blast radius, high leverage: an add-on change lands on running production clusters, so correctness and rollout safety are the design constraints, not an afterthought
- You're upstream and downstream of everyone: AWS service teams ship add-ons through your pipeline, and your operator is what actually puts them on customer clusters
- Real open source: ACK and kro are public projects; the team works in the upstream repos, not just around them

Key job responsibilities
- Own the team's charter, roadmap, and delivery for add-on lifecycle, add-on release, and managed ACK/kro capabilities, including the trade-off calls between new capability and paying down operational load
- Hire, grow, and retain SDEs across levels; set the bar for design review, code review, and on-call quality
- Raise release velocity for add-on partner teams while tightening the safety envelope: staged rollouts, bake time, automated validation, fast rollback
- Own operational excellence for a fleet-wide, multi-region, multi-partition service: alarms that mean something, dashboards leadership can read, COEs that produce fixes rather than paragraphs
- Drive the security supply chain for add-on images: scan coverage, time-to-patch, and holding the line with provider teams on CRITICAL/HIGH findings
- Partner with PM and adjacent EKS teams (control plane, connectivity, the internal cluster platform the capability controllers run on) on cross-team designs and launches
- Represent the team in upstream ACK/kro and EKS add-on community work, and in customer and service-team escalations


A day in the life
You start with the health of a system that is always mid-flight: overnight reconciliation and canary signal, an alarm from one region, a partner team's release stuck in a rollout wave. You spend the morning making those either fixed or owned, and asking why the system needed a human at all.

Then the design work. An engineer wants to change how the operator detects drift; another is proposing how a managed controller gets scoped credentials to touch a customer's AWS resources. You review the doc, push on failure modes, and cut scope so it ships in a quarter rather than a year.

Afternoons are the seams between teams. An AWS service team wants their add-on GA'd in a new partition. A container security review needs an answer on patch latency. Your PM wants to know what the roadmap costs if you also take on the next capability type. You have 1:1s, you write, and you fight for the two or three things that actually matter this quarter.

Your customers are both external and internal: EKS customers running these add-ons in production, and the AWS service teams and open-source partners who ship through your pipeline.



About the team
We're the add-ons and capabilities team inside Amazon EKS, based in Seattle. Our mission is simple to state and hard to do: everything a customer adds to their cluster should be installed correctly, upgraded safely, patched fast, and boring to operate.

Culturally we're a code-is-truth team. Designs are written down and argued about; assumptions get checked against the source and against production rather than asserted; the person who finds the sharp edge is expected to file it down, not just report it. On-call is shared and taken seriously, and we treat operational pain as a design bug. We work in public repos alongside upstream maintainers, which keeps the standard honest.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required
- Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
- Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
- Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
- Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:
-Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
-Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
-Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)

title: Program Manager III, Service Delivery Standard Work
descriptionHtml:

Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. Our team enables Amazon CS’ frontline teams to deliver seamless, consistent, convenient, and delightful customer service to all our customers (including our consumers, businesses, and drivers) across every interaction.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to serve as the Service Delivery organization’s single threaded leader for CS Security. You closely partner with CS Security in identifying and mitigating information security risks across all Customer Service systems, data, people, assets, and capabilities. You will work backward from security risks and associate pain points to design solutions and processes and define product requirements. Partnering with CS Security, engineering, operations, and stakeholder teams you will deliver solutions at scale. You will balance short-term tactical improvements with long-term strategic bets to continuously raise the bar on the associate experience and empowerment.

You are equally comfortable diving into data and anecdotes to identify opportunities, writing PRFAQs, vision docs and BRDs, and influencing without authority to align cross-functional teams on a shared vision. You thrive in ambiguity, are biased toward action, and have a track record of delivering products that meet their customers’ needs. Key job responsibilities

title: Sr Solutions Architect, BDT
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges at the intersection of innovation and impact? Join Amazon's Business Data Technologies (BDT) organization as a Solutions Architect, where you'll serve as the critical technical bridge between the teams building Amazon's data platform and the internal teams transforming how they leverage it. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in large-scale data systems architecture and cross-functional technical communication to guide internal customers through their most challenging data initiatives.

You'll lead architecture reviews for interconnected systems, translate complex technical concepts for multiple audiences simultaneously, and identify friction points across consultation patterns to drive systemic improvements. Working directly with internal Amazon teams, you'll combine deep technical knowledge with strategic thinking to accelerate data lake adoption, modernize legacy platforms, and architect scalable solutions that unlock business value across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
Lead architecture reviews and provide technical guidance for large-scale data systems, evaluating design choices, identifying scalability bottlenecks, security considerations, and performance optimization opportunities while ensuring solutions are extensible and aligned with best practices.

Define and validate technical and business requirements for interconnected, complex systems by working closely with internal Amazon teams to understand their data platform needs and architect solutions that address both immediate challenges and long-term business outcomes.

Deliver clear, compelling written technical communication that resonates across multiple audiences simultaneously, creating reusable content such as architecture patterns, onboarding documentation, and technical guidance that educates teams on data platform capabilities and best practices.

Drive root cause analysis of recurring friction points identified through consultation patterns, aggregating evidence across customer interactions to identify systemic issues and partner with product and engineering teams to translate feedback into actionable improvements.

Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key internal customers, providing ongoing architecture guidance, migration support from legacy platforms, and strategic counsel that helps teams achieve their goals with Amazon's data lake technologies

A day in the life
Your day begins by triaging consultation requests that arrive through the team's ticket intake system, where you'll be assigned to new architecture challenges through round-robin distribution. You'll dive deep into a team's data architecture, reviewing their requirements for a large-scale migration off a legacy platform, and crafting recommendations that balance immediate needs with long-term scalability. Between consultations, you'll check in with established customers you've built relationships with, helping them navigate obstacles in their ongoing data lake initiatives and celebrating wins as they achieve key milestones with your guidance.

About the team
You'll join a tight-knit team of four Solutions Architects who serve as the technical connective tissue between Amazon's data platform builders and the diverse internal teams who depend on it. The team's mission is clear: accelerate data platform adoption across Amazon by providing architecture guidance, onboarding support, and expert migration assistance.

This team thrives on collaboration and knowledge sharing, working together to identify patterns across consultations and continuously improving how Amazon teams leverage data infrastructure. You'll be part of a culture that values technical depth, clear communication, and the satisfaction of removing blockers that help internal customers succeed with their most critical data initiatives.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- Experience working with or having knowledge of cloud computing and existing cloud technologies
- Can communicate effectively with all levels of the organization

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
- Knowledge of cloud architecture
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
- Experience establishing credibility quickly with senior level executives across organizations

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer - Amazon LEO, LEO Pop DataPlane
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building the networking software that connects millions of people to the internet for the first time? Amazon LEO is launching a constellation of satellites to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to the communities worldwide. As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Pop DataPlane team, you will sit at the critical junction where customers meet the LEO satellite network. You will architect and build the traffic processing pipelines that connect the satellite network to the outside world, designing systems from the ground up as Amazon LEO prepares to launch worldwide service. This is a rare opportunity to shape the technical direction of a product at global scale during a pivotal moment in its lifecycle.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and own the architectural direction of the Pop DataPlane traffic processing systems, balancing scalability, performance, and security tradeoffs across the full software lifecycle.
- Lead multi-engineer projects to build networking functions on AWS cloud infrastructure, establishing best practices for development, testing, and deployment processes.
- Collaborate with satellite network, ground station, and customer-facing teams to gather requirements, define interfaces, and ensure your systems integrate into the broader LEO architecture.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and operational dashboards to ensure system reliability and rapid delivery of new capabilities.
- Coach and mentor engineers on the team, driving a culture of high-quality code, thorough design reviews, and continuous improvement.

A day in the life
You will start many mornings reviewing operational metrics for the data-plane services your team owns, then shift into design discussions with satellite network and ground station engineers to define how new traffic flows will be processed. Afternoons often blend hands-on coding with code reviews, where you help raise the quality bar. You will regularly partner with product and systems engineers to translate customer connectivity requirements into technical designs, and you will participate in on-call rotations to keep the services that connect customers to the LEO network running smoothly.

About the team
The Pop DataPlane team within Amazon LEO owns the software layer where customer traffic enters and exits the satellite network. As Amazon LEO moves toward worldwide service launch, the team is focused on building reliable, high-throughput data-plane systems that deliver connectivity to customers around the globe. We value an inclusive culture where every team member's perspective strengthens our engineering decisions. If you want to work on a product whose impact you can see from space, this is the team to join.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

title: Procurement Category Manager, DCSP - Construction
descriptionHtml:

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com that provides a broad set of infrastructure services including computing power, storage options, networking and databases available on demand. We are the leader in cloud computing and our pioneers are embracing innovation, building the future, and making history! The infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and data center capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business.

AWS is seeking a motivated and data-driven Construction Services Procurement Category Manager to develop and implement a Procurement Change programme for the EMEA data center construction space. The ideal candidate should have a management consulting or change management background, have strong supply chain and procurement skills, analytical and financial acumen, communication capabilities, construction background and a hands-on passion to dive-deep into processes used in our data center operations environment. The candidate must have proven skills in managing operational and project teams for procurement improvement projects.

As a Procurement Category Manager for EMEA region, you will work closely with the Construction and Procurement teams to streamline vendor relationships, focusing on tier 2 and tier 3 vendors, ensuring timely delivery of materials, and mitigating bottlenecks in the procurement process. This role will also play a critical part in applying lessons learned from previous projects to enhance efficiency and optimize vendor performance. You will create and implement change programmes that will address policy, process and system changes needed to raise the maturity of the procurement function and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce costs and improve procurement function efficiency for AWS. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to manage improved internal processes. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include identifying wasteful processes, analysing data and market trends for increasing the business impact of procurement. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit a curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

title: Cost Estimator, Worldwide Grocery Stores - Growth & Development
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores, Growth & Development team is looking for a Cost Estimator to join our Store Development team.

Are you ready to play a critical financial role in one of the world's most ambitious physical retail expansions? In this role, your cost models and analysis will directly shape how Amazon builds hundreds of grocery stores across North America. You won't be tracking project budgets, you'll be building program-level cost baselines, driving portfolio analytics, and delivering the executive-level insights that help leadership make smarter investment decisions across a portfolio of 600+ locations.

Here's what makes this role different:
- You work at the program level, not the project level. Your job is to understand what it costs to build a store, why those costs shift, and how to keep our financial models current, contributing directly to how leadership makes smarter financial decisions at scale.
- Your work reaches the top. The baselines you build and the analyses you run feed directly into senior leadership conversations, monthly executive reports, and financial planning for the broader organization.
- You'll be a true cross-functional connector. You'll work closely with design, construction, finance, capital planning, and procurement teams, engaging directly with general contractors and external consultants, connecting you to some of the most important work in the business.
- You'll contribute to shaping the tools, not just use them. You'll provide input on the AI-powered analytics platforms and construction management systems our team relies on, supporting process improvements and governance that help the whole organization run more efficiently.
- You'll make the whole operation smarter over time. Every project you close out, every driver you identify, and every lesson learned feeds back into sharper baselines and better assumptions, so the next store format or new market benefits from everything we've already built.

If you're energized by the idea of bringing financial rigor to a fast-moving, large-scale retail operation, you have construction experience, and you want your work to compound in impact as the portfolio grows, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain program-level cost baselines across store formats and retail concepts, keeping financial models current as market conditions and construction costs evolve
- Execute portfolio-wide budget variance analyses and reconcile actual spend against planned baselines, covering both active and completed projects
- Support proforma updates as cost drivers shift, and collaborate with design, construction, capital planning, and procurement partners on trade-offs that impact financial goals
- Prepare monthly and quarterly cost performance data and supporting analyses for leadership review, contributing to executive review meetings and coordinating follow-up items
- Engage directly with general contractors and external consultants to gather cost data, validate assumptions, and support governance and cost validation processes
- Support process improvement, governance, and controls within construction management systems to improve data quality, consistency, and operational efficiency at portfolio scale
- Contribute to the team's AI and analytics strategy by gathering requirements, supporting tool adoption, and tracking the impact of new platform implementations
- Apply lessons learned from completed projects to continuously sharpen cost baseline assumptions and inform cost models for new store formats and capital programs

A day in the life
Most of your time centers on keeping cost models and financial baselines sharp: analyzing why costs are shifting, costing out new initiatives/formats, and making sure the right data is ready before big decisions get made. On any given day, you might be on a call with a general contractor validating cost assumptions, or working through how a design change affects an overall program cost. What you learn from each closed project feeds directly back into sharper models for the next store format. Beyond the routine, expect rapid executive requests, new concept launches, and engagement across the entire organization.

About the team
The Cost Management team is the financial accountability and controllership engine of our Store Development organization. We own the cost intelligence, vendor performance, and financial governance programs that help leadership invest smarter and operate more efficiently across 600+ grocery locations. We are a direct execution team: we do not advise on problems. We own and solve them. Every program we run is designed to scale with the business. If you join this team, you will be expected to execute with precision, build with rigor, and make the work better than you found it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
- Experience with advanced use of Excel and using statistical analysis applications, or experience in construction or project management
- Experience in financial modeling, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
- Experience working with General Contractors and construction consultants on cost-related deliverables
- 5+ years of experience in cost management, financial analysis, or construction cost management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in commercial construction
- Experience in retail or grocery construction projects
- Familiarity with construction cost indices (e.g., CCI) and industry benchmarking methodologies
- Experience supporting external consultant relationships in a construction or real estate development context
- Track record of contributing to cost reduction strategies

title: Software Development Engineer II, Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) - Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS)
descriptionHtml:
Every time an advertiser runs a campaign on Amazon, they want to know: did it drive sales at Target, Walmart, Costco, and hundreds of other retailers? Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) answers that question — and we're just getting started. We build the ML-powered attribution systems that connect billions of ad impressions to real-world purchases across the entire retail landscape, processing massive-scale panel data to give advertisers measurement insights no competitor can match. OCM is one of Amazon Ads' highest-growth products, directly responsible for unlocking advertiser investment by proving the full omnichannel value of Amazon media.

Right now, we're shipping some of the most ambitious projects in MADS: Fine-Grained OCM that breaks attribution down to category and retailer level for the first time, OCM for Autos bringing omnichannel measurement to the automotive vertical, OCM Local building location-based foot traffic measurement for restaurants and retail, a Combined Methodology that unifies our Panel and Circana measurement into a single omnichannel view, and international expansion of the Unified Panel to 8 new marketplaces. Looking ahead to 2027, we're building real-time streaming attribution, integrating LLMs for agentic report generation and automated campaign optimization, expanding into healthcare and home services verticals, and launching causal incrementality measurement. The problems are genuinely hard — privacy-safe identity resolution at scale, calibrating ML models across sparse panel data, building streaming systems that produce daily estimates from weekly ground truth — and the ambiguity is high. You won't be handed a spec; you'll be defining what to build and how.

As an SDE II, you will own the architecture and delivery of major system components end-to-end. You'll make technology choices that shape how OCM scales from thousands to tens of thousands of active studies, design distributed data pipelines processing billions of events in Spark/EMR, and build the AI-powered features that transform OCM from a reporting tool into an autonomous measurement platform. You'll work across Scala, Java, and Python, with deep expertise in big data technologies (Apache Spark, Kestrel, EMR), AWS infrastructure (Lambda, DynamoDB, Step Functions, CDK), and data modeling for both relational and non-relational systems.

You will lead technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the engineering bar across the team. You'll partner directly with applied scientists on ML model productionization and with product managers to translate ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. This is a team where an L5 engineer has outsized impact — we're small enough that your architectural decisions become the system, and high-visibility enough (S-team and VP-level goals) that leadership sees the results.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, has a track record of delivering complex distributed systems in fast-moving environments, and gets energized by problems that sit at the intersection of big data, ML, and product. You're not just looking for a job — you're looking for a team where you can shape the technical direction of a product that's redefining how the advertising industry measures success.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build scalable data pipelines processing billions of ad impression and panel receipt events using Spark/EMR on Kestrel, powering omnichannel attribution for thousands of active advertiser studies
- Lead architecture decisions for OCM's calibration, report generation, and data processing systems spanning multiple pipelines across multiple AWS accounts
- Own end-to-end delivery of major product features — from technical design through production launch — including real-time streaming attribution, AI-powered report generation, and new vertical measurement frameworks
- Drive operational excellence across OCM's distributed systems: improve observability, eliminate silent failures, and build self-healing capabilities to meet advertiser SLAs
- Mentor junior engineers, raise the bar on code quality through design reviews and CRs, and establish engineering best practices across the team
- Partner with applied scientists and product managers to translate ML model requirements into production-grade systems that serve advertiser-facing measurement products

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the overnight calibration pipeline run, investigating why a study's attributed sales look anomalous. After standup, you pair with an applied scientist to optimize a Spark job that processes panelist receipt data against ad exposure signals. In the afternoon, you lead a design review for a new streaming architecture that will reduce OCM's reporting latency from weeks to days. You close the day reviewing a CR from a teammate building LLM-powered receipt data extraction. Your work directly impacts how major brands like Procter & Gamble, Hasbro, and Scotts Miracle-Gro measure and optimize billions in advertising spend across Amazon and beyond.

About the team
Omnichannel Metrics (OCM) is part of MADS (Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science) within Amazon Ads. We answer the question every advertiser asks: "Did my Amazon ad drive sales at Target, Walmart, and other retailers?" Our team builds the ML-powered attribution systems that measure off-Amazon impact using panel data from millions of shoppers. We're a high-impact team in startup mode — shipping features that directly unlock advertiser investment and competing head-to-head with Google and Meta's measurement offerings. We value ownership, technical depth, and moving fast.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
Assemble comprehensive production kits containing all raw materials, custom workholding, cutting tools, gauges, and documentation required for specific CNC work orders.

Review Bill of Materials (BOM), blueprints, and digital CAD/CAM setup sheets to ensure perfect component matching before jobs hit the floor.

Stage completed kits at designated machining cells to ensure operators can transition seamlessly between production runs without material-related delays.

Process job teardowns by receiving used kits, logging returned components into the ERP/CMMS system, and returning modular tooling to stock.

Preset and pre-assemble cutting tools (end mills, drills, inserts) into specific tool holders using precision tool presetter machinery.

Measure and record tool offsets (length and diameter dimensions) and update the shop's central tooling database or generate RFID data tags.

Inspect, clean, and maintain specialized fixtures, molds, die components, and workholding equipment (vises, chucks, custom clamps).

Manage tool wear tracking, identifying when tooling needs replacement, regrinding, or recycling.

Track stock levels of standard raw material blanks, modular hardware, fasteners, inserts, and shop consumables.

Initiate purchase requisitions for replacement tooling and components to prevent stockout bottlenecks.

Audit and organize the tool crib and kitting zones using strict 5S lean manufacturing methodologies.

A day in the life
The Machine Shop Kitting Specialist optimizes production efficiency by managing the flow of cutting tools, fixtures, raw materials, and precision documentation to the shop floor. This role bridges the gap between engineering, the warehouse, and CNC machinists by building complete production kits. By assembling all required tooling, raw material blanks, and setup sheets prior to a production run, this specialist reduces machine downtime.

title: ATE Test Engineer , Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Come work at Amazon!

As an ATE Test Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive, design, and develop innovative test solutions for products developed for and deployed in Amazon Leo phased array antennas in LEO satellites and ground terminal products. You'll be a key contributor to defining and developing characterization and validation ATE test methodology for Amazon Leo custom silicon, helping take devices from silicon bring-up through release to high-volume production. You will contribute across digital, high-speed I/O, and RF test, and support the design and verification of the ATE hardware that enables it. You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open, collaborative peer environment.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, review, and verify ATE hardware (load board, socket, and probe card) for signal and power integrity, with attention to high-speed and RF interfaces, collaborating with external vendors through the hardware design and build process.
• Implement and optimize test programs for mm-wave System-on-Chips (SoCs) on ATE platforms such as Teradyne/Advantest and ensure seamless integration into high-volume manufacturing environments.
• Implement and optimize RF, mixed-signal, and high-speed interface test routines for high-volume manufacturing.
• Implement on-chip calibration techniques for analog and mixed-signal circuits and validation of calibration accuracy across process/voltage/temperature (PVT) corners.
• Partner directly with DFT teams to define test insertion strategy, review pattern quality, resolve coverage gaps, and optimize scan/MBIST/BIST content for ATE execution.
• Drive test program release to production, ensuring test readiness, quality, and yield targets are met at hand-off to high-volume manufacturing.
• Optimize test time, yield, and repeatability across process, voltage, and temperature.
• Support RMA and field-return debug, using test and characterization data to root-cause and resolve downstream quality issues

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 4+ years of experience in ATE test engineering, preferably in high-volume manufacturing of communication/modem processors or consumer SoCs.
- Experience developing and debugging test programs on Teradyne UltraFLEX and/or Advantest platforms.
- Experience with digital, high-speed I/O, and RF ATE test.
- Experience with ATE hardware (load board, socket, or probe card) design and verification.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- International travel required during release-to-production phases.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- Experience testing digital modem, baseband, or communication processor SoCs on ATE.
- Knowledge of transceiver architecture and topology, with a strong understanding of key test parameters and performance metrics.
- Experience with semiconductor wafer sort testing, including RF probe-level challenges and associated test methodologies.
- Digital test techniques such as scan, ATPG, MBIST, and loopback; JTAG and IEEE 1149.x.
- ATE hardware design and verification, including signal/power integrity analysis for high-speed and RF interfaces, and working with vendors through the hardware design and build process.
- Test automation of bench equipment for digital electronics (e.g., pattern generators, logic analyzers) and RF electronics (e.g., spectrum analyzers, VNAs).
- Familiarity with the New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from characterization through release to high-volume production.
- Experience with OTP/eFuse test and programming.
- Experience with source control (Git, SVN) and issue tracking (JIRA).

Central Operations (CO) is a team that explores new approaches and ways of working at Amazon Logistics, delivering scalable solutions for running increasingly complex and growing last-mile delivery networks. The CO is responsible for the critical processes of last mile delivery, such as Route planning, Scheduling and Forecasting, On Road Management, and has a vision to continually transform the way we do this in a scalable manner.

We are looking for Program Manager to join our team to launch new programs, drive improvements to the processes and technology used within Central Operations (CO). Program Manager must be able to excel and grow in a new team with high ambiguity. In this role, you will think big, develop original ideas, and directly influence and collaborate with the Transportation team, Last Mile Tech team, Operations, and business development teams to further expand Central Operations also responsible for developing strategic approaches.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.

Key job responsibilities
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.

A day in the life
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.

About the team
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, New Product Success
descriptionHtml:
Most AI in commerce helps customers find what already exists. We help shape what should exist.

Third-party sellers account for about 60% of units sold in Amazon's stores. New Product Success helps them identify, launch, and scale new products, and helps customers discover them. As AI reshapes shopping, the store that wins won't have the most products. It will have the products customers actually want. That's the problem we solve, with ML and AI at the core.

As the Principal PMT on New Product Success team, you will own the ML-powered system that turns unmet customer demand and gaps in our selection into launch opportunities for sellers. That means finding what customers want but can't find using internal and external signals, sizing and ranking those gaps, personalizing them for each seller, and setting up for success each opportunity through launch and discovery across shopping surfaces.

Few roles let a product leader own the ML, the user experience, and the marketplace growth outcome end to end. This one does, and it's high-visibility, high-leverage, and central to how Amazon's selection grows. The results are tracked as company level goal by Amazon's executive leadership team.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for this space, working backwards from both customers and the sellers who serve them.
• Define product requirements for the ML systems behind the experience, including product clustering, unmet demand and selection gap detection, opportunity sizing and ranking, and personalization.
• Own the seller-facing experience: which opportunities each seller sees, when, and why, so guidance is clear, trusted, and actionable.
• Close the loop from opportunity to launch, measuring whether guided launches succeed and feeding those learnings back into the models.
• Shape the economic model that makes launching guided selection the rational choice for sellers - spanning fee incentives, discovery support, and risk-sharing mechanisms that close the gap with low-cost competitors.
• Partner with engineering, science, design, user research, and marketing, and influence Directors and VPs across Amazon through PRFAQs, strategic narratives, and business reviews.
• Set the metrics, mechanisms, and experimentation strategy that prove impact and guide future investment.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience leading large projects through the full product development life cycle in a large, cross-functional team
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design of new and current systems
- Experience defining and shipping ML-powered products, such as recommendation, ranking, personalization, or prediction systems
- Experience communicating product strategy and influencing senior leadership through written narratives and executive reviews

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- MBA, or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
- Experience with generative AI, LLMs, or agentic experiences in production
- Experience with two-sided marketplaces or seller, merchant, or partner-facing platforms
- Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that span business and technology
