title: Strategic Planning Lead, Sales Strategy and Business Operations, AWS WWPS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Strategic Planning Lead to drive strategic Go-to-Market (GTM) execution across two high-impact initiatives within the Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of AWS's strategic enterprise account growth initiative and the Prioritized Growth Systems framework, operating as the connective tissue between worldwide strategy and field-level sales execution.

The successful candidate will split their focus equally between two critical workstreams:

Strategic Account Operations: Serving as the operational backbone for WWPS's enterprise strategic account initiative, ensuring alignment between worldwide strategy and regional execution. This includes managing cadences with Geo leadership, preparing executive-level reporting, monitoring KPIs, facilitating cross-functional coordination, and driving the deployment of the strategic account operating model within WWPS.

Mission Systems & Growth Systems GTM Operations: Supporting the design and execution of WWPS's Prioritized Growth Systems framework, a unified strategic workload mechanism providing sales teams with operational infrastructure, industry intelligence, and strategic support to systematically identify and pursue the highest-impact public sector mission system opportunities.

This role requires someone who can navigate organizational complexity, influence without direct authority, and operate effectively across multiple stakeholder groups spanning sales, GTM, industry specialists, partnerships, enablement, and executive leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Serve as the operational point of contact for WWPS Geo leadership, account teams, and cross-functional partners across both strategic account and mission systems workstreams, ensuring seamless coordination between worldwide strategy and field execution

Collaborate with Geo GTM, sales leaders, and industry GTM leaders (Healthcare, Education, Government, Partners) to develop and execute localized GTM plans, aligning on priorities, investments, resource deployment, and use case patterns

Provide inputs, strategic context, and WWPS-specific insights to support Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), 2x2 documents, and other key initiative reviews led by the Geo Execution team

Identify trends and surface risks from KPIs, pipeline data, and opportunity metrics to inform Geo leadership decision-making and prioritize customer lists

Quantify opportunity landscape by industry use case, evaluate average opportunity sizing, and validate data findings with FSO leaders and sales stakeholders to inform GTM strategy

Facilitate regular cadences with Geo teams, the worldwide strategic accounts organization, and Growth Systems stakeholders to inform strategy updates and enable best practice sharing

Oversee the deployment and effective utilization of strategic account and Growth Systems operating model components within WWPS, ensuring mechanisms are integrated into existing sales motions

Support the development and maintenance of tooling including data pipelines, dashboards, and SFDC strategic workload features for pipeline visibility and taxonomy tracking

Manage stakeholder engagement across multiple WWPS verticals, coordinating between Sales Leaders, GTM Leaders, FSO, Enablement, Marketing, Capture, and Partnership functions

Drive cross-functional coordination and issue resolution, mapping mechanisms, roles, and responsibilities across enabling teams

Continuously seek opportunities to streamline processes, build mechanisms, improve efficiency, and scale initiative execution across Plan, Build, Implement, and Scale phases

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing strategic account performance dashboards and triaging escalations from Geo account teams, then pivot to preparing a monthly business review narrative that synthesizes pipeline health across priority accounts. After a working session with industry leaders to validate use case patterns against pipeline data, you facilitate a cross-functional sync aligning with partner teams. Your afternoon involves updating heat maps to reflect new demand signals, followed by a cadence call with the strategic accounts team to share execution updates and surface emerging best practices. No two days look alike, but the throughline is connecting strategic intent to operational reality across the organization.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. title: Brand Specialist - German
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role

Account Management- Brand Specialist

As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon.

You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.

You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business.

• Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.

• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.

• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience.

• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.

• Conduct regular WBRs, MBRs with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and building action plans.

descriptionHtml:

title: Manager III, SecEng, AppSec AI
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced security leader to join the Application Security team with a focus on Generative AI applications. As a security leader, you will manage a team of security engineers and technical program managers specializing in GenAI security, fostering a strong team culture and driving progress towards strategic goals. You should know how to prioritize, communicate clearly and compellingly, and understand how to drive a high level of focus and excellence with a strong team. Passion and discipline around cloud computing and AI/ML security is critical, as is a high level of ownership and accountability.

Amazon is continuously innovating new services and features leveraging Generative AI for our customers. Our engineers invent, build, and sometimes break things to make them easier, faster, better, and more cost-effective. However, no matter what we're building—from AI-powered customer experiences to large language model integrations, prompt engineering to model fine-tuning—security is always our top priority. The Amazon Application Security team focuses on working with our builders to provide GenAI experiences that our customers can trust. That means constantly learning new things and solving complex problems unique to AI systems to protect the safety, security, and privacy of billions of lives on a global scale.

At Amazon, you'll be working with the best minds in technology, security, and artificial intelligence. Learn and be curious here, and accelerate your career growth. You can take pride in knowing that your work is meaningful, having a positive impact on others and making the world a better place.

As a manager, you will lead application security engineers and technical program managers to solve novel security challenges that arise when Amazon builds and deploys Generative AI technologies. You'll help them develop their skills and their careers as you tackle emerging threats like prompt injection, model poisoning, data leakage, and adversarial attacks, while contributing to Amazon's overall security and privacy strategy for AI systems.

Key job responsibilities
- You will lead, manage, and develop a team of Security Engineers and Technical Program Managers responsible for Application Security (AppSec) of Amazon's Generative AI services and AI-powered applications.
- You will lead the strategic direction and evolution of GenAI Application Security review processes, including setting goals and establishing priorities for securing LLM integrations, prompt engineering workflows, and AI model deployments.
- You will set the direction for the team by driving strategic initiatives in AI security, influencing leadership, key stakeholders, and partnering with AI/ML teams throughout Amazon.
- You will develop a healthy and collaborative culture and enable the team to deliver results in the rapidly evolving GenAI security landscape.
- You will lead effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities, including data science, ML engineering, and product teams.
- You will drive improvements to internal program and process specific to GenAI security reviews, including threat modeling for AI systems, secure prompt design, and model security assessments.
- You will write and deliver high-quality documents for technical and non-technical audiences on complex GenAI security topics.
- You will drive the adoption of GenAI-specific security processes, automation, and tooling to improve operational efficiency and scale security reviews for AI applications.
- You will stay current with emerging GenAI security threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring the team maintains expertise in areas such as prompt injection prevention, model security, RAG security, and AI supply chain security.
- You will mentor and develop individual contributors, helping them grow their technical expertise and leadership capabilities.

About the team
About Amazon Security

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 5+ years of managing and developing teams experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
- Knowledge of security of web services, video content protection technologies, cryptography, network security protocols and operating system security
- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques to traditional and AI-powered applications
- Understanding of Generative AI technologies, large language models, and AI application architectures

title: Software Development Manager, Region Flexibility and Efficiency
descriptionHtml:
As a software development manager in the Region Flexibility and Efficiency organization, you will play an essential role in building the software services, frameworks, and components at the forefront of Amazon's service-oriented architecture. You will be integral in shaping the direction of our team, how we use state-of-the-art technologies to influence the way thousands of engineers interact with our products. You will be empowered to define the goals, strategy, roadmap and success metrics for this brand new team.

In this role you will lead our infrastructure-efficiency and cross region data-migration charter at Amazon scale. The systems in scope are production, mission-critical services processing millions of transactions, running across a large fleet of AWS accounts and infrastructure. Efficiency gains translate into large, fleet-wide capacity and cost impact.

You'll lead a team of 10-12 engineers driving large-scale DRAM allocation reduction across these production fleets and building the tooling and agentic workflows that make multi-region dataset migrations safe, automated, and repeatable, without compromising the availability of systems Amazon's customers and internal teams depend on every day.

This role spans people leadership, technical depth, and cross-org execution. You'll grow and develop the team, own the roadmap, dive deep on system design and efficiency, and influence partners across multiple orgs to deliver outcomes end-to-end. The team has a strong track record of realized efficiency savings and of automation that has cut manual analysis from weeks to hours, all applied safely against production workloads.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead your team to solve intriguing problems in software architecture with highly scalable solutions, guiding your team in choosing the right technologies

title: Engineering Operations Technician (Night Shift)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability

Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)

Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)

Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA

Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment

Technical writing to support change management program

Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Ingénieur régional en colo électrique Sénior  (Elec Colo Regional Engineer), Colocation Region Engineering- AMER
descriptionHtml:
Êtes-vous un ingénieur passionné par la conception des centres de données? Recherchez-vous un défi à relever pour tracer votre propre chemin? Si c’est le cas, nous vous demandons de nous aider à faire avancer l’histoire.
Les centres de données AWS constituent la base sur laquelle nos logiciels et nos services fonctionnent pour répondre aux demandes croissantes de nos clients. Ce rôle offre l’occasion de collaborer avec les équipes de prospection de clientèle, les ingénieurs concepteurs, les professionnels des opérations des centres de données, des fournisseurs et des conseillers externes, ainsi que d’autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour évaluer et sélectionner des installations de colocalisation qui répondent à nos besoins commerciaux.
Vous serez en mesure de démontrer votre compréhension approfondie de la conception de centres de données, de l’ingénierie et de l’exploitation de l’infrastructure commune aux centres de données, aux installations de télécommunications et à d’autres infrastructures d’environnements critiques.
Vous travaillerez directement avec les équipes commerciales internes et les fournisseurs de colocalisation pour identifier, documenter et résoudre toutes les lacunes opérationnelles/de conception qui pourraient avoir un impact sur la capacité ou la disponibilité d’un site.
Vous aurez l’occasion d’influencer les normes sur les produits de centre de données, de créer et d’améliorer des processus, et d’orienter notre portefeuille de centres de données de colocalisation à l’échelle mondiale. Si vous êtes un leader solide avec une grande expérience en ingénierie de conception des infrastructures mécaniques, électriques, structurelles et de plomberie des centres de données, Amazon vous offrira un environnement de travail dynamique, amusant et passionnant, unique sous tous les aspects et une opportunité gratifiante exceptionnelle.
Vous serez responsable des éléments suivants :
Diriger les évaluations de sites selon les normes établies par AWS pour les centres de données de colocalisation, les mises à niveau d’installations existantes et les efforts généraux sur le capital.
Effectuer des analyses de risques et des calculs de disponibilité pour l’infrastructure du centre de données de colocalisation détenu et exploité par le fournisseur afin de déterminer l’adéquation à l’utilisation ou au service.
Influencer les conceptions et les exigences techniques d’AWS pour répondre à nos besoins commerciaux relatifs aux produits de colocalisation d’AWS.
Faire des recherches et documenter l’analyse des causes profondes des défaillances de l’infrastructure et de l’équipement.
Travailler avec les fournisseurs et les agences locales ayant autorité pour assurer la conformité aux exigences et aux codes aux niveaux fédéral, provincial et municipal.
Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’exploitation et de mise en service pour tester et valider correctement l’installation, le fonctionnement et les performances des systèmes électriques, mécaniques, structurels, d’extinction des incendies et de contrôle critiques.
Soutenir les équipes d’exploitation, les spécialistes des données et les autres partenaires commerciaux pour établir des analyses de l’utilisation, de l’efficacité et des performances des systèmes critiques.
Vous devrez vous rendre sur les sites des centres de données (jusqu’à 50 % du temps en déplacements nationaux et internationaux).


Are you an engineer with a passion for data center design and looking for a challenge to chart your own course? If so, we are looking for you to help us make history.
AWS data centers are the foundation upon which our software and services operates to meet the growing demands of our customers. This role provides the opportunity to collaborate with business development, design engineers, data center operations professionals, external vendors and consultants, and other cross-functional teams to assess and select colocation facilities that meet our business requirements.
You will be able to showcase your in-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.
You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.
You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. So, if you are a strong leader with solid data center mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural (MEPS) infrastructure design engineering experience, Amazon will present a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment that is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional rewarding opportunity for you.
You will be responsible for the following:
Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers, legacy facility upgrades, and general capital endeavors.
Perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit-for-use/fit-for-service.
Influence AWS’ design and specification requirements to meet our business needs for AWS colocation products.
Investigate and document root-cause failure analysis associated with infrastructure and equipment failures.
Work with vendors and local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and codes.
Collaborate with engineering, operations, and commissioning teams to properly test and validate the installation, operation, and performance of critical electrical/mechanical/fire suppression/controls systems/structural systems.
Support Operations, data scientists and other business partners to determine utilization, efficiency, and performance analysis on critical systems.
Travel to Data Center sites as required - International & Domestic (up to 50%)


Key job responsibilities
Diriger les évaluations de sites selon les normes établies par AWS pour les centres de données de colocalisation et les installations de communication dans la région.

Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers and telecommunications facilities within the region.
Reviews vendor critical infrastructure designs and perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit-for-use/fit-for-service for AWS cloud compute and networking services.

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, ISV
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and committed support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS is seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to work with with the express goal of helping the customer accelerate value creation across the portfolio through business transformation. The successful candidate will help the customer design and rapidly execute strategic migrations to the AWS cloud and build modern, cloud native solutions that fulfill their highest ambitions. You will work backwards from customer objectives, utilize AWS best practices developed over thousands of engagements, and design and execute an end-to-end frictionless cloud adoption experience. Your customers capture the full potential of AWS’ industry-leading solutions. As a CSM, you are a thought leader with a strategic, business mindset. You use your technical acumen, program management, organizational change management, and communication skills to problem solve, challenge the status quo, and align a broad range of multidisciplinary teams including sales, solution architecture, enterprise support, product development, professional services, and partners.

In this role, you will earn trust across the customer’s organization, identify strategic opportunities, uncover cloud use cases, establish roadmaps and actionable program plans, capture success criteria, manage a large number of initiatives across the diverse portfolio of businesses, orchestrate advanced technical architectures, and establish programmatic governance. You own and drive execution excellence for the end-to-end customer cloud journey (e.g., technical, operational, organizational, and educational) that span IT teams, executives, and business units.

At AWS we value critical thinking, self-motivation, and ability to thrive in ambiguous, entrepreneurial environments. You will pay attention to detail but think big on behalf of our customers. As a CSM, you have a business outcome mindset, broad technical background, and a driven problem-solver. You are a team player, use data to make decisions, express yourself thoughtfully verbally and in writing, and are passionate about delivering Earth’s most customer-centric experiences.

We value Work and Life balance and understand that it looks different from person to person. Our team is dispersed across North America and stays connected through remote meetings, calls and emails. We work hard each day in a fast-paced dynamic environment, but value the need for downtime to unplug and recharge. We want employees who enjoy what they do, and do what they enjoy at work, at home and beyond. We encourage our team members to partner with their managers to strike the right balance.

AWS is a growth environment - we’re hiring and scaling rapidly to meet the needs of our internal and external customers. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope of influence naturally as we scale, deliver initiatives that make an impact and allow you to build your skills, and will have the opportunity to help hire & develop other leaders along the way.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will:

• Execute a near, mid, and long-term vision and strategy for the overall customer’s cloud transformation by collaborating with the customer and the AWS team
• Demonstrate excellent customer engagement skills through all levels of an organization and develop long term relationships based on excellence
• Maintain a broad and in-depth knowledge and understanding of existing and developing technologies as it relates to cloud computing, to unlock opportunities for customers
• Possess a strong background in change management and incorporating organizational change best practices seamlessly into project delivery
• Accelerate customer adoption through education and enablement
• Collaborate with customers in identifying and prioritizing high business impact use cases for AWS service adoption as well as best practice implementations
• Manage time efficiently and align and engage required Customer, AWS, and Partner teams to accelerate customer’s cloud journey
• Be a thought leader across Amazon organizations to knowledge share success mechanisms, mentor junior CSMs, and impact industry trends

About the team
Why AWS?

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon Private Brands
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Private Brands (APB) is reinventing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) with AI at its core. Private Brands Central (PBC) is our PLM platform, and we're building a new generation of AI-native experiences, from Gen AI copilots that accelerate new product development to agentic workflows that automate the manual, high-dwell steps in bringing a product to market. This is a chance to put Gen AI to work on real, high-volume product workflows and see the efficiency gains land.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer III who's comfortable at all levels of the stack to design, build, and operate AI-powered systems at Amazon scale. Whether it's building customer-facing experiences in React, creating Java-based web APIs, or embedding Gen AI and agentic capabilities into sourcing, quality, sustainability, and detail-page workflows, this is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own complex, ambiguous problems end to end, drive architecture and design decisions for AI-native systems, and partner with a leading 3P PLM solution to build out an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Your work will directly shape how thousands of APB products are sourced, developed, and launched.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate full-stack AI-powered systems across the PBC PLM platform, including Gen AI copilots and agentic workflows.
- Lead architecture and technical design for embedding Gen AI, LLMs, and automation into new product development workflows, working backwards from customer needs.
- Solve challenging problems involving distributed systems, agentic orchestration, performance, scalability, and reliability.
- Drive technical decisions across team and 3P-vendor boundaries to deliver integrated, AI-enabled capabilities.
- Own your systems end to end, including production operations, model behavior, and operational excellence.
- Mentor engineers on AI-native design patterns and raise the team's technical bar.

A day in the life
You'll balance hands-on delivery with the technical leadership the team relies on across development cycles measured in weeks, not years. Your day involves designing and reviewing complex systems, collaborating with engineers and applied scientists on Gen AI design decisions, and aligning with APB business partners and the 3P vendor on integrated PLM delivery. You'll spend time mentoring engineers, unblocking hard technical problems, and setting the standards that let the team ship AI-powered experiences customers can feel.

About the team
This team builds functional modules within the Private Brands Central Product Lifecycle Management tool to accelerate speed to market for new product development for Amazon Private Brands (APB) and reduce dwell time for specific processes, increasingly powered by Gen AI and automation. Examples include: developing an externalized module for sourcing Request For Quotations (RFQs) from APB suppliers, launching an automated process to manage sustainability and quality related claims for APB products, and automating ASIN and Detail Page creation on Amazon systems. The team is partnering with a 3P solution to build out an integrated PLM tool with an industry-leading software solution.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- Experience in similar environments, or experience working with and managing third party vendors

title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.
221100
10044

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
- Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
- Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
- Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.
- Establish reusable delivery mechanisms, best practices, and documentation standards that improve quality and efficiency across engagements, and mentor fellow engagement managers to raise the overall team capability.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and preparing for a steering committee meeting with a customer's leadership team, where you present delivery progress and align on upcoming milestones. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team planning session, helping architects and developers prioritize the next sprint. After lunch, you join a technical review to validate that a proposed solution meets the customer's business objectives, then spend time coaching a newer engagement manager on stakeholder communication. Your afternoon wraps with a pipeline discussion, where you help shape an upcoming pre-sales opportunity.

About the team
AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. Whether you are helping a customer adopt generative artificial intelligence or guiding a complex enterprise transformation, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in cloud technology and have the opportunity to shape how organizations innovate at scale.

- 2+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
- 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
- Bachelor's degree in STEM field
- Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
- Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
- Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
- active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
- AWS certification
- Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
- Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga

title: Apprenti(e) Program Manager FRA
descriptionHtml:
Un univers d’opportunités chez Amazon
Chez Amazon, votre carrière ne suit pas une ligne droite. Elle accélère, prend des tournants et vous met au défi d’une manière que vous n’auriez jamais imaginée. Dès votre arrivée, vous faites partie de quelque chose de grand : créer des produits ou des services qui touchent des millions de personnes et façonnent la manière dont elles vivent, travaillent et interagissent au quotidien. C’est ici que vos idées se transforment en un véritable impact.
Vous travaillerez avec des outils de premier plan, des plateformes mondiales et des systèmes conçus pour fonctionner à une échelle extraordinaire. Vous avancerez vite, expérimenterez et lancerez des solutions qui comptent vraiment. Grâce à d’innombrables opportunités à explorer au sein de différentes équipes et fonctions, vous apprendrez rapidement, mettrez en pratique vos connaissances et découvrirez des compétences que vous ne soupçonniez pas. C’est un environnement pensé pour les bâtisseurs qui veulent voir l’impact concret de leur travail dans le monde.
Prêt(e) à commencer votre aventure ? Une alternance chez Amazon, c’est de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour. Vous construirez, testerez et apprendrez aux côtés de personnes qui veulent vous voir réussir, tout en ayant un impact qui va bien au-delà du campus.

Key job responsibilities
Principales responsabilités du poste
•      Collaborer avec différentes parties prenantes internes pour contribuer à enrichir l’offre d’un programme et ses bénéfices pour nos clients.
•      Développer des compétences en gestion de projet dans un environnement commercial compétitif et dynamique, en travaillant avec des équipes transversales.
•      Travailler sur un ou plusieurs projets au sein de votre équipe d’accueil : suivre les actions en cours, mener des analyses approfondies et formuler des recommandations fondées sur l’analyse des données.
•      Analyser les processus pour identifier les points critiques et anticiper les risques.
•      Accompagner l’équipe dans la recommandation et la mise en œuvre d’améliorations au sein du réseau.
•      Proposer des solutions innovantes, durables et bénéfiques pour l’ensemble de l’équipe.

A day in the life
Une journée type
Chaque jour est différent en tant qu’apprenti(e) Program Manager. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de votre mentor dédié et de votre équipe sur de véritables projets d’amélioration et d’innovation qui soutiennent la croissance du réseau européen d’Amazon. Vous pourriez passer votre matinée à analyser un large jeu de données pour identifier des goulots d’étranglement opérationnels, puis consacrer votre après-midi à échanger avec des parties prenantes de différents pays sur un plan de déploiement. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes transversales, suivrez les jalons des projets et partagerez des mises à jour avec la direction.
Amazon est une entreprise guidée par les données : quel que soit le projet sur lequel vous travaillez, une partie de votre rôle consistera à en extraire des enseignements pour orienter les décisions. Vous développerez des solutions à de véritables défis opérationnels, testerez différentes approches et présenterez vos conclusions à la direction, renforçant ainsi vos compétences analytiques, en communication et en gestion de projet dans un environnement international au rythme soutenu.

About the team
À propos de l’équipe
Communauté des alternants : En tant qu’alternant(e) Amazon, vous ferez partie d’une communauté dynamique et solidaire qui favorise votre croissance et votre développement. Vous collaborerez avec des alternants et stagiaires du monde entier, en tissant des liens et en participant à des événements sociaux pour élargir vos perspectives. Vous pourrez également rejoindre des groupes spécialisés axés sur des domaines tels que le développement durable, afin d’explorer vos centres d’intérêt variés.
Accompagnement : Le programme d’alternance offre un système d’accompagnement solide, comprenant des créneaux hebdomadaires dédiés aux alternants, un support informatique et RH dédié, ainsi qu’une équipe programme engagée pour votre réussite. Cela garantit que vous disposez de l’orientation et de l’assistance nécessaires pour vous épanouir.
Sessions de formation : Des sessions de formation exclusives renforceront davantage vos compétences, en vous donnant accès aux plateformes d’apprentissage de référence d’Amazon et à l’expertise de leaders du secteur. Ces opportunités de développement structurées vous prépareront à la prochaine étape de votre carrière.
Opportunités : À l’issue d’une alternance réussie, vous pourrez être considéré(e) pour un poste en CDI jeune diplômé ou pour un second contrat, vous permettant de poursuivre votre parcours chez Amazon. Vous bénéficierez d’un salaire mensuel compétitif, d’une aide à la relocalisation et d’un accès à une gamme d’avantages sociaux.
Dates de début tout au long de l’année : Nous recrutons des alternants pour des prises de poste à tout moment entre janvier et septembre 2027. Chaque mois, nous organiserons une à deux journées d’intégration pour les nouveaux arrivants.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French and English at C1 level or above
- Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral (niveau C1 minimum)
- Être actuellement en avant-dernière ou dernière année d’études et préparer un diplôme universitaire avec une date de diplôme prévue après la fin de l’alternance
- Être disponible pour commencer une alternance entre janvier et septembre 2027, puis être disponible pour une durée de 12 mois (la durée est soumise à la disponibilité)
- Maîtrise avancée de Microsoft Excel (par ex. macros, tableaux croisés dynamiques, fonctions de recherche, VBA)
- Disposer du droit de travailler en France à la date de prise de poste
- Être basé(e) à Clichy pendant toute la durée de l’alternance (une aide à la relocalisation pourra être proposée, sous réserve de critères d’éligibilité)
- Diplôme de niveau licence ou supérieur en gestion, administration des entreprises, économie, ingénierie ou marketing

Preferred qualifications

- Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse, avec la capacité d’identifier des améliorations de processus et des solutions innovantes
- Excellentes compétences en communication et en travail d’équipe, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les autres
- Curiosité, proactivité et volonté démontrées de relever des défis dans un environnement ambigu et au rythme soutenu

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

This role will drive AWS technology adoption and revenue growth across a small set of global automotive and manufacturing customers. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers navigate complex architectural decisions across connected vehicle platforms, autonomous driving workloads, digital twins, smart factory/Industry 4.0 initiatives, supply chain optimization, and software-defined vehicle (SDV) strategies. As an experienced technologist and key member of the Account Team, you will influence customers' architectural choices across broad use cases involving IoT, edge computing, high-performance computing (HPC), security, data lakes and analytics, AI/ML, simulation, and robotics — as well as foundational services spanning compute, storage, and networking. title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Continuous Infrastructure Automation
descriptionHtml:
The Continuous Infrastructure Automation Team builds and continuously improves the core infrastructure components used by tens of thousands of Amazonians, hundreds of thousands of IP enabled devices, a growing fleet of robots, and countless other user devices in our facilities around the world. You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. You will work directly with other systems, network and software engineers to help secure and scale the technology that supports our Fulfillment Centers and Transportation sites.

As a technical leader, you will be a pragmatic leader that can translate business needs into technology solutions that scale both technically and operationally. You are responsible for driving quality and enabling technical innovation. You will recruit top talent, manage evolving / complex demands, including multiple projects with dependencies on other internal organizations. You will draw on customer feedback, usage and operational data, and your experience leading technology businesses to set and deliver on key goals for adoption, operational performance, feature delivery, and revenue.

Key job responsibilities
You must be able to:
- Interact with Project Sponsors, other Technical Program Managers, and multiple development teams to define and deliver complex cross-functional projects.

- Drive large scale projects spanning teams across Amazon from inception to conclusion, formulate the product vision, define user stories, research appropriate technical solutions.

- Clearly communicate vision, plans and project status to management and key technical and business stakeholders.

- Work closely with the software development team on delivering high-quality solutions, and provide guidance regarding architecture, design, and priorities.

- Engage with other teams across Amazon to evangelize the team and your projects, to build relationships and help identify existing technologies that can be leveraged to meet your team’s goals.

- Identify, assess and mitigate risks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs balancing the business needs versus constraints.

descriptionHtml:

The Hyperplane team within AWS is rebuilding one of its critical engineering groups and looking for experienced technical leaders to help strengthen engineering practices, raise the bar on software quality, and drive the next wave of innovation — including investments in generative AI and a greenfield rewrite of a core system.

Hyperplane delivers a distributed Network Function Virtualization (NFV) platform that powers customer-facing services such as NAT Gateway, Elastic File System, Load Balancers, and AWS service endpoints. We operate at massive scale on critical workloads, and we need engineers who are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making sound technical trade-offs, and mentoring others along the way. If you want to leave a lasting mark on cloud networking infrastructure that serves millions of customers, this is the role for you.

You might start your morning reviewing a design proposal for the new greenfield system, providing feedback that shapes the architecture before code is written. We are in a period of deliberate investment — rebuilding our team with experienced technical leaders, expanding into generative AI, and planning a greenfield rewrite of a critical system. descriptionHtml:
The Global Specialty Recruiting Team (GSR) recruits for Amazon's most senior technical and leadership roles.

We are seeking a Talent Intelligence Analyst to develop mission-critical insights and analysis for a data-driven talent acquisition team. You will work with business leaders and talent acquisition partners to define key talent questions, set up data structures to collect information, and design and execute research projects to answer those questions.

The Talent Intelligence Analyst will partner with GSR and the business to drive hiring strategies globally by sharing market insights and advising recruiting and leadership.

Scope
This role is critical to building our research capability across multiple locations and partnering with business teams to design recruiting strategies for hard-to-fill, business-critical roles. You will act as a talent advisor, partnering with GSR Recruiters, Human Resources, Finance, and business customers to drive strategy, goals, processes, and metrics.

The ideal candidate
You operate effectively in ambiguity, are highly analytical, and can independently set up frameworks to understand talent markets. You have experience providing information that yields measurable results. You can work independently to research, analyze data, and create geo-talent solutions to determine the best locations to grow our businesses – whether competing in hyper-competitive markets or identifying opportunity sites to access niche skillsets. You are curious, driven, and solution-oriented, with an understanding of global talent flows to support future business growth.

Key job responsibilities

Market Intelligence & Research: Lead end-to-end market intelligence projects, including geographical deep dives, talent competitor analysis, benchmarking studies, and predictive trend research. Combine primary and secondary research methods (expert interviews, surveys, desk research) with both quantitative and qualitative data to inform recruiting strategy.

Data Storytelling & Strategy Documents: Translate complex data into clear narratives, executive-ready visuals, and data-driven site strategy documents that influence organizational goals such as cost savings, diversity, and access to talent.

AI/Automation & Tooling: Design and maintain self-service dashboards and automated workflows; leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and reduce manual effort. Maintain hands-on proficiency with vendor research platforms (e.g., PitchBook, Capital IQ) for market and financial data sourcing.

Market Pulse & Trend Synthesis: Synthesize industry trends, competitor moves, and market signals into timely, digestible updates that keep Talent Acquisition leadership ahead of the curve. Evaluate and triangulate across sources to ensure accuracy.

Stakeholder Partnership & Advisory: Partner with Recruiting leadership, HR, Compensation, executive leaders, and business stakeholders to provide strategic recommendations that shape hiring decisions and ensure a superior client and candidate experience.

Recruiting Enablement & Collaboration: Mentor and partner with Sourcers and Recruiters on passive sourcing strategies; contribute to the broader TA knowledge base through education on relevant industries and talent pools.

Execution & Problem-Solving in Ambiguity: Operate independently to manage competing priorities in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment; frame research questions, set delivery timelines, run experiments, and iterate based on results with minimal direction.

A day in the life
Research: ability to learn new technology and product domains, and quickly understand and apply this knowledge into strategies for TA team

Communication: ability to effectively engage the attention of stakeholders and articulate complex arguments in a polished and professional manner

Self-assured: ability to think on your feet and work on confidential projects with senior leadership.

備品・消耗品の管理と購買・請求書処理 — 必要なものが不足しないよう手配し、日々の購買・請求書処理を進めます。
売店・Cafeteriaの運営管理 — 従業員満足度の向上に向けて、食堂運営会社と協力してサービスレベルの維持・改善に取り組みます。
従業員向けイベントの企画・運営 — FCで働く人が楽しめるイベントを自ら企画・運営します。自分が企画したイベントで従業員が笑顔になる瞬間に立ち会えることも、このポジションならではのやりがいです。
社内外の窓口・調整 — ベンダーや業者、行政などとの窓口を担い、必要な調整を進めます。
■建物・設備を守る仕事
施設の維持管理 — 建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火・昇降設備といった建物全体のインフラについて、点検結果の確認や修繕の手配・発注を行い、倉庫の安定稼働を支えます。
省エネルギー活動 — エネルギー使用量のデータをもとに、照明のLED化や空調運転スケジュールの見直しなどを進め、環境負荷の低減とコスト削減の両立を目指します。
廃棄物・リサイクル管理 — FC内で発生する産業廃棄物やリサイクル品の回収・分別を、安全・品質・生産性の観点で管理・改善します。マニフェスト管理や行政報告など、法令に沿った手続きも担います。

**このポジションの魅力**
幅広い経験がキャリアの土台になる — 建物・設備・環境・総務・イベント企画まで、施設に関わることを幅広く経験できます。特定分野に偏らない経験は、この先どんなキャリアにも活きる強みになります。
若手でも「任される」 — 発注者側の立場で、業者やベンダーへの依頼・調整を自分で進めていきます。指示を待つのではなく、自分で考えて動ける環境です（最初は先輩がしっかりサポートします）。
カスタマーの声がダイレクトに届く — 「美味しい食事が食べられて快適に働ける」「オフィスの雰囲気が良くなった」といったポジティブな声を、すぐそばで直接受け取れます。
AI・生成AIを日常業務に — Amazonでは最新のAIツールや生成AIを日々の業務に取り入れています。学習を継続する文化が根付いており、ご自身のペースでAIや施設管理の知識を深められるリソースが用意されています。

**こんな方を歓迎します**
- 施設管理の仕事に興味がある方
- 人と関わり、誰かのために動くことにやりがいを感じる方
- 新しい知識を学ぶことに前向きで、自分で考えて行動できる方
- チームや職場全体のために、情報を共有しサポートし合える方

Key job responsibilities
Amazonの業務は数値で管理されています。キーとなる数値目標がセットされ、業務の改善を通してパフォーマンスを引き上げていくことがミッションです。
たとえば電気使用量や社員食堂の満足度には数値目標があり、電気は節電、社員食堂はメニュー改善、廃棄物はリサイクル率の向上などを、各協力会社とともに進めて目標達成を目指します。


A day in the life
1日は朝礼から始まります。朝礼後はチーム別に分かれて当日の業務内容を確認し、メールチェックや現場巡回を行います。
ランチはカフェテリアや売店を利用し、あわせてサービスレベルもチェックします。会議は1日に1〜2件ほど、サプライヤーとの定例会議が中心で、主に業務進捗の報告を受けます。
困ったときは先輩やチームに相談しながら進められます。

About the team
メンバーは多くの場合、1 FCあたり1〜2名が配属されています。少人数だからこそ幅広い業務を経験でき、成長のスピードが速い環境です。
全国各地のメンバーが一斉に集まる定例オンライン会議が毎週あり、成功事例の共有や困りごとの相談ができます。

title: Customer Solutions Manager, Retail CPG
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, focusing on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers — whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

The Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) at Amazon Web Services (AWS) is responsible for guiding a strategic customer through their multi-year cloud journey, ensuring effective collaboration across AWS teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. This role focuses on understanding industry-specific needs and driving digital transformation, orchestrating the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS Cloud journey.

In this role you will be a critical partner to the account team, owning the execution layer of the engagement to accelerate the customer's outcomes and multiply the impact of Sales and Solutions Architecture. You will drive the follow-up actions that turn strategy into delivered outcomes: planning and running executive engagements, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, tracking progress, and ensuring the customer consistently realizes value from AWS.

You will interface with customer stakeholders and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the core account groups (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, partners, and customer teams. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from the customer's key milestones. Executive meetings, roadmap-to-business-outcome alignment, quarterly and monthly business reviews, and enablement programs are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of the customer's cloud and AI journey.

Successful candidates will have a strong delivery and change-management background, be detail-oriented, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators at both the executive and project-team level. You will be a peer leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in. You will evangelize AWS services, be passionate about delivering a great customer experience, and be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of your customer's successful adoption of AWS.

Key job responsibilities
Own executive & customer engagement planning — plan and run executive meetings and customer visits with inputs and direction from the account team.
Own recurring business reviews — put together the monthly/quarterly business review for the customer, gathering inputs from all account and extended team members, and own the meeting itself.
Drive customer maturity & innovation programs — run activities such as Culture of Innovation, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), and Cloud Maturity Model assessments, sustaining momentum through continuous effort.
Run cross-functional cadences & track execution — run weekly workstream meetings that bring in people beyond the account team, and track progress and actions in shared trackers so nothing slips.
Own stakeholder relationships where it adds value — hold specific customer stakeholder relationships (e.g., a platform or line-of-business team), positioning AWS as the right platform and driving the associated initiatives.
Support the customer's AI journey — help plan and shepherd the customer's AI adoption from planning through demos/POCs to production, including driving active usage of relevant AI tools.
Coordinate migrations and enablement as the engagement requires — while large-scale migration ownership (on-prem/other-cloud to AWS) and hands-on enablement delivery are not the primary focus of every engagement, the CSM owns or coordinates these where an account calls for it, including partnering with the AWS Training & Certification team to plan and run enablement.

A day in the life
As a part of the customer focused team your daily routine will swing from tactical tasks like driving team meetings, overseeing in-delivery initiatives to strategic activites like planning and driving business reviews, executive engagements. Through your interactions with the customer you will also open up new engagement avenues through motions like Cloud Adoption Framework, AI maturity assessment, etc. which help the customer accelerate their cloud and AI journey.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
- 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
- Experience in a direct or matrixed role leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- cloud certification like AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect - Associate
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
- Experience in retail / CPG or a comparable industry, and comfort operating in a multicultural, cross-geography account team

title: Infra Delivery Install Technician, Data Center Communities
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).


NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed

- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- High School diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)

title: Sr Software Engineer – DevOps, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, an Amazon company, is building Physical AI by deploying autonomous robots for real-world doorstep delivery. Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software to hardware, RIVR is purpose-built for safety, reliability, and the customer from day one.

We are looking for a mid-level DevOps Engineer to join our team. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliable and efficient development and deployment of our robotics software. You will focus on building and maintaining the infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines that enable our engineering teams to rapidly and safely iterate on software for our physical robots.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for robotics software deployment, including further developing and managing observability and telemetry pipelines.

Work closely with software and robotics engineers to automate infrastructure and streamline workflows.

Implement best practices for code security, versioning, and reproducibility.

Manage and maintain our development environments, including containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes).

Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues.

Contribute to documentation and guidelines to enhance knowledge sharing across the team.

title: Transportation Specialist in Carrier Performance, ATS - Middle Mile Execution
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Transport Specialist to own the end-to-end monthly Carrier Performance cycle. In this role, you will be responsible for generating carrier performance metrics, distributing performance reports to carrier partners, analyzing and resolving disputes raised by carriers, and closing the monthly performance with consolidated, accurate results. You will work closely with carriers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure transparency and accountability in performance management.

Key job responsibilities
Performance Data Generation:
1) Extract, consolidate, and validate carrier performance indicators (OTA, OTP, cancellations, incidents) from internal systems, dashboards, and databases.
2) Ensure data accuracy and integrity before distribution, performing quality checks and reconciliations on a regular basis.
3) Maintain and improve data extraction processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency gains.
4) Prepare and distribute periodic performance reports to each carrier partner, ensuring clarity, consistency, and timeliness.
5) Communicate performance results in a structured and professional manner, highlighting key metrics, trends, and areas requiring attention.
6) Serve as the primary point of contact for carriers regarding performance data and report inquiries.
7) Receive and analyze disputes and contestations raised by carriers regarding reported performance indicators.
8) Track dispute trends and identify systemic data quality issues or process gaps.
9) Consolidate final performance results after dispute resolution, producing the official monthly carrier performance report.
10) Present monthly performance summaries to leadership, highlighting key outcomes, dispute volumes, and carrier trends.
11) Contribute to the evolution of performance measurement tools, templates, and processes.
12) Benchmark performance cycles against best practices and propose enhancements to improve cycle time and data quality.


A day in the life
1) Monitor data feeds and dashboards to ensure carrier performance indicators are being captured correctly.
2) Manage the dispute inbox: review new carrier contestations, prioritize pending analyses, and follow up on open cases.
3) Respond to carrier inquiries regarding performance reports, metrics clarification, and dispute status updates.
4) Maintain and update report templates, data extraction queries, and dispute tracking tools.
5) Attend alignment meetings with the Carrier Management and Operations teams.
6) Identify improvement opportunities and propose process or tooling enhancements.


About the team
The Carrier Performance team sits within Middle Mile Execution at Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) Brazil. Our mission is to ensure full visibility and accountability over carrier performance across the Brazilian middle-mile network. We drive data-driven conversations with carrier partners, set clear expectations through structured performance cycles, and enable the broader Carrier Management organization to make informed decisions on tiering, scorecards, and continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS)

title: Embedded Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

You will design, craft, and deploy reliable embedded software for large quantity of consumer electronic products. Amazon LEO is breaking new ground with every device we design, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices within the Amazon LEO system.
· Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
· Developing embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
· Have experience with real-time embedded software philosophies and practices
· Have expertise with Linux and/or RTOS
· Review schematics, logic analyzer, and embedded software trouble-shooting techniques.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
As part of our Amazon LEO Customer Terminal Software Team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Amazon LEO products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment. You need to be flexible and responsive to changing priority issues.

About the team
The Amazon LEO Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Amazon LEO network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to build cloud services that keep the fleet humming. In this role, you will build the cloud foundation and applications that connect robots to customer experiences and internal operations as we scale.

The ideal candidate has built distributed systems that connect physical devices to cloud services end to end. They are comfortable building and operating the services they own from prototyping through launch and beyond. They make sound architectural tradeoffs across privacy, security, reliability, delivery speed, and cost when requirements are still evolving. They work effectively across robotics, product, and operations teams while remaining hands-on in design and implementation.

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We're changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We're building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you'll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It's an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
