title: Automation Process Engineer, Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services' Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world's premier cloud computing platform. The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team designs, validates, and deploys automation solutions, including robotics, cobots, vision inspection, AI-powered quality systems, and automated assembly workflows, across contract manufacturer sites worldwide.

About the Role: You will own end-to-end automation process engineering for the Graviton platform family. This includes defining automated assembly sequences, specifying robotic cell requirements, developing process validation protocols, and driving automation deployment at contract manufacturer sites for this platform. You serve as the single-threaded owner for all automation decisions affecting Graviton production, working with central engineering specialists (robotics, vision, controls, mechanical) to apply their capabilities to your platform's unique requirements. You translate platform-specific product design characteristics into automation process specifications. You work closely with the Product Design vertical (Hardware Engineering) to manage automation requirements, participate in design reviews, and provide feedback on assembly compatibility for the Graviton platform. You serve as the point of contact for automation during New Product Introduction (NPI), supporting the product design team in transitioning new Graviton designs from prototype to production-ready automated assembly, ensuring automation readiness is built into the NPI process from the earliest stages. You also partner with the Manufacturing Process Quality vertical to define quality verification requirements, validate process capability, and ensure automation solutions meet quality targets before production sign-off.

The scope covers all server and rack assembly across all architectures and platforms, including compute, AI/ML accelerators, storage, and networking. The team designs intelligent, predictive-analytics-driven production systems where every station is sensor-driven, AI-optimized, and self-correcting, turning assembly lines into programmable, data-generating platforms that scale capacity without scaling headcount. This role requires the engineer to operate in a fast-paced, multi-platform international manufacturing environment with travel to contract manufacturer sites (up to 25-30% travel anticipated).


Key job responsibilities
• Own automation process specifications for Graviton platform assembly operations
• Define automated assembly sequences and station allocations for platform-specific operations
• Develop and execute process validation protocols for automated stations on Graviton lines
• Drive automation deployment and ramp at contract manufacturer sites for the Graviton platform
• Identify automation opportunities specific to Graviton architecture and drive business case development
• Coordinate with central engineering specialists to apply robotic, vision, and controls solutions to platform needs
• Own platform-specific automation KPIs: throughput, quality yield, automation rate, and cycle time targets
• Partner with Hardware Engineering to influence product design for automated assembly compatibility
• Collaborate with Manufacturing Process Quality to define quality verification requirements and validate process capability for automated stations
• Serve as the automation point of contact during NPI, supporting product design teams in transitioning new Graviton designs to production-ready automated assembly
• Partner with Hardware Engineering (Product Design vertical) to manage automation requirements and participate in design reviews for new Graviton configurations


About the team
About the team: The Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering team is building a centralized automation Center of Excellence that owns the process specification and IP for how AWS hardware gets assembled. The team is responsible for engineering, defining automated process requirements, designing and proving solutions at proof-of-concept, and maintaining AWS-owned intellectual property that scales globally. The team works within a collaborative framework across Hardware Engineering (product design for automation), Manufacturing Automation Design & Engineering (process specification and validation), and Manufacturing Operations (deployment and scaling), ensuring automation is engineered once, proven once, and deployed everywhere.

Basic qualifications

- BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent
- 7+ years in manufacturing process engineering with experience in automated assembly environments
- Experience developing process specifications for electronic or precision hardware assembly
- Experience with process validation methodologies (e.g., PFMEA, capability studies, DOE)
- Track record of deploying automation solutions in production environments
- Experience with multi-site manufacturing (deploying standard processes across geographies)
- Experience driving automation readiness during NPI from concept through production ramp
- Experience leading design reviews and providing DFM/DFA feedback to product engineering teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with custom silicon, ARM-based, or server processor hardware assembly
- Knowledge of robotic assembly systems and collaborative robots
- Experience with design-for-automated-assembly (DFAA) principles
- Electronics, server, or data center hardware manufacturing environment
- Process optimization and cycle time reduction experience
- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)
- Cross-functional leadership with product design, quality, and operations teams
- Experience serving as automation or manufacturing engineering lead during new product introduction cycles

title: Category Manager, Construction Category, Global Procurement Organization
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to shape the future of Amazon's construction procurement landscape in Europe? Amazon's Global Procurement Organization (GPO) is seeking a Category Manager to lead strategic construction procurement activities across our diverse portfolio of multi-million-dollar real estate projects.

As a key member of our Construction Category Procurement Pillar, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on Amazon's growth and innovation in Europe. The ideal candidate will bring deep understanding of construction trades including civil and architectural works, interior fit-out, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) systems, and fire protection.

We're looking for a dynamic leader who thrives in our fast-paced, results-driven environment. This role offers unique opportunities to influence major construction projects, drive sustainable procurement practices, and collaborate with world-class professionals across Europe. If you're a self-starter who excels in complex, challenging environments and has a passion for construction procurement, this role could be your next career milestone.

This role offers exceptional visibility with senior leadership and the chance to make lasting improvements to Amazon's construction procurement ecosystem. Your success will directly contribute to Amazon's ambitious growth plans, competitiveness and environmental commitments across Europe.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute construction category sourcing strategies across different supply chain tiers (General Contractors, Subcontractors, Suppliers, OEMs) and trades (including civil, architectural, MEP, fire protection, and fit-out) across Europe
- Take responsibility for increasing Amazon's competitiveness and maintain continuity of supply and mitigate risks across geographical and business unit boundaries, defining opportunities to suit the particular needs of Amazon business
- Focus on deep diving construction categories and regions to add value to the overall procurement process by identifying synergies, benchmarking, innovation, eliminating waste and identifying economies of scale, thus increasing our competitive advantage
- Drive cost optimization through negotiation, standardization, value engineering, and supply chain improvements
- Build effective internal and external relationships with colleagues, suppliers and partners that enables effective collaborative working and a positive and productive working environment own strategic supplier relationships
- Negotiate, execute and manage framework agreements
- Support sustainability initiatives aligned with Amazon's Climate Pledge
- Provide market intelligence and strategic insights to key stakeholders and procurement leadership to inform decision making
- Own the individual targets and goals identified across the construction category scope as well as identifying and delivering incremental value and process improvements
- Innovate within the procurement space, automating and improving tools and processes to better support the Procurement Life-cycle


A day in the life
- Lead procurement processes including prequalification, onboarding, tender management, evaluations, contract negotiations and award recommendations, delivering to tight timescales, being technically and commercially accurate and to manage several schemes simultaneously
- Apply technical knowledge of construction trades to assess supplier capabilities, evaluate proposals, and drive value engineering initiatives
- Drive procurement of innovative, sustainable, and cost-effective construction services to help our Operations teams succeed and delight Amazon.com customers with speed, selection and convenience
- Collaborate with technical teams to optimize specifications across various construction disciplines
- Serve as the key interface between project delivery and any internal central core team from Design and Construction, Real Estate and Legal partners and the senior leadership of external supply chain (General Contractors, Subcontractors, Suppliers, OEMs)
- Support supplier performance management together with Design and Construction partners
- Provide insight and knowledge of the construction industry and supply chain and in turn develop procurement strategies to support/inform strategic decision making
- Prepare high quality white papers and anticipate objections to proposed procurement approach and gain buy-in from decision makers, including managing differing perspectives to a recommended position. Influence decision-making at senior leadership levels
- Adapt and sometimes take different roles from strategy development to project management to rapidly meet customer needs

About the team
You'll join a growing team where your strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and leadership skills will be paramount. Working in an environment that encourages autonomy and creative problem-solving, you'll partner closely with Design and Construction, Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams to shape and execute innovative category strategies.

Your expertise will be crucial in delivering measurable value creation, driving sustainability initiatives, and establishing best-in-class procurement practices across our European operations.

- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in procurement and purchasing, including supplier relationship management
- Experience in construction or project management, or experience in electrical or mechanical engineering
- Experience in contracts management
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience identifying, mitigating, and managing business risks and tradeoffs
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience with high-level negotiation and successful internal and external relationship management
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)

title: Security Expert (Sicherheit und Schadensverhütung), Security & Loss Prevention
locations: Giengen an der Brenz, BW, Germany
descriptionHtml:
Unser Betriebsnetzwerk, das für seine Schnelligkeit, Genauigkeit und seinen außergewöhnlichen Service bekannt ist, liefert täglich Millionen von Pakete und ein Lächeln an Amazon-Kunden. Um die Sicherheit unseres Betriebsnetzwerks zu gewährleisten und die Betriebskontinuität zu gewährleisten, suchen wir proaktive und lösungsorientierte Fachkräfte, die sich unserem Team als Loss Prevention Manager:in anschließen möchten. In dieser Schlüsselrolle liefern Sie Sicherheit als Service für unsere Betriebsstandorte entlang der gesamten Lieferkette, um unsere Mitarbeitenden zu schützen und Verluste zu verhindern.

Key job responsibilities
• Unterstützen Sie die Widerstandsfähigkeit unseres Geschäftsbetriebs, indem Sie zur Notfall- und Krisenplanung für Standorte in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich beitragen
• Tragen Sie zur Identifizierung von Schwachstellen bei (z. B. Verlust, Mitarbeitererfahrung, Prozessverbesserung) und definieren Sie geeignete Abhilfemaßnahmen, während Sie gleichzeitig die Einhaltung rechtlicher und ethischer Standards sicherstellen
• Als Ansprechpartner fungieren und Maßnahmen zum Risikomanagement mit dem lokalen Management und externen Parteien (z. B. Strafverfolgungsbehörden und Branchenverbänden) in allen sicherheitsrelevanten Angelegenheiten koordinieren
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ihnen zugewiesenen Standorte den globalen Sicherheitsstandards von Amazon entsprechen
• Eigene Projekte im Zusammenhang mit Sicherheit und Schadensverhütung auf lokaler, regionaler und Landesebene

A day in the life
Als Security & Loss Prevention Expert:in werden Sie Teil eines Teams von Sicherheits- und Verlustpräventionsexperten, die Geschäftskunden in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen in einem bestimmten geografischen Gebiet Sicherheit als Service anbieten. Sie führen regelmäßig physische Sicherheitsaudits durch und ermitteln Richtlinienverstöße, sicherheitsrelevante Vorfälle und Verlustereignisse.

Während Ihrer Ermittlungen sammeln Sie Informationen, indem Sie Systeme und Tools überwachen, Datenberichte analysieren und Befragungen durchführen. Ihre Erkenntnisse tragen dazu bei, Schwachstellen in unseren Prozessen zu identifizieren und Sie treiben Abhilfemaßnahmen voran. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der physischen Integrität unserer Standorte, indem Sie den Funktionalitätszustand unserer Systeme prüfen und überwachen und gemeinsam mit Fachexperten und externen Lieferanten deren Funktionalität aufrechterhalten.

Darüber hinaus identifizieren und ergreifen Sie Initiativen zur Verbesserung unserer physischen Sicherheitsinfrastruktur und tragen direkt zur Budgetplanung unserer externen Lieferanten bei. Sie interagieren täglich mit unseren externen Sicherheitsdienstleistern, um die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Sicherheitsdienste und ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis sicherzustellen.

Schließlich führen Sie Schulungs- und Sensibilisierungsprogramme zur Schadensverhütung für andere Teams auf allen Managementebenen durch und leiten die Umsetzung unseres Sicherheits- und Schadensverhütungsplans.



About the team
Als Teil der Worldwide Operations Security-Organisation (WWOS) unterstützt Security and Loss Prevention die Erreichung der Geschäftsziele von Amazon und die Stärkung unserer Marke durch wirksamen Schutz vor relevanten Bedrohungen und durch das Management von Sicherheits- und Verlustpräventionsrisiken, die Folgendes könnten:

1. Gefährdung unserer Mitarbeitenden und Kunden
2. Die Kontinuität unseres Geschäftsbetriebs stören
3. Unseren Vermögenswerten Schaden zufügen
4. Einen negativen Einfluss auf den Ruf unserer Marke haben

In Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Stakeholdern sichern wir die Amazon-Lieferkette durchgängig und fördern die Sicherheit bei geschäftlichen Entscheidungsgesprächen.

Wir tun dies, indem wir sicherheits- und verlustverhütungsbezogene Risiken und Schwachstellen so früh wie möglich verhindern, in sich abzeichnende Vorfälle eingreifen, um negative Auswirkungen zu minimieren, sowie sicherheitsrelevante Vorfälle gründlich untersuchen, um die Grundursachen zu identifizieren und zu beseitigen und so ein erneutes Auftreten zu verhindern .

- Relevante sicherheits- oder risikobezogene Erfahrung (z. B. Sicherheitsdienste, physische Sicherheit, Schadensverhütung, Risikomanagement, Bestandsverwaltung, Ermittlungen, Lieferkette, Auditierung, Compliance oder Ähnliches)
- Einschlägige Erfahrung im Umgang mit der MS-Office-Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in einem professionellen Umfeld
- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end-to-end back-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record-to-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today.

The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS as a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi-tenancy, data isolation, multi-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it.

descriptionHtml:
This position requires in-role training at an operating site which will be 2+ weeks in duration. This training will be located 50+ miles away from the home site location. All travel accommodations for training will be booked and paid for by Amazon.

Please note: this role requires open flexibility to work 10 hour overnight shifts (late afternoon to early morning hours) and will be scheduled on a front-half (Sunday – Wednesday) or back-half (Wednesday – Saturday) schedule. Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.


ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

title: Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon develops innovative consumer-centric product solutions. As a reliability engineer you will be part of an exciting team developing, testing, and delivering products. Your primary responsibility will be the development and implementation of methodologies/techniques to enhance product reliability. You will work closely internal cross-functional teams and outside partners to drive and execute product qualification. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.

The reliability engineer will be responsible for:

- Create reliability test plans including resource allocations, validation schedule assumptions, and validation items scope.
- Manage the local supplier team on reliability resource planning, test execution, failure analysis, and track the issues from creation to closure.
- Implement specific validation items in reliability test plans with schedule. Flexible adjustment should be made based on issue occurring and debugging.
- Lead and drive on DFMEA, debugging, failure analysis, DOEs and fixing issues discovered during testing.
- Evaluate and develop reliability test methodologies to reduce test time and increase test coverage.
- Evaluate reliability risks, perform risk assessment and do escalations to management team.
- Travel extensively in Vietnam and Asia to support reliability activities.
- Travel to US for team collaboration or training.

Key job responsibilities
- As a Reliability Engineer (RE) for critical components, the primary responsibility will be the development and implementation of methodologies/techniques to enhance product reliability and manage reliability activities.
- The RE will lead reliability engineering and operations activities throughout the program's execution phase, accountable for managing new component programs from PR/FAQ through to sustaining, across the company's development.
- The RE will work closely with internal cross-functional teams and outside partners to drive and execute product qualification and failure analysis.
- The RE will drive the configuration management deliverables to ensure the timely release of all device components and assemblies to production.
- The RE will also assist Rel Test Engineer in enhancing suppliers' local infrastructure and capability, including lab construction, testing and FA capability, and assist with cross functional team activities to ensure the right level of engagement from reliability.
- The RE needs to have strong logical capabilities to summarize failures, solid statistical knowledge to perform risk assessments, and good judgment to provide team recommendations during failure escalations.
- The RE needs to be capable of technical dive deep in the engineering scopes such as display, optic, camera, PD, EE, SoC, etc.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, material engineering, mechanical engineering or related fields
- 5+ years of engineering experience
- Experience using analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify root causes of technical problems
- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities
- Good understanding of the principles and basic structures of measuring instruments such as HALT, chambers, oscilloscopes, multimeters etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 7+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- Experience with risk adjustment coding, or experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems
- Experience in consumer electronics or technology sector
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations, or experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing environments
- Master's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

title: Creative Assistant, Documentaries, Documentary Series and Film
descriptionHtml:
Are you a resourceful, detail-oriented professional who thrives on keeping creative teams running smoothly? As a Creative Assistant on the Documentaries team at Amazon, you will play a key role in enabling producers, directors, and cross-functional partners to focus on what they do best — telling compelling stories. You will manage schedules, coordinate logistics, and keep day-to-day operations on track so that projects move forward without a hitch. If you are an organized self-starter who enjoys juggling multiple priorities and working alongside creative talent, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage complex calendars and scheduling across multiple stakeholders, applying an understanding of shifting priorities to ensure the best use of everyone's time.
- Plan, organize, and execute team events and meetings, coordinating logistics, managing budgets, and communicating with internal and external partners.
- Create and process expense reports and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with applicable guidelines and policies.
- Build and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, and process improvements that increase team efficiency and drive consistent results.
- Coordinate domestic and international travel itineraries, track key deliverables to completion, and follow up on outstanding action items.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing the day's schedule, confirming meetings, and flagging any conflicts before they become problems. Throughout the day you will toggle between coordinating travel plans, preparing expense reports, greeting visitors, and keeping project trackers up to date. You will regularly connect with producers, production coordinators, and external vendors to ensure everyone has what they need to stay on track.

title: Sr Mechanical Engineer, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, prototyping, testing, and scaling the mechanical systems for our robotic systems. This role requires a strong background in mechanism design and mechatronics, coupled with the ability to bring products from concept to production.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop prototypes and refine designs for robotic mechanisms and subsystems
- Create and optimize precision mechanical systems, including linkages, joints, and actuation systems

- Collaborate with electrical and software engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and control systems
- Partner with in-house designers to meet product aesthetic and cosmetic requirements
- Design parts for machining, casting, 3D printing, and other manufacturing processes
- Work with suppliers and manufacturers worldwide to source components, manage production timelines, and maintain quality standards

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 10+ years of working in mechanical engineering background
- Experience with CAD software (Solidworks, Onshape, NX, Catia, etc)
- Strong knowledge of prototyping and mechanism design
- Proficiency in designing machined, cast, and 3D-printed parts
- Experience with mechatronics, including sensors, actuators, and motion control systems
- Understanding of manufacturing processes and working with a global supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Previous experience in robotics or control systems
- Knowledge of finite element analysis (FEA) and simulation tools for stress, thermal, and dynamic analysis

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Sr. Technical Product Manager creates and drives the next generation of medium voltage (MV) products, including Medium Voltage Switchgear (MVS) and Medium Voltage Transformers (MVT), from concept to at-scale global deployment. This role provides a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power distribution infrastructure and hyper-scale data center growth. The Sr. PM-T applies their expertise to:

- Design, develop, launch, and support MV switchgear and transformer products critical to data center electrical infrastructure
- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) efforts for MVS and MVT programs, coordinating design validation, prototype builds, testing, and production readiness milestones
- Drive supplier qualification activities, evaluating and onboarding MV equipment suppliers to meet AWS quality, reliability, and capacity requirements
- Identify and execute cost reduction initiatives across the MV product portfolio while maintaining or improving product performance and reliability
- Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to capture critical medium voltage power distribution needs for current operations, rack roadmaps, and new data center designs
- Utilize those insights to define product requirements, create a product vision, and own the product development roadmap for MVS and MVT programs
- Coordinate between multiple teams to develop business cases that substantiate value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
- Drive continuous advancements within MV electrical designs and communicate technical direction to Sr. Management
- Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide-scale deployment to eventual deprecation
- Work independently in a high-pressure environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

This role works closely with a cross-functional team of Product Design Engineers (PDEs), Product Lifecycle Engineers (PLEs), Structural Engineers, and Technical Program Managers (TPMs). The PM-T partners with PDEs on new product development, collaborates with PLEs on customer engagement and lessons learned, and coordinates with TPMs on first-of-a-kind deployments. The ability to lead across these disciplines without direct authority is critical to success.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in data center technology. We will rely on the Sr. PM-T's ability to understand customer needs and build them into the overall product design and strategy. The ideal candidate:

- Is passionate about understanding customers' needs and translating them into MV product requirements
- Has passion for product development, electrical infrastructure design, and medium voltage power distribution equipment
- Is great at solving problems across technical and commercial domains
- Has the ability to lead multiple products and projects at different stages while staying organized
- Earns trust and builds relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Product Development, Finance, Operations, Suppliers)
- Is comfortable addressing and resolving ambiguity
- Recognizes and appreciates diversity of thought and perspectives

Each day the Sr. PM-T will interact with different teams responsible for engineering, product development, finance, integration, and operation of these complex MV technology programs. They prioritize their activities to support data center product development, identify and resolve problems and blockers, and focus on the actions that are most impactful for product success.

This role requires travel of 30%+ to manufacturing facilities, AWS engineering hubs, data center sites, and supplier locations to drive NPI, supplier qualification, and at-scale deployment.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale size, this job is for you!

descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

For over 15 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet.
In 2019, Amazon announced The Climate Pledge, which includes our commitment to power our operations with 100% renewable energy by 2025, on the path to achieving net zero carbon across our businesses by 2040. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com and https://sustainability.aboutamazon.com/environment/the-cloud.

The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. The Environmental team has responsibility for developing and implementing AWS’s global environmental programs.

We are seeking an Environmental Engineer to support AWS environmental compliance in Tokyo, Japan. The environmental engineer will ensure standards and policies support regulatory compliance, and they will provide appropriate environmental guidance to regional operations teams. The individual will support environmental performance analysis, reporting, monitor metrics, support due diligence processes and guide the operations teams in implementation of Amazon environmental procedures. The environmental engineer will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

The Environmental Engineer must have excellent communication skills, local language skills, strong environmental regulatory knowledge, demonstrated success in supporting roles for program development and management of complex and technical projects.



Key job responsibilities
Assess and support compliance with national and local environmental regulations, contractual obligations, and internal Amazon policies.

Support the growth of the business through environmental due diligence reviews and permitting support.

Play a key role in regional environmental programs by integrating with engineering, construction, and operations - drive an environmentally responsible culture within the organization.

Support the maintenance of and compliance with implemented Environmental Management Systems (EMS).

Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with Amazon standards.

Develop, analyze, and forecast environmental metrics, horizon scan for risk and effectively communicate insights to internal stakeholders
Support environmental audits to drive continuous improvement.

Build collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.

Submit time critical environmental reports to various governmental agencies.

Complete thorough environmental investigations and associated regulatory report including working with operations and necessary stakeholders to develop and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. title: Software Development Manager, SageMaker Training
descriptionHtml:
Interested in building the distributed systems that let customers customize foundation models at scale? The SageMaker Training and Model Customization team builds the services customers use to fine-tune and post-train models against their own accuracy, reliability, and cost targets. We are hiring a Software Development Manager to lead the team that owns those capabilities.

Model customization is the fastest-moving layer of the machine learning stack. Post-training has moved from supervised fine-tuning to reinforcement learning against verifiable rewards, and from single-turn tasks to agentic training where a model learns by acting in an environment over long trajectories. Each shift changes the shape of the workload. Reinforcement learning puts an inference engine inside the training loop. Agentic training adds environments and tool calls, and moves the bottleneck from one run to the next. Your team turns each new technique into a capability customers can use, without rebuilding the platform every time the research moves.

Underneath the techniques, this stays a hard distributed systems problem. Training jobs run across large accelerator fleets for days at a time, and a single node failure can stall the job. The team works in PyTorch and across frameworks including Verl, FSDP, Megatron and vLLM, and contributes upstream to the open source projects the platform depends on.

As the manager you own the team and its charter. You will hire and grow engineers, set technical direction with your senior engineers and product managers, and decide what the team does and does not build. You own the roadmap and defend its tradeoffs with leadership. You own the service in production, including on-call health, operational metrics, and the requests that come with sitting in the critical path of customer training workloads.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the team's charter and roadmap, and defend its tradeoffs with senior leadership.
- Hire, develop and retain engineers in a specialized field with a scarce talent pool.
- Set technical direction with your senior engineers, applied scientists and product managers.
- Decide what the team builds, and what it does not.
- Turn new post-training techniques into supported customer capabilities on a predictable schedule.
- Own the service in production, including on-call health, availability and operational metrics.
- Improve training throughput and cost per run across large accelerator fleets.

A day in the life
Your morning starts in a design review. The team is working out how to keep an inference engine and a training engine in the same loop for reinforcement learning without leaving accelerators idle, and the answer will shape the future of the platform. You deep dive into possible scenarios, because at this scale a node dies routinely and recovery has to be normal rather than exceptional.

Then a charter call. A new post-training technique is three months out of the research literature and two customers are already asking for it. With your senior engineers and product manager you decide whether it becomes a first-class capability, a recipe on top of what you already have, or a no. That decision is yours to make, and the industry does not wait for it.

You spend an hour in 1:1s, including a career conversation with an engineer who wants to own the parallelism work. After lunch you sit a hiring debrief and make the call. Later you meet the applied scientists to understand what they have validated, and you argue about sequencing.

You close the day writing a page for leadership: what you are not building this half, and why that is the right trade.

About the team
We build the managed services customers use to customize foundation models. A customer brings a task, a dataset, and a way to score a good answer. Our services run the post-training loop on their behalf. We own that entire path, from the customer-facing API down to the training session infrastructure and the accelerator fleet it runs on.

That makes this a foundational charter. title: Regional Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection Team
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are committed to and invested in the natural environment because it is good for business, the planet, our customers, and our communities. The Middle East, Africa & Turkey (MEATR) Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) Field team capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed and ability to invent and simplify to create a better and more resilient company. We manage our environmental impacts, uphold company standards and expectations, and seek to continuously improve the tools and processes that we use in doing so.

The MEATR team is seeking an experienced Environmental Professional to join the team and lead the environmental compliance aspects of Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business line and third-party (3P) logistics facilities across the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Saudi Arabia (KSA), Egypt, South Africa and Turkey. These are small-format urban facilities. This role will own the environmental program across environmental media (air, stormwater and wastewater, waste, etc.) and management programs (such as Spill Response, Regulatory Interactions) and roll them out in partnership with the Operations team and support functions who execute at site level. Country Environmental Managers will provide guidance on country-specific regulatory requirements.

This role will provide strategic direction supporting the Operations team and EAP field customers to ensure that designed programs and trainings are implemented and meet each stakeholder group's needs. This role will also work with consultants and technical teams to resolve regulated environmental program barriers and provide guidance, and will support the MEATR Environmental Leader in environmental data management and business reporting for this business line to meet Amazon's high bar.

The ideal candidate must possess proficiency in environmental programs and regulations and demonstrate this expertise when partnering with teams. The successful candidate must be able to work successfully in a fast-paced environment, have a results-oriented approach, strong analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, and experience in implementing processes and procedures across multiple regions, sites or businesses.

This position will directly report to the MEATR Environmental Leader.

Key job responsibilities
Support business line and country-specific environmental compliance programs and procedures for small-format urban facilities, including waste segregation and storage standards, hazardous waste management, spill response, etc., and ensure compliance.

Ensure the environmental requirements are embedded in third-party (3P) logistics contracts and service agreements, covering inventory waste handling and storage, licensed disposal vendors for inventory waste, manifest retention, audit rights, and related obligations.

Work with internal stakeholders, such as Operations (including ACES), Workplace Health & Safety (WHS), Facilities, Legal, Dangerous Goods, Engineering, Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME), Procurement, Learning and Development, Real Estate and GES team for new buildings, to identify and remove barriers for successful environmental program development, deployment and process improvements, and to secure senior-level commitment to environmental requirements for this business line.

Assess and identify applicable environmental operating permits, licenses, classifications and recurring municipal reporting obligations across all five countries, maintain them in the environmental compliance platform, and drive renewal actions with the Operations team.

Conduct site assessments and environmental inspections across the portfolio to verify program adoption, identify compliance gaps, and record findings and corrective actions in the environmental compliance platform.

Roll out the program across the portfolio working with the Operations team, defining the standard, sequence, training and completion criteria, and verifying adoption.

Release network alerts to stakeholders on new developments, requirements, and updates around the programs.

Deploy and review environmental performance against applicable key performance indicators with their owners.

Support the Operations team during regulatory interactions and agency inspections at QC sites.

Support and lead the preparation and finalization of environmental business review reports for the business line.

Identify large-scale opportunities and partner with the program team to develop, integrate and implement standardized programs that maintain compliance while reducing the burden on Amazon's resources.

Supervise consultants and third-party environmental service providers hired to deliver specific products and services under the EAP scope for QC and 3PL.

- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 6+ years of experience serving as an environment manager, program specialist, or program manager.
- Experience developing and managing environmental programs for air, waste, and water.
- Experience rolling out a compliance program across a multi-site portfolio and working with multiple stakeholders
- Experience managing environmental permits and licenses, including application, renewal and regulatory inspection response.

title: EMEA Payroll Compliance Manager, Global Payroll Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for an experienced Payroll Compliance Manager to join our EMEA Payroll Compliance team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring payroll compliance across EMEA countries. You will proactively identify and mitigate payroll compliance risks, and lead responses to regulatory inspections and audits. You will also work with Payroll Tech stakeholders to build scalable process improvements and transformation mechanisms that raise the compliance bar and protect Amazon's employees and the business.

This role offers a unique blend of regulatory depth, cross-border complexity, and technology-driven innovation — ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex compliance challenges at scale. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of payroll operations, human resource, benefits and employment tax and legal. You will work across countries, and across functions to ensure that every employee is paid accurately and in full compliance with local laws.


Key job responsibilities
• Proactively monitor payroll compliance and regulatory updates at a regional level, communicate their impact on business and payroll operations and update policies accordingly.
• Lead proactive compliance assessments across EMEA payroll operations, identifying risks in Social Security contributions, tax withholding, and statutory reporting before they become regulatory findings.
• Design and implement EMEA-wide payroll compliance assessment frameworks with country-specific depth and regional consistency.
• Manage responses to labor inspections, Social Security audits, and tax authority inquiries, coordinating with Legal, Payroll Operations, and external advisors.
• Monitor legislative changes, court rulings, and regulatory guidance across assigned markets and translate them into country-specific operational guidance, process updates, system and control improvements — ensuring payroll calculation accuracy and compliance with applicable laws, policies, and collective bargaining agreements.
• Partner with payroll vendors to validate system configurations, establish compliance checkpoints, and drive remediation of identified gaps.
• Work with Product and Tech teams for automation initiatives and implement compliance control mechanisms that work across countries, legal entities, and payroll platforms
• Partner with HR, Benefits, Legal, Employment Tax, Payroll Technology, and Product teams to develop and enhance existing payroll systems to meet payroll compliance requirements.
• Produce clear, concise compliance risk assessments and present findings and recommendations to senior leadership.


A day in the life
Your primary focus will be ensuring payroll compliance across Western European countries, developing payroll risk control frameworks, payroll blueprints, and compliance rulebooks for mitigating risks, while assisting colleagues across the wider EMEA region. You will respond to stakeholders and/or employee requests on compliance questions, partner with tech colleagues to build AI solutions for risk assessments, and ensure payroll accuracy and compliance. You will join Payroll Product design PODs, where you share compliance requirements, develop self-service mechanisms using AI agents for compliance monitoring, bring new ideas, and learn new opportunities to improve payroll processes and controls.

About the team
The Global Payroll Compliance team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, with highest controllership and compliance with all regulatory requirements.
You will have opportunities to expand your technical depth, explore new technologies, and contribute ideas that shape the direction of our payroll platform. If you are looking for a team where your work is visible and your development is a priority, this is the place for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources Management or related field.
- Payroll qualifications (e.g. CIPP).
- A minimum of 5 years extensive hands on experience in EMEA payroll and tax related compliance.
- Experience undertaking internal risk reviews covering payroll compliance is essential.
- Proven expertise in payroll compliance and administration, with a strong background in employment tax consulting.
- Experience in leading payroll tax audits and resolving complex tax issues.
- Proven ability to build frameworks and documentation from scratch in ambiguous or evolving environments.
- Strong knowledge of EMEA payroll engines.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Finance/Tax (MBA or related discipline)
- Exposure to payroll system transformations and/or tax compliance audits.
- Experience working in a government (state or federal) payroll tax or regulatory environment.
- Experience with end-to-end project management, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
- Experience building and scaling knowledge management systems (wikis, runbooks, shared repositories).
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager , Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our Strategic Accounts organization. In this new, highly visible role, you will be responsible for helping guide AWS customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud, ensuring that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.
Our team is committed to helping large industry-leading enterprise customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of agentic AI and cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.
You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale agentic AI and cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.
You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations and modernizations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and technical customer engagements are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.
You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.
Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, familiar with agentic AI/GenAI, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem-solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. You will be a peer leader, have the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, negotiate and lead virtual teams. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.
You will evangelize AWS services and influence customers for adopting them. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by deploying AWS solutions and driving innovation, and also be obsessed with contributing to the day-to-day management of customers’ successful adoption of AWS.


Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solutions Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

1/Accelerating AWS Adoption through Delivery and Execution
2/Identify & Align on Strategic Opportunities: CSMs work with the Account team to work backwards from the customer to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities. These strategic cloud opportunities can include but are not limited to large-scale workload migrations & modernizations, GenAI/Agentic, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, and business agility.
3/Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams.

title: Sr Software Development Engineer, CloudWatch Collectors
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for an exceptional senior software development engineer to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 13 quadrillion metric observations per month! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

CloudWatch is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will lead the design and architecture of highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide and spanning multiple services and teams. You will shape the technical strategy and roadmap for the services you and your team own, making and documenting the key architectural decisions and tradeoffs, and you will stay hands-on — building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will raise the engineering bar across the team through code and design reviews, coding standards, and operational excellence, and help expand our services across all AWS Regions. When issues arise, you will dive deep to understand the root cause and drive fixes that prevent them recurring. Above all, you will mentor and develop the engineers around you, growing the technical capability of the team, and partner with product and other engineering teams to break ambiguous problems down into deliverable workstreams. You will champion the adoption of GenAI and AI-powered development tools across the team, raising engineering productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.

About the team
Our team owns telemetry collection for CloudWatch, building and operating the agents that gather metrics, logs, and traces at AWS scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- Experience in development in the last 3 years
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

title: Partner Solutions Manager, Partner Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads builds the technology connections between our advertising platform — the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — and the agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators that build on them. As a Partner Solutions Manager (PSM), you own the production life of these partner integrations: you keep them healthy, current, and performing in market, and you grow the revenue they generate over time.

Once an integration is live, you own its operational trajectory — production support, migrations, deprecations, and ongoing technical health. You are the technical owner partners rely on to keep a shipped integration running as the platform evolves, to drive migrations to completion, and to resolve production issues before they affect advertiser adoption or revenue. You handle complex, ambiguous operational problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, make pragmatic trade-offs between short- and long-term fixes, and escalate with sound judgment to clear blockers.

You coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering teams to resolve recurring production issues and translate persistent partner friction into product feedback. You communicate clearly in writing and in technical reviews, and you are trusted to represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders. Success is measured in operational outcomes — sustained post-launch adoption, migration completion, time-to-resolution on production issues, and the revenue retained and grown across the integrations you own.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the production health of a portfolio of live partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, and Amazon Marketing Stream — keeping them stable, performing, and current as the platform evolves.
- Resolve production issues end to end, from diagnosis to resolution, managing time-to-resolution and preventing recurrence.
- Plan and drive migrations and deprecations to completion, keeping integrations on supported patterns with no disruption to live traffic.
- Grow the revenue the integrations you own generate, acting on optimization and expansion opportunities within live implementations.
- Run the operational cadence with each partner's engineering team — health reviews, change management, release coordination — against clear reliability and adoption targets.
- Coordinate across Partner Development, Amazon Ads product, and engineering to unblock production issues and drive cross-team fixes to closure.
- Translate recurring partner friction into prioritized, evidence-backed product feedback.
- Make pragmatic short- vs. long-term trade-offs, escalating with sound judgment to clear blockers.
- Represent production health and risk to senior stakeholders through clear written narratives and technical reviews.
- Protect proactive capacity, holding reactive load within target so most time goes to durable health, migration, and revenue work.

A day in the life
Customers: partners whose integrations are live — agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, SIs, ERPs, Japan — working directly with their engineering teams; advertisers are the end beneficiaries.

Internal stakeholders: Amazon Ads Product & Engineering (Ads API, DSP, AMC, Stream), PDMs, Solutions Architects, pod manager and peer PTMs.

Problems solved: keeps live integrations stable as the platform evolves; drives migrations off deprecated patterns without disrupting traffic; resolves production issues before they stall adoption; turns recurring friction into product feedback; grows revenue from live implementations.

Daily: monitor portfolio health, run partner technical cadences, drive issue resolution and migrations, escalate defects, report production health.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.

title: Wireless Network Development Engineer , ONE-NAT, ONE Access Engineering (LAN/Wireless)
descriptionHtml:
Are you strong in network automation? then this might be a great opportunity for you.

Join Amazon's Network Access Technology team and build automation that keeps the world's largest enterprise wireless network running smoothly and healing itself. You'll design and deploy next-generation access infrastructure across thousands of global sites, solving complex problems at massive scale while your work directly enables every package Amazon delivers.

Your primary focus is building automation that makes our global wireless network self-sufficient and resilient. You'll analyze patterns across thousands of sites, develop workflows that resolve issues without human intervention, and validate new hardware before it reaches production environments.

You partner with firmware, field operations, and infrastructure engineers—pressure-testing designs and influencing decisions through data-driven insights. You'll mentor newer engineers, conduct technical reviews, and occasionally visit sites for hands-on validation and troubleshooting.

No two weeks look the same, but the constant is this: you're solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, and your work directly impacts the reliability of our fulfillment network worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and Deploy Network Solutions: Lead the design, development, and deployment of network access solutions spanning wireless (Wi-Fi 5/6/6E/7), wired (802.1X, NAC), and emerging network access technologies across Amazon's global fulfillment network.
- Own End-to-End Project Delivery: Take ownership of complex, multi-milestone network engineering projects from requirements gathering through deployment and validation, ensuring alignment with internal processes and stakeholder expectations.
- Build Automation and Tooling: Develop and enhance automation frameworks for network configuration, compliance validation, and zero-touch deployment pipelines that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
- Enable Self-Healing Operations: Contribute to our automation platform by developing automated remediation workflows, anomaly detection models, and predictive maintenance capabilities for wireless infrastructure.
- Drive Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering, field operations, network operations, and program management teams to develop solutions that balance performance, cost, and operational simplicity while validating new device types and configurations.

About the team
We own the design, planning, deployment, and support of the largest wireless and wired access network in the world. We operate at an unprecedented scale—assisting fulfillment, sortation, and delivery sites globally. Our team manages access interconnection that ensures every Amazon associate, robot, and IoT device stays reliably linked to power Amazon's fulfillment promise.

We're focused on transforming network engineering and operations through AI-driven automation, self-healing infrastructure, and next-generation access technologies. We don't just maintain reachability—we architect the network that enables Amazon to deliver for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a team that values operational excellence, continuous improvement, and collective problem-solving.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 4+ years experience developing engineering, deployment, or operations mechanisms to support IP network and/or networking systems
- 4+ years experience in a network focused hands-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and platforms in large scale enterprise wireless network environments

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a focused Security Engineer who can take on a leadership role in responding to security issues across the largest cloud provider in the world. - Evaluate the impact to the organization of current security trends, advisories, publications, and academic research. Coordinate responses as necessary across affected teams to do the right thing for our customers and our organization.
- Ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of sensitivity, and multiple audiences.
- Recognize, adopt and instill the best practices in security engineering fields throughout the organization: development, cryptography, network security, security operations, incident response, security intelligence.

- Demonstrate high capacity and tolerance for context switching and interruptions while remaining productive and effective.
- Develop pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while maintaining an acceptable level of risk.
- Mentoring of junior staff and proactively share knowledge sharing within the team and across the company.

AWS Cloud Response is responsible for the security of AWS Cloud services.
