This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS is building a new team focused on driving customer adoption of AWS security services - and we're looking for a senior technical specialist to help define what great looks like from day one.

Customers are moving fast, especially into generative AI and agentic architectures, and they need help doing that securely. At the same time, they want to get more from the AWS security services they already own and adopt new ones with confidence. That gap is where this team lives.

As a Sr. Solutions Architect on the Security Services team, you will work directly with enterprise customers to design, adopt, and operationalize AWS security services at scale. You won't just advise - you'll own the technical relationship, architect the solutions, and stay engaged through adoption. You'll work alongside a paired security services seller as a technical and commercial unit, and you'll bring what you learn back to AWS product teams to shape the roadmap.

This is a founding role on a new team. The playbooks don't exist yet. You'll help write them.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end technical relationship with a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding their adoption of AWS security services including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, and Amazon Detective
- Architect solutions to complex security problems where the technology strategy is not yet defined - helping customers move from intent to implementation with confidence
- Work as a paired technical and commercial unit with a security services seller, driving service adoption and measurable customer outcomes together
- Help customers secure their generative AI and agentic architectures, meeting them where they are and helping them move faster without sacrificing their security posture
- Serve as the voice of the customer back to AWS security product teams - surface field patterns, identify gaps, and translate that feedback into clear requirements that shape the roadmap
- Build and maintain relationships with AWS Partners to design and deliver architectures that combine AWS-native security services with best-in-class partner solutions
- Produce thought leadership that scales your impact beyond individual engagements - blogs, reference architectures, workshops, and conference sessions that help customers and the field community
- Partner with AWS Account Teams and security strategy roles to connect service adoption to broader security transformation at customers

A day in the life
No two days look the same in this role. You might start the morning reviewing a customer's detection and response architecture - mapping out how Security Hub and GuardDuty fit into their existing tooling and where the gaps are. Mid-morning, you join a call with your paired seller to align on an account plan for an enterprise customer consolidating third-party security tooling onto AWS. You draft a few notes on a pattern you've seen across three customers that the product team should know about.

In the afternoon, you run a workshop with a customer's security engineering team - walking through how to operationalize Security Hub findings at scale. You wrap the day reviewing a draft reference architecture you've been building for securing agentic workloads, something you plan to publish as a blog post next month.

Through all of it, you're doing the work directly. You're the technical expert in the room, and customers know it.

About the team
This is a new team within the AWS Customer Solutions & Scale Innovation (CSSI) organization. The team's mission is to accelerate customer adoption of AWS security services by pairing deep technical expertise with a commercial go-to-market motion alongside security services sellers.

You will work closely with AWS Account Teams, security strategy roles, and AWS Partners to help customers build confident, secure operations on AWS. The customers you serve are navigating real complexity - they're adopting generative AI, rethinking identity and access models, and trying to keep pace with a threat environment that evolves daily. This team exists to help them do all of that on AWS.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience securing generative AI or agentic workloads, or a strong point of view on how security models need to evolve for AI-native architectures

descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s team! We are looking for talented Program Manager to make it dramatically easier for sellers to launch and grow their business on our marketplace. In this role, you'll own the seller journey from registration end through first listing and early success, removing friction at every step so more sellers reach their first sale and long-term growth faster. You'll partner with product, tech, verification, and business teams to reinvent onboarding, accelerate sellers to key milestones, and turn seller pain points into solutions. If you love building programs that unlock growth for hundreds of thousands of sellers, this is for you.

Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

descriptionHtml:

AWS is looking for a Principal Product Designer to define and own the design vision for observability — the products engineers and SREs rely on to understand, monitor, and operate systems at massive scale. In this role you'll turn ambiguous, deeply technical problems into clear design theses and simple, shippable experiences across dense data: dashboards, telemetry, alerting, and incident workflows. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering in the codebase, set the craft bar for the team, and coach senior designers to raise theirs. If you thrive on problems others haven't framed yet, build your way to the answer, and want your work to shape product strategy at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

Your morning might start in a design review where you challenge the team to push past the surface of a new alerting experience, followed by a working session with engineering to pressure-test what's technically possible. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to ambiguity and help your organization move forward with confidence.

Our team shapes the observability experiences that engineers and SREs depend on to run systems at scale turning overwhelming streams of telemetry, logs, and alerts into something people can actually reason about under pressure. We operate as a builder team: we don't hand off specs and wait. We prototype, commit production code, run experiments, and push toward production, working side by side with engineering in shared pods. We're investing in emerging technology including AI-driven and agentic experiences for monitoring and incident response and we care as much about the craft of a dense data interface as the strategy behind it. title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security's Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon's security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping
Amazon and its customers safe.

We are seeking a senior Software Development Engineer to lead the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a technical leader who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems where the business need is understood but the technology strategy is not yet defined, who owns outcomes across system boundaries, and who thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals. You will own the architectural direction of the SecComms platform, lead projects staffed by multiple engineers, and act as a force multiplier for the team.

Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross-functional team - engineers work shoulder-to-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable leading discussions and building consensus in this environment across both technical and non-technical domains.

Key job responsibilities
Design & Delivery

title: TEMPEST Security Specialist, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a TEMPEST Engineer to protect the classified space and systems that a U.S. Government AI Factory program depends on.

Emanations security sits on the critical path for accreditation, and we need someone who can both run the test and own the program behind it. You will plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis, then develop and maintain the TEMPEST program and documentation that carries those results into the accreditation package. You will verify RED/BLACK separation and TEMPEST countermeasures and work directly with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority. Partnering with physical security, construction security specialists, systems engineers, and our Government counterparts, you will take classified space and equipment from design to accredited, and keep it that way.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis on classified systems and facilities; set up test equipment, take measurements, record findings, and produce test reports.
- Identify compromising-emanation vulnerabilities and recommend, implement, and verify TEMPEST countermeasures and mitigations.
- Develop and maintain the TEMPEST program, TEMPEST Checklist, and emanations-security test documentation in support of the ICD 705 accreditation package.
- Verify RED/BLACK equipment and cabling separation and installation against CNSSAM TEMPEST/01-13 and related standards.
- Coordinate with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority on TEMPEST requirements, countermeasure reviews, and findings.
- Track TEMPEST testing status, findings, and retest and reaccreditation actions.
- Collaborate with internal teams, general contractors, architects, and engineers prior to and during facility builds to ensure emanations-security requirements are captured and met.
- Read and understand construction details and drawings that capture Government TEMPEST and RED/BLACK requirements and standards.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because classified space moves through phases and so do you. One morning you are on site with test equipment, taking instrumented emanations measurements and analyzing signals; that afternoon you are writing up findings and updating the TEMPEST Checklist and accreditation documentation. Some days you are walking a build with construction security specialists and engineers, confirming RED/BLACK separation against the drawings before walls close. Others you are on the phone with the CTTA and the Government accreditation authority, working countermeasure reviews and closing out findings. You move fluidly between the bench and the program, and you are the person who makes sure the emanations-security details are right so accreditation stays on track.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience
- Experience in relevant work
- Can bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Can use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
- Can walk on job sites in uneven terrain
- Can work at heights and from ladders

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of data center engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling
- Experience in data center engineering
- Can perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Media & Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS)
descriptionHtml:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team that partners with one of the world's most-watched media companies, where live sports, entertainment, and streaming reach tens of millions of people every day. In this role, you'll design resilient, low-latency AWS architectures behind streaming platforms that have to hold up when the whole country tunes in at once, and the media supply chain that gets content from creation to screen.

You'll work at the intersection of engineering and storytelling, turning complex broadcast and business challenges into elegant cloud solutions. Your work will span large-scale live and on-demand streaming; media asset management, archive modernization, and cloud-based production workflows that unlock decades of content; real-time ad decisioning, contextual targeting, and personalization across ad-supported streaming; and generative AI experiences that change how content is tagged, discovered, and monetized. From the newsroom to the big game, you'll support live moments where there are no second takes. We're looking for strategic thinkers who thrive in ambiguity, communicate with clarity to engineers, producers, and executives alike, and are energized by mentoring others.

Why join? You'll help ensure millions of viewers get the right content and the right ad, in the right moment, flawlessly. You'll collaborate on some of the most demanding streaming, media supply chain, and ad delivery architectures in the industry, and innovate in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, and diverse perspectives. Apply now to architect the future of how the world watches.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design of end-to-end cloud solutions for customers, working backward from their business objectives to architect systems that are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor by building relationships with customer leadership, understanding their technology challenges, and ensuring short-term decisions align with long-term business outcomes.
- Drive technical solution discussions with customer teams, diving into design choices, best practices, and use cases while proactively identifying and mitigating high-risk or overly complex approaches.
- Develop and deliver technical content such as presentations, workshops, sample code, and white papers to educate customers on cloud strategy and architectural best practices.
- Collaborate with internal teams including sales, professional services, support, and engineering to accelerate solution adoption and contribute reusable reference designs for the broader Solutions Architecture community.
- Stay at the forefront of emerging technology in streaming, media supply chain, and ad tech, including generative AI, so you can keep earning your place as your customers' trusted advisor as their industry evolves.
- Build and showcase hands-on prototypes, demos, and proofs of concept that bring new capabilities to life and shorten the path from idea to production.
- Partner with ISVs and industry partners to shape joint solutions across live streaming, media asset management, and ad delivery and personalization.
- Share your expertise through blogs, conference talks, and industry events, helping AWS stay established as the cloud of choice for media companies looking to grow revenue and modernize their operations.

A day in the life
Your day spans internal alignment, customer architecture discussions, and hands-on experimentation with AWS services to solve media challenges: live streaming at scale, ad decisioning and personalization, and modernizing the media supply chain. You might start by reviewing a proposed architecture and finding ways to simplify it, then lead a deep-dive with a customer's engineering team on the trade-offs between encoding, delivery, and ad-insertion approaches. Afternoons bring solutioning sessions where you craft architectures that hold up under the biggest live audiences, followed by building proofs of concept to de-risk high-stakes decisions, like how to unlock decades of archived content or personalize ads in real time. Between engagements, you'll partner with AWS service teams to advocate for your customer's needs and turn their feedback into roadmap priorities. You'll close your day sharing what you've learned through blogs, demos, and conversations across engineering, production, and business stakeholders.

About the team
We're the AWS Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS) Solutions Architecture team, and our vision is simple: we meet our customers where they are, design what's next, prove what's possible, and scale what matters for every fan, every story, every screen, and every experience. #InventForFans

We come with a point of view, staying on the frontier of technology and pushing it where it matters most to our customers. We're builders who roll up our sleeves to create demos, proofs of concept, and prototypes, because a working idea beats a slide every time. We collaborate across account teams, specialists, and service teams, acting as the connective tissue that shapes what gets built next. And we scale our thinking, turning what we learn in the field into patterns and reference architectures that the whole industry can use. Every activity backs an outcome for our customers, and we're intentional about the work that matters.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Knowledge of cloud architecture
- Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
- Experience working with end user or developer communities

descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, News, Prime Video Global App Experience
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop destination for premium video in one app, available on thousands of devices worldwide. Alongside movies, series, and live sports, Prime Video is becoming a place customers come every day to stay informed, and we're investing in News to make that happen.

Our News program is early. We launched a dedicated News experience this year and are moving quickly, but much of what this product could become is still unbuilt. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Prime Video's effort to become the best place to watch video news. The work feels like a startup inside a larger business. You'll have the room to define a new category for Prime Video, along with the scale, data, and technology to reach millions of customers.

You'll own the strategy for growing customers' awareness of news on Prime Video and making it a daily habit. You'll set ambitious goals and run the programs that deliver them. A central part of the work is inventing AI-powered news features that inform and engage customers. You'll partner directly with applied scientists and engineers to build them, turning user research and data into the experience customers see on screen. You'll study the competitive landscape closely so that Prime Video sets the bar for video news streaming instead of following it.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is highly analytical, customer obsessed, and comfortable with ambiguity. You have a track record of taking a new product area from early traction to scale. You're fluent in AI/ML and generative AI, and you can weigh in on technical trade-offs with scientists and engineers. You influence senior stakeholders through clear writing and sound judgment, and you can bring hotly debated topics to a decision. Experience in news or digital media is a strong plus.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for news on Prime Video, and the metrics that measure customer awareness, engagement, and daily habit.
- Set ambitious, measurable goals for news growth, and drive the programs and feature launches that deliver them.
- Invent AI-powered news experiences that help customers stay informed in ways they can't get elsewhere.
- Partner directly with applied scientists and software engineers to frame problems, evaluate model and technology choices, and make trade-offs between quality, speed, and cost.
- Build a deep understanding of news customers through user research, experimentation, and data analysis, and translate those insights into product requirements and design direction.
- Continuously benchmark against best-in-class news and video experiences, track emerging industry trends, and use those insights to inform Prime Video's approach.
- Write clear product narratives and requirements that align senior leaders and cross-functional partners, and bring contentious decisions to resolution.
- Drive launches across teams inside and outside Prime Video, including design, content partnerships, marketing, legal, and operations.
- Shape how Prime Video meets the unique demands of news, including timeliness, accuracy, trust, and responsible use of AI.

About the team
Prime Video's Global App Experience (GAE) organization builds a simple, intuitive, fast, and personalized streaming experience for Prime Video customers worldwide, across web, mobile, and living room devices. Our goal is to make Prime Video a daily destination where customers want to come to watch their favorite content. The News team within GAE is central to that goal. We're building Prime Video into the place customers turn every day to stay informed. The team combines the energy of an early-stage startup with GAE's global reach and Amazon's investments in AI. We work closely with science, engineering, design, and content partners to experiment fast, learn from customers, and scale what works.

- 4+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience with AI/ML technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods
- Experience reviewing user research and data to build a strategic and user-friendly design
- 5+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience

title: Signal Integrity Engineer, Amazon Devices
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile devices like the Kindle family of products. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. Key job responsibilities
As a Signal Integrity Engineer, you will be part of Validation team that is exploring new hardware designs to improve our devices. In this role, you will be responsible for Signal Integrity aspects, compliance, and interoperability of package substrate, PCB, Cable solutions and system-level SI for interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Clocks etc. You will also be responsible for contributing to package and platform design guideline development.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary groups including Board Design, System Architects, IP developers, and Design Engineering, to verify and deliver complex, high volume SoCs that enable development of world-class hardware devices. In this role, you will be:

• Reviewing and evaluating package and board design and providing review feedback.
• Responsible for providing power delivery solutions across platform, package and SOC level
• Definition of worst-case currents and voltage drop scenarios, MIM/decoupling allocation, grid choices and analysis, droop control, SOC ESD compliance, On-die droop detectors, usage of on-die delivery solutions like VR, LDO, and Power gates.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 4+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- High speed serial interface analog building blocks, protocol, specifications and test methods
- Familiarity with Simulation tools (ADS, HFSS, PowerSI, PowerDC, Hyperlynx) to execute SI-PI simulations is required.
- Experience with performing measurement, and correlating measurements to simulations.
- Experience with modeling and simulation of high-speed interface interconnects/channel.
- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- Understanding of Power & signal integrity concepts such as differential impedance, jitter, insertion loss, return loss, termination, etc.
- Scripting experience in any programming language (C++, Python, PERL, MATLAB) to develop automation scripts is a plus.
- Experience in Analog IP Characterization (SerDes, PLL, DDR) is desirable.

descriptionHtml:

Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research.

Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations.

- Own end to end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot data collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. Coordinate dependencies and resolve blockers to meet agreed quality and turnaround goals.

- Demonstrated ability to deliver independently within defined objectives, coordinate multiple partner teams, and resolve operational blockers with limited guidance
- Experience diagnosing hardware, software, or process issues, using evidence to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, including the ability to assess risks and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information
- Working understanding of how collection quality, task coverage, and consistency affect model training and evaluation, with the ability to translate research requirements into executable procedures and quality checks
- Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others and communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including remote teams and colleagues who use English as a second language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing SOPs, technical documentation, performance metrics, and process improvements, and ensuring their adoption
- Experience with robotics, teleoperation, egocentric video, or multimodal sensor data

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
The best coding assistants have to do two hard things together: understand code as the structured, interconnected system it really is, and keep learning from every interaction so they get better over time. Most AI tools today do neither well. They flatten code into tokens and lose the structure that makes software navigable, and they start each session from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about a developer's codebase, patterns, and way of working. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to change both at once, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist who will work across code understanding and continual learning as a single, connected problem. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.

In this role you will turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a unified representation our models can reason over, and you will make that system learn over time, so it accumulates knowledge without forgetting what it already knew, retrieves the right memory at the right moment, and personalizes the experience for each developer and team. These are not two separate jobs. A system that understands code deeply is also the one best positioned to remember and personalize how it helps, and you will own that intersection end to end. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper.

Key job responsibilities
- Build representations of code that fuse static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context, and that models can use at repository scale

- Make those systems learn over time through memory-augmented architectures, retrieval mechanisms, and personalization that consolidate and recall knowledge across sessions

- Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale

- Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide

- Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)

- Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Hybrid Work
We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development

title: Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements

At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. title: Applied Scientist II, Prime Video - Ads Science
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities
The science challenges include:
- Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
- Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
- Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
- Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
- Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life
- Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
- Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
- Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
- Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
- Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
- Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About the team
Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience with programming languages such as Python, Java, C++

title: Head of Movies, Content Acquisition, Prime Video Japan
descriptionHtml:
Lead the movies strategy for one of the world's fastest-growing streaming services in one of its most dynamic markets. As Head of Movies for Prime Video Japan, you will define what millions of customers watch by building the content portfolio that keeps them coming back — from blockbuster Japanese theatrical releases to marquee US studio titles.

Prime Video is a premium streaming service offering customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies, Amazon Originals, exclusive licensed content, and live sports events across 240+ countries and territories. We are a fast-paced, growth business where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.

We are seeking an exceptional leader to join our content acquisition team in Tokyo and own the end-to-end movies strategy for Prime Video Japan, with a focus on Japanese and US Movies. You will identify the most compelling content for our customers, build and deepen partnerships with major studios and content owners, and drive high-impact decisions that shape the movie selection on our service. This role requires deep expertise in deal structuring, content performance forecasting, and partner relationship management — all in service of delivering a world-class movie experience to our customers.


Key job responsibilities
Own and execute the content acquisition strategy for Japanese and US movies on Prime Video Japan, setting the vision for selection that drives customer engagement and business growth.

Negotiate and execute SVOD content licensing agreements with movie rights holders, aggregators, and other content suppliers across various business models, optimizing for customer value and financial performance.

Build and maintain senior-level relationships with major Japanese and US studios, distributors, and content partners, positioning Prime Video as a preferred licensing partner.

Leverage data on customer behavior, viewing patterns, and market trends to inform acquisition priorities, uncover underserved content genres, and validate deal economics.

Develop content acquisition plans, financial models, and performance forecasts for senior leadership, translating data insights into actionable strategy recommendations.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Programming, and Studios teams to define content strategies, execute licensing agreements, and support promotional activities.

Monitor the competitive landscape and evolving dynamics of the Japanese entertainment market to identify emerging opportunities and inform long-term content strategy.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing performance data on recent movie launches to assess what's resonating with customers. Mid-morning, you're in a negotiation call with a major Japanese studio, working through deal terms for an upcoming theatrical slate. After lunch, you join a cross-functional strategy session with Marketing and Programming to align on the quarterly content calendar. Later, you're building a business case for a new content partnership, pulling together financial projections and customer insights to present to senior leadership. No two days are the same — but every day, you're making decisions that directly shape what millions of customers watch.

About the team
The Prime Video Japan Content Acquisition team is responsible for building the content portfolio that delights our customers across movies, drama, anime, sports, variety, and more. Based in Tokyo, we work closely with Japan's entertainment industry and global studio partners. We are a collaborative, data-driven team that combines deep industry relationships with analytical rigor to make smart content investments. You'll be joining a team that values bold thinking, customer obsession, and a passion for great storytelling.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of content acquisition team management experience
- 10+ years of account management, business development, content licensing or finance experience
- Experience with leadership and mentorship of personnel within large organizations
- Experience in strategy development
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of digital video landscape, including solid understanding of digital video distribution technologies
- Experience creating and improving processes
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience in movies & TV distribution/licensing

title: Transportation Representative, NOC-NL
descriptionHtml:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Key job responsibilities
Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers
(Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data
management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams
who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that
make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the
relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and
identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative
outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review
forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environmen

Basic qualifications

- - Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL - Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments - 10+ 2 degree

Preferred qualifications

title: Senior SAP Technical Consultant, Professional Services - SAP
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior SAP Technical Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will own the technical architecture and engineering strategy for SAP engagements across ABAP development, BTP extensibility, BASIS operations, and integration delivered within customer environments. You will lead multidisciplinary delivery teams of ABAP developers, BTP engineers, and BASIS professionals on complex SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations and modernization programs, establishing the technical standards, governance, and delivery mechanisms that produce secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP outcomes for AWS customers.

This role requires someone who moves fluidly between enterprise architecture decisions and hands-on technical problem-solving. You will evaluate solution alternatives, define development and extensibility patterns, resolve complex technical risks mid-delivery, and ensure ABAP, BTP, and BASIS workstreams operate as one integrated engineering organization across AWS teams, customer teams, and SI partners.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Own the SAP technical architecture across ABAP, BTP, BASIS, integrations, extensibility, and platform operations on active customer engagements

Lead and develop multidisciplinary delivery teams across BASIS, ABAP, and BTP disciplines, establishing clear ownership, priorities, standards, and delivery expectations on every program

Define technical patterns and guardrails for SAP configuration, custom development, workflows, forms, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and extensions and enforce them across customer and partner teams

Establish and defend clean-core principles on every engagement, determining when requirements are addressed through standard SAP functionality, in-app extensibility, side-by-side BTP extensions, or custom ABAP and holding that line under commercial pressure

Own BTP architecture decisions including account and subaccount design, environments, connectivity, identity, security, application services, integration services, development standards, and lifecycle management

Lead BASIS architecture and operational design across system landscapes, environments, transports, upgrades, patching, performance, capacity, availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and production support

Establish software development standards covering solution design, coding, peer reviews, automated testing, documentation, source control, CI/CD, transport management, and release governance and embed them into customer delivery teams that will own them post-engagement

Partner with functional architects, customer product teams, and SI partners to convert business requirements into scalable technical designs and accurate delivery estimates

Review and approve technical designs across workstreams, ensuring solutions meet requirements for performance, scalability, security, controls, resilience, supportability, and cost

Develop technical roadmaps, architecture documents, SOW inputs, decision materials, and executive updates that communicate priorities, risks, trade-offs, and required investments to both customer and AWS leadership

Evaluate emerging SAP and generative AI capabilities including Kiro, ABAP Accelerator, and agentic testing frameworks and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, user experience, automation, monitoring, and support on active engagements

What Makes This Role Different

You are not maintaining a system. You are building the technical foundation customers rely on after AWS leaves. Every architecture decision, every standard you set, and every pattern you enforce becomes the customer's operational reality. The bar is high, the engagements are complex, and the impact is permanent.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of SAP migration, implementation, or consulting experience in software or technology industries
- Experience as a technical lead or mentor on SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations
- Deep expertise in one or more of: ABAP development, SAP BTP, SAP BASIS, SAP integration, or SAP technical architecture

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture, and networking experience in customer-facing delivery contexts
- Deep knowledge of SAP systems including Business Suite, S/4HANA, BW, HANA, and Business Objects and their architecture and infrastructure requirements
- Hands-on experience with SAP clean-core design, including build using non-SAP technologies across Generative AI, agentic AI, and data and analytics
- Experience with ABAP Cloud, Core Data Services, RESTful Application Programming Model, Fiori, SAPUI5, APIs, workflows, forms, and enhancement frameworks
- Experience with SAP BTP services including Integration Suite, Extension Suite, Cloud Foundry, Kyma, SAP Build, Event Mesh, API Management, or related capabilities
- Experience with SAP BASIS and HANA administration across system landscapes, transports, upgrades, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational support

title: Senior Security Compliance Specialist, Devices & Services Security Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Devices & Services organization is expanding into new markets and facing a wave of new regulations, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act. We are looking for a Security Industry Specialist to help us stay ahead of these changes by building and scaling the compliance programs that earn customer trust for products like Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV. In this role, you will work across security, engineering, legal, and business teams to assess control environments, design compliance frameworks grounded in standards like ISO 27001, and drive remediation strategies to completion. You will also help reshape how we work by contributing to an AI-first approach to compliance processes. If you thrive on solving complex compliance challenges across a global organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key job responsibilities
Design and drive scalable Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks that address security assurance requirements for Amazon devices across multiple regulated markets, including new certifications and labels as the product portfolio expands.
Assess and mitigate security compliance risks by developing remediation strategies, tracking issues to resolution, and escalating blockers with actionable recommendations for leadership.
Collaborate with engineering, legal, and business teams to translate evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act into control designs and compliance programs aligned with security audit frameworks like ISO 27001.
Represent Amazon in industry groups and with external regulators to understand and shape emerging compliance requirements before they impact the security and control environment.
Create repeatable process paths for security control design, testing, and validation that reduce duplicate effort and can be adopted by multiple teams across the organization.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing updates to an upcoming regulation and mapping its requirements against existing device certifications. Later, you could lead a working session with engineering and security partners to close a control gap, then prepare a compliance briefing for leadership. You will regularly engage with external auditors and industry peers, turning what you learn into practical guidance for internal teams. Mentoring colleagues and refining shared processes round out a day focused on protecting customers and enabling business growth.

About the team
The Devices & Services Compliance Team supports Amazon's consumer devices products, including Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV, by setting a high security bar, ensuring regulatory compliance, and obtaining industry certifications. The team is investing in an AI-first redesign of its compliance processes and expanding its coverage as Amazon enters new markets and navigates new regulatory demands. You will join a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving and works closely with security, engineering, legal, and business partners worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- 7+ years of security, compliance and risk management experience, or degree in advanced technology
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security
- Experience working with multiple security frameworks and regulations like ISO 27001/2, HIPAA, NIST CSF

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS tech stack (e.g., AWS Redshift, S3, EC2, Glue)
- Experience working directly with security engineers, auditors, and development teams
- Consistent demonstration of utilizing automation and AI to solve recurring problems at scale
- Experience working with connected devices or related regulations (e.g. EU Radio Equipment Directive, Cyber Resilience Act, AU Cyber Security Act, etc.).
- Experience obtaining one or more of the following certifications/reports: ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, Matter PKI, HITRUST.
- Experience with hardware and software development processes, products launches and lifecycles of devices and/or services

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.

Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, ASCS, Amazon Freight
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
• Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
• Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
• Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets
• Own escalation communication to customer executives when something goes wrong: what's happening, what we're doing about it, and how we're tracking toward resolution
• Own internal reporting, including MBRs, account bridges, and leading inspection mechanisms for your accounts. Report out on performance metrics, cost inputs, and customer KPIs
• Influence customer operations to drive optimal inputs that lower our costs. Define what good looks like, measure it, and partner with customers to change how they operate
• Activate structured recovery programs before the customer escalates


A day in the life
Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. By midmorning you're briefing a customer's regional transportation director on performance, then rallying ops and pricing partners on a structural issue hitting multiple facilities. After lunch you build your MBR narrative, quantifying your team's impact and open items. Later you lead a working session with operations and product on a fix to prevent recurring defects, then close by updating a customer VP on a two-week escalation, showing progress against committed targets.


About the team
The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. This team serves as the single threaded relationship owner for our largest customers' operational points of contact. We exist to ensure that every enterprise shipper on our platform experiences the service level we committed to, and when they don't, we coordinate the teams that fix it.
