title: Sustainability Program Manager, EU Ops Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
EU Operations Sustainability drives the decarbonization of Amazon's operational footprint across Europe, focusing on reducing environmental impact from transportation, buildings, and energy consumption. The team develops and executes strategies spanning First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile logistics — including energy efficiency, renewable energy, building material decarbonization and climate resiliency and adaptation, at fulfillment centers, sort centres and delivery stations. Working cross-functionally with EU Operations, WW Sustainability, engineering and procurement, the EU Ops Sustainability team translates Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments into actionable programs with measurable targets. The team navigates also the evolving European regulatory landscape to ensure compliance while identifying opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines.

EU Ops Sustainability is looking for a Sustainability Program Manager to support energy efficiency programs across all miles. In this role, you will own strategic, tactical, and cross-functional projects and programs within the STEP organization to meet sustainability goals. You will be responsible for scoping and creating project plans, developing processes, coordinating and driving execution, and communicating progress to senior leadership. You will work day-to-day with cross-functional partners including RME, Finance, Real Estate, Design & Construction (D&C), and IT to deliver measurable energy and carbon reductions. You will also have the opportunity to work with selected start-ups through the Amazon Sustainability Accelerator (ASA) – Climate Tech programme, helping to evaluate, pilot, and scale innovative sustainability technologies across Amazon's European fulfillment network.

This role can be also based in other EU cities: Paris (CDG10), Barcelona (BCN10), Madrid (MAD12), Milan (LIN15), and Munich (MUC11).

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector
The position is classified at level 1 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
Manage full lifecycle complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations

Work closely with partner teams and stakeholders in and outside of your organization to source, allocate, and coordinate resources
Build and own financial models including business cases, Capital Appropriation Request (CAR) submissions, and discounted payback period (DPP) analysis to justify energy efficiency investments;

Own reporting on the state of initiatives, measuring improvements and impact of changes

Navigate the evolving European regulatory landscape — including EPBD (Energy Performance of Buildings Directive), Décret Tertiaire, and ISO 50001 to ensure compliance and identify opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines

Work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, seeking to understand business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions and reasons behind leadership decisions

Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks)

Work with program managers, business leaders and executive team to communicate and impact critical business initiatives

Develop, implement, and govern Key Performance Metrics (KPI) reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones, and performance across all projects

Set-up mechanisms to audit and perform necessary course corrections where needed to meet business objectives


About the team
EU STEP brings together Supply Chain, Network Design, and Transportation Planning teams to improve end-to-end forecasting, network flow, planning, and execution. It also brings together our teams from across the business focused on our Operational Excellence pillars - Amazon Customer Excellence Systems (ACES), Learning, Quality, Service, Sustainability and Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Field teams. This integration strengthens operations and execution while driving quality improvements and enhanced customer experience across the entire value chain.

title: Senior Data Center Design Manager, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
You'll join a diverse team of data center professionals. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Data Center Design Manager, you will be a key member of a high-performing global design engineering leadership team, comprising world-class Architects, Structural, Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, ICT, Fire, Acoustics, Water, and Security Engineers. You will own the design direction, design quality, and design delivery for a portfolio of mission-critical data center projects across the APAC region.

This is a deeply design-centric role. You will set the vision for complex, multi-discipline infrastructure systems driving design from concept through detailed engineering, construction documentation, and commissioning validation. You will define and evolve regional design standards, champion design automation and tooling innovation, and embed continuous improvement into every phase of the design lifecycle. Your decisions will directly shape how AWS builds its next generation of data centers in APAC.

This role demands close collaboration across multiple facets of the AWS design engineering organisation, external engineering consultancies, regulatory bodies, and Australian government agencies.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance. Candidates must be Australian citizens or eligible to obtain the required clearance as a condition of employment.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers through all phases of data center critical infrastructure design from concept through detailed engineering, construction documentation, and commissioning validation.

Owning end-to-end design direction for power, cooling, controls, physical security, and structural systems setting the architectural vision and ensuring designs meet AWS performance, reliability, and cost targets.

Establishing regional design standards, basis-of-design documents, and design quality frameworks that drive consistency and scalability across APAC projects.

Leading design reviews from schematic through 100% construction documentation, ensuring technical rigour, code compliance, and alignment with AWS global design principles.

Driving design innovation, automation, and tooling initiatives that reduce cycle time, minimise rework, and improve documentation quality.

Tracking design-specific KPIs, cycle time, design maturity, RFI rates, and first-pass quality integrating construction and commissioning feedback to close the as-designed to as-built loop.

Driving design risk identification, constructability reviews, and value engineering across the region.

Establishing design budgets, contributing to business cases, and partnering with finance, engineering leads, and internal customers to optimise resources and define deliverables.

Driving permit approvals and interfacing with AHJ, Australian regulators, and government agencies.

A day in the life
As a Senior Design Manager, your day is anchored in design. You might start with a technical design review of a new cooling topology, then shift to a cross-discipline coordination meeting resolving interface clashes between electrical and mechanical systems.

After lunch, you're reviewing design automation outputs, benchmarking design cycle metrics against regional targets, and coaching a design engineer on construction documentation standards. Later, you brief leadership on design program status, or drive a constructability risk workshop with external consultants.

Every day, you're shaping how AWS designs and delivers its most critical infrastructure in APAC.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- 6+ years of project management or project lead work including RFQ/RFP process, selecting engineering teams, developing budgets, coordinating multiple consultant teams and facilitating meetings experience
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

title: Controls Integration Engineer, One MHS | Systems Integration and Flow
descriptionHtml:
The Controls Integration Engineer defines how automated material handling systems operate and owns the site-specific setup of the controls application software that runs them, assembling and configuring standard code for each site's conveyors, sorters, and automated work cells. For an assigned project, the engineer leads technical execution end to end: authoring the functional specifications, defining test criteria, and delivering tested, reviewed code and documentation ready for field deployment. The engineer solves difficult technical problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity to implementations where the business problem is understood but the solution is not fully designed. The engineer mentors the engineers on the project, reviews every deliverable for quality and downstream readiness, and builds close partnerships with third-party vendors and cross-functional teams. The engineer is also the primary handoff contact to the field team and carries field lessons learned back to upstream design teams. The goal is to take risk out of every project before it reaches the field and give the field team everything it needs to bring the site up.

Key job responsibilities
Application Development and Delivery
Own application deliverables for the assigned project from planning through handoff.
Assemble and configure the site's controls application software from standard code libraries, adapting it where the project requires.
Partner with design teams to resolve open functional questions and drive decisions to closure.
Contribute to design reviews with partner teams, bringing the controls and system function perspective.
Testing and Validation
Define test criteria for emulation, digital twin, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) in partnership with simulation, equipment, and design teams.
Lead emulation and digital twin testing, verifying that system flow meets design intent.
Participate in FAT and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) as the system function expert.
Build the site's commissioning test cases from the standard test case library, in partnership with the field team.
Cross-Team Partnerships
Build strong partnerships with cross-functional teams and third-party vendors, leading site-level coordination to resolve technical issues and unblock progress.
Define functional requirements for third-party interfaces and drive gaps to resolution with third-party teams.
Communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to project stakeholders.
Serve as the primary partner to the field team from planning through handoff.
Site Handoff and Post-Handoff Support
Deliver a complete, documented handoff package for each project.
Train the field team on each subsystem before handoff.
Partner with the field team on root cause analysis and corrective action for issues found in the field.
Continuous Improvement and Mentorship
Document issues, resolutions, and lessons learned, and feed them back to upstream design teams to improve future projects.
Improve team procedures, templates, and tools based on project experience.
Mentor engineers through hands-on guidance and deliverable review.
AutoStore-Specific Commissioning Duties:

Commission and validate AutoStore grid infrastructure, robot fleet initialization, port configurations, and charging systems
Troubleshoot robot navigation faults, bin handling errors, and port throughput issues
Analyze system logs, datasets, and diagnostic outputs to identify trends, anomalies, and root cause of system failures
Monitor and optimize system performance using diagnostic tools (PowerBI, Databricks, AutoStore controller software)
Support grid modifications, expansion projects, and firmware/software upgrades
Conduct advanced root cause analysis on system failures and performance deviations
Validate end-to-end material flow from AutoStore grid through conveyance to outbound operations
Collaborate with AutoStore distribution partners, customers, and internal teams to ensure successful deployments and minimal downtime
Interpret system telemetry, performance metrics, and monitoring dashboards to drive continuous improvement

Basic qualifications

- Experience with networking fundamentals including hands-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Travel up to 50% of the time
- Willingness to travel up to 50% for on-site commissioning and deployment support.
- Hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, EtherCAT, or Modbus TCP.
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Experience developing or testing application software for industrial automation systems using IEC 61131-3 platforms such as Codesys, Rockwell Logix (Studio 5000), Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff TwinCAT, or equivalent.
- Experience writing functional specifications or descriptions of operations for automated systems.
- 5+ years of experience in systems development engineering, controls application development, or industrial automation.

Preferred qualifications

- Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts in an IEC 61131-3 environment (e.g., structured function blocks, reusable control architectures).
- Experience supporting large-scale commissioning projects such as automated warehouses, conveyor and sorter systems, or complex manufacturing environments.
- - Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
- - Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
- - Demonstrated ability to independently interpret functional design documents and implement or validate corresponding controls behavior.
- - Experience with industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, or Modbus TCP.
- - Experience coordinating with third-party vendors or system integrators on interface specifications and gap resolution.
- - Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and engineering drawing review tools (AutoCAD, Navisworks, or equivalent).
- - Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows or improve code quality.
- - Hands-on experience with emulation or digital twin tools (e.g., Emulate3D or equivalent).
- - Experience creating or executing structured test plans (FAT/SAT) for automated systems.
- - Experience with SCADA systems, OEE data generation, or supervisory control platforms.
- - Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and automated code review or static analysis tools.
- - Familiarity with industrial safety systems and safety-related controls standards.

In this role, you'll be the critical link between station operations and our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Flex DPs driving safety, delivery quality, capacity planning, compliance, and cost performance.

You'll think on your feet every day - balancing customer expectations with operational realities across a dynamic delivery network. You'll be the voice of the DSP within the station and region, building strong partnerships with operations teams, leveraging data to solve problems, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement. This field-based role offers the chance to shape the future of last mile delivery in Australia - it's fast-paced, challenging, and hugely rewarding.

The days and hours required for this role are Sunday-Wednesday 06:00 - 16:00

Key job responsibilities
- Safety leadership - Champion on-road safety standards; lead investigations, drive corrective actions, and deliver against regional safety metrics in partnership with the Senior OTR Manager and site leadership.

- DSP performance management - Support and coach a portfolio of Delivery Service Partners through daily performance reviews, training, metrics analysis, and structured feedback to maximize delivery quality and productivity on route.

- Data-driven decision making - Deliver weekly reporting on on-road performance; create actionable insights and improvement plans that influence stakeholder decisions and drive operational excellence.

- Capacity planning & execution - Manage short- and medium-term capacity plans, coordinate network changes, and execute high-volume event planning including infrastructure scaling during peak periods (e.g., Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday).

- Service type strategy - Own strategy and execution for all DSP delivery programs in your area, including standard next-day, same-day, and specialty deliveries.

- Continuous improvement - Proactively identify process improvement opportunities using Lean tools and ACES methodologies; lead cross-functional projects from concept to implementation.

- Collaboration with Under the Roof (UTR) teams - Partner with Delivery Station management to maintain quality control standards, optimize dispatch, and ensure a seamless end-to-end delivery experience.

- Stakeholder communication - Align goals and tasks across operations, customer service, technology, and senior leadership to guarantee program success.

A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing performance dashboards and safety metrics before heading to the station floor to observe dispatch and debrief with DSP owners and drivers. You'll spend time in the field conducting safety audits, and time on dispatch dock to understand challenges. Back at your desk you'll analyze route-level data, identify improvement opportunities, and prepare for Daily/weekly business review. Throughout the day you'll collaborate with UTR leadership, ACES teams, and cross-functional partners - while mentoring DSPs and helping them navigate challenges. No two days look the same, and that's what makes this role exciting.

About the team
This role sits within the AMZL Last Mile Operations structure and reports to a Senior OTR Manager. You'll work alongside a collaborative team of OTR Managers across Australian delivery stations, all focused on building strong partnerships with independent delivery businesses to ensure millions of packages reach customers efficiently and safely. We value ownership, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that work for both operations and our delivery partners.

This is a **field-by-design** role - you'll be primarily based at your assigned delivery station with regular travel to partner sites within your region as required.

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 3+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst, Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate- Quality Analyst is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

Skills:
• Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
• Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
• Strong attention to details.
• Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
• Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
• Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
• Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

title: Principal TPM Operations Infrastructure Services Self-Service, Customer Experience Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Every Amazon fulfillment center, delivery station, and grocery store depends on the network gear, scanners, and devices that keep it running. Getting that hardware ordered, right-sized, and on site at the right time is still too slow and too manual. You'll build the program that fixes this, starting from a blank page.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and launch a new program that connects how infrastructure is planned, ordered, and fulfilled across Amazon's global operations network. Today, product teams and thousands of field associates each work with supply chain in their own way. They rely on manual handoffs and country-specific workarounds, and nobody has a single view of the process. Your job is to replace that with one governed, automated way for infrastructure demand to turn into orders, deliveries, and ready-to-install hardware.

There's no existing program to inherit. You'll set the mission, the operating model, and the integration architecture. Then you'll lead the teams that build it. You'll work with engineering teams who are already committed to this work, and with senior leaders across supply chain, procurement, field operations, and technology.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Define the program from the ground up: its charter, guiding principles, operating model, and how teams work together across organizations.
- Break down where time is lost between a customer's request and a placed order, set baselines, and target the biggest gaps first.
- Design how self-service ordering and automated bill-of-materials tools connect to supply chain systems, so orders flow without manual re-entry.
- Build a data model that handles country-specific regulations and vendor constraints as part of the design, not as exceptions.
- Set up forward-looking demand signals, so procurement moves from reacting to individual requests to planning ahead.
- Decide which systems hold the source of truth for each type of data, and which existing tools to invest in, consolidate, or retire.
- Write the strategy and present it to senior leaders, shaping who owns procurement and deployment for new site launches.

You'll love this role if you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something that doesn't exist yet, and want your work to show up in faster site launches, less wasted spend, and a better experience for teams across Amazon's operations network worldwide.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
We make infrastructure simple for every team that builds and runs technology across Amazon's operations network, from fulfillment centers to quick commerce sites worldwide. We build self-service products that let customers plan, order, and deploy infrastructure on their own, make the cost of every decision visible, and support complex programs that self-service can't handle yet. Each one teaches us what to automate next. You'll join product managers, engineers, solution architects, and program managers, partnering closely with supply chain, procurement, and field operations. We work backwards from the customer, measure outcomes over activity, and give people real ownership.

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

descriptionHtml:

Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for a world class leader to own the strategic relationship with a single strategic AWS Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Partner. You will set the vision and long-term strategy for the partnership, build and develop a high-performing team, and drive execution across joint solutions, field engagement, and GTM plans globally.

You will establish and grow executive-level business and technical relationships while providing strategic direction and coaching to your team on day-to-day partner interactions. You will have a business background that enables you to engage at the CXO level, a sales background that enables you to guide joint GTM efforts, and demonstrated people leadership experience that enables you to attract, develop, and retain top talent. title: Program Manager - Procurement & Process Excellence (SRM), Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) function is part of AIS.

Are you passionate about driving best-in-class strategy and governance in Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)? Do you have the leadership to be a trusted advisor across a complex, high-growth, global organization — and the hands-on instinct to not just coordinate the work, but design and build the tools and processes that run it?
As Program Manager, Procurement Excellence (SRM) within Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG), you will play a key role in leading our SRM program in support of Amazon's data center procurement organization.
This is a build-and-own role. Advances in generative AI, low-code, and automation tools have dramatically lowered the barrier to building — and we are looking for a program manager who pairs deep SRM and process knowledge with the technical fluency to design, build, and continuously improve the solutions and automations that run the program, close enough to the process to re-engineer it as needs evolve. You will own outcomes end to end: from deciding what is worth building and why, through building and landing it, to driving the user adoption that makes it stick.

This role involves working with a broad array of procurement practitioners and partner teams in a global, matrixed organization. The ability to make an impact and drive outcomes amid an ambiguous, complex landscape is critical to success. Due to the global nature of the role, flexibility in working across time zones is needed.

Your role includes:
• Refresh, lead, and build our SRM program strategy and operational execution — achieving the optimal mix of business value, governance, and compliance.
• Architect, build, and execute process improvements, controls, and policies that raise the SRM bar globally — re-engineering workflows rather than automating them as-is.
• Design and build AI-enabled and automation solutions end to end on modern low-code and generative-AI platforms — tools that measure supplier performance, monitor risk, and surface insight proactively, not static reports and trackers.
• Be data-fluent: read, interrogate, and judge whether the data behind a decision can be trusted, and build in the right checks so the insight you put in front of leadership is reliable by design.
• Serve as a subject-matter expert and trusted advisor on SRM to the procurement organization and partner teams.
• Drive a culture of innovation, simplification, and continuous improvement through best-practice sharing, advocacy, and hands-on delivery.
• Own change management and adoption for what you deliver — enablement, training, feedback loops, and iteration until the solution is the way the work gets done.
• Derive actionable insights and routinely present analysis and recommendations to stakeholders, partners, and senior leadership.
You may also contribute to other improvement and governance projects across DCPG. As a strong individual contributor, you will own significant workstreams end to end and influence across a broad, matrixed stakeholder group.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record delivering global programs in a central governance function of a large-scale procurement organization, with a process-improvement and excellence focus — and increasingly demonstrates hands-on building: re-engineering and automating workflows, building data-driven and AI-enabled tools, and shipping solutions that get adopted. Experience in SRM, supply chain, outsourcing, and/or vendor management, combined with strong digital and solution-building skills, is highly valued.



Key job responsibilities

1. Develop, maintain, and continuously improve a comprehensive SRM governance framework aligned with organizational strategy and industry best practices.
2. Design and implement policies, procedures, and standards for SRM processes — building the process logic into automated and AI-enabled tools rather than static documentation.
3. Establish and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) for SRM process effectiveness and supplier performance, instrumented in self-updating, trustworthy tools.
4. Develop and implement risk monitoring and management strategies for supplier relationships, with automated risk-surfacing where feasible.
5. Create, adapt, and maintain a centralized, well-governed repository for supplier information, contracts, and performance data.
6. Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to ensure alignment and drive measurable adoption of SRM governance practices.
7. Provide subject-matter expertise on complex supplier relationship issues.
8. In conjunction with Compliance and Risk, conduct regular audits of SRM processes and supplier engagements to ensure adherence to applicable controls and assurance programs.
9. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the SRM program.
10. Develop and deliver SRM training content and resources for procurement and partner teams.
11. Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging best practices in SRM governance and in applying AI and automation to procurement.
12. Prepare and present regular reports to senior management on the state of SRM governance and its impact on business performance.

A day in the life
• This role has a global scope, so there is no standard day — there is much variety.
• You could start with a morning meeting with US team members, a coffee with APAC, and finish with a call with EMEA.
• You will work on multiple projects across multiple teams and stakeholders — and spend real time building, not only coordinating.
• Your biggest customers will be our data center procurement teams and partner teams such as Construction and Project Managers. Stakeholders also include legal, finance, assurance, health & safety, and other data center colleagues.
• You will be seen as the domain expert in SRM and Supplier Management — and as the person who turns that expertise into working, adopted capability.

About the team
Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) is a global function that enables Amazon's data center procurement organization to execute at scale. It comprises of 1/ Program Management that drive programmatic and business improvements across our E2E procurement life-cycle 2/ Systems, Tooling & Analytics 3/ Data Analytics & GenAI The SRM program provides procurement managers a global framework to measure, track and benchmark supplier performance across key categories, driving enterprise value while ensuring AWS meets its regulatory, risk obligations.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors a Women's Leadership Program that supports the growth and development of female builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of vendor management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership.
- Hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping solutions — such as process automation, workflow tools, or AI-enabled tools, taken to adoption and iterated.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Head of Asia Pacific B2B Marketing, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. We're seeking a dynamic Head of Asia Pacific B2B Marketing who can create and execute full-funnel marketing acquisition strategies for multiple countries within the region.

This role requires a flexible, growth mindset and the ability to manage a high degree of ambiguity. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of operating as a player and a coach, setting and achieving key performance indicators as a strategist, and acquiring customers and hitting revenue targets. They will need to demonstrate a history of progressive scope and the ability to solve problems autonomously and navigate a very large, global and matrixed environment while balancing hands-on execution with future leadership.

At Amazon Leo, the B2B Marketing team is defining our end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) strategy. We own B2B customer insights, deliver compelling content, and acquire and retain customers across multiple industries and regions. The Head of Asia Pacific B2B Marketing will be responsible for crafting and implementing marketing strategies that resonate with diverse markets and cultures within the Asia Pacific region. They will need to be as comfortable with full lifecycle account-based marketing as with programmatic digital, delivering regional thought leadership, and white-glove, executive-focused events. This is a unique opportunity to shape the regional B2B marketing strategy from the ground up, for a highly advanced connectivity service in one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regions.

As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities

We're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing, mentorship and high-quality work. We embrace diversity of thought and love to test, learn and innovate across marketing disciplines. title: Senior Developer Marketing Manager, Developer Marketing
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) China and Hongkong Marketing team is looking for a Senior Developer Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end planning, execution, and amplification of developer marketing programs that drive awareness, adoption, and usage of AWS services across developer and builder audiences.

You will set the strategy and lead a team to design and run hackathons, competitions, hands-on workshops, and developer festivals — from problem statement design and platform setup all the way through promotion and post-event engagement. You won't just plan marketing tactics — you'll roll up your sleeves and build demo applications on AWS services yourself, so you can speak to developers as a peer, not just a marketer.

Beyond 1P programs, you will cultivate relationships with third-party developer communities — including open-source communities, community-oriented tech media (e.g., CSDN, InfoQ, GeekPark), and influencer-owned technical communities — to extend AWS's presence where developers already gather.

You will also lead to create compelling developer-facing content (blogs, vlogs, short-form videos, social posts) and bring creative energy to everything you do — designing programs that surprise, engage, and resonate with a developer audience that is notoriously hard to impress.

Key job responsibilities
• Define the developer marketing strategy for Greater China and drive end-to-end delivery of programs: scoping, planning, cross-functional coordination, execution, promotion, and post-program analysis.
• Set the bar for technical depth — design hackathon problem statements, set up hands-on lab environments, and build sample applications on AWS services to demonstrate real-world use cases.
• Coordinate across product marketing, field marketing, tech teams, PR, and business teams to ensure programs ladder up to broader GTM goals.
• Build and maintain engagement with 3P developer communities — open-source organizations, tech media with community reach, and influencer-led developer groups.
• Savvy in producing developer-facing content across formats: technical blogs, vlogs, demo videos, and social posts.
• Bring creative, out-of-the-box thinking to program design — crafting experiences that stand out to developers and builders who have seen it all.
• Mentor and develop a small team of marketers, raising the bar on both technical depth and creative execution across the squad.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- A strong portfolio of self-produced content — blogs, videos, vlogs, or social posts — that demonstrates the ability to engage a technical audience. Personal influencer or creator experience is a strong plus.
- Creative instinct: able to come up with ideas that grab developer attention in a crowded feed — unexpected formats, compelling hooks, culturally relevant angles.
- Comfortable working cross-functionally with marketing, tech, and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication in both Chinese and English.
- Experience with cloud computing technologies, especially AI/ML services.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience as a content creator, tech influencer, or community leader with a demonstrable online presence.
- Proficiency with video editing tools, social media analytics, and content management workflows.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
External job description
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

title: Principal Tech Program Manager, GES NA, Technical Vendor Management, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of innovative solutions into our world-class existing fulfillment centers and logistics systems? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry’s most complex problems? Does the challenge of designing and implementing ground breaking solutions for automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing appeal to you? If you’re looking to be challenged in a fast paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!

Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the design, development and deployment of our material handling systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
- Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
- Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
- Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
- Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
- Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
- Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
- Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
- Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
- Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
- Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
- Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
- Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
- Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
- Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review
- Coordinate annual Charter/Strategy and Headcount Reviews, maintaining documentation in SharePoint and WorkDocs
- Support annual goal-setting processes and provide monthly goal update reminders
- Manage the Team Request Tracker — assign and track action items across team members
- Maintain and optimize operational mechanisms in Smartsheet and Slack to support team workflows

A day in the life
Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Technical Vendor Management operates at the intersection of engineering execution and vendor partnership across North America. A day in the life may involve leading a weekly business review with a general contractor, reviewing scorecard data to identify systemic performance patterns, conducting a strategic planning session with your team leads, or presenting portfolio risk assessments to GES leadership. You will engage with vendor executives, coordinate with GPO on sourcing decisions, align with TVM counterparts, and drive cross-portfolio intelligence that no single project team can see. GES NA Technical Vendor Management is highly collaborative, working daily to make vendor performance consequential, vendor relationships strategic, and Amazon’s construction supply base stronger every year.


About the team
The Technical Vendor Management (TVM) organization is an engineering and performance-focused function within NA GES, consisting of five pillars: TVM MHE Vendor Management, TVM MHE Vendor Development, TVM MHE Components, Construction Contracts, and Technical Vendor Management, Construction. We manage the full project lifecycle of Amazon’s vendor relationships for general contractors and specialty subcontractors—from qualification through active project execution, performance accountability, and continuous improvement. Technical Vendor Management exists because vendor performance directly impacts whether Amazon’s network launches on time, on budget, and at the quality level operations require. With our team, vendor performance improves year over year because we make it consequential. We build strategic relationships that unlock decisions site-level teams cannot reach, see patterns across the portfolio that no single project can see, and act on them before they repeat.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 8+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 5+ years of commercial construction experience
- Experience managing end-to-end project lifecycles including scope definition, scheduling, risk management, vendor coordination, and delivery
- Experience with project management tools and reporting frameworks (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and data-driven decision-making
- Position includes travel up to 50% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- 8+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience in vendor management, RFP and RFIs
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making

title: Sr. Solutions Architect – Database Migration & Modernization Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Are you an experienced presales Solutions Architect with deep expertise in databases, migrations, and modernization? AWS is seeking a Sr. Solutions Architect to serve as a trusted technical advisor to our customers who are embarking on complex database migration and modernization journeys. In this role, you'll combine your strong business acumen with your technical expertise in relational and non-relational database technologies to architect solutions that transform our customers’ most critical data workloads.

Our Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to helping customers achieve their business goals through thoughtful, well-architected technology solutions. We work closely with sales, engineering, and professional services teams to deliver outcomes that matter. We are a collaborative group that values knowledge-sharing, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving. If you are excited about working with customers across industries, tackling new technical challenges, and contributing to a team that is always learning and growing, this is the place for you.


Key job responsibilities
• Design and architect end-to-end database solutions for customers in our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) vertical
• Lead technical discussions on complex migration and modernization strategies across commercial relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server), open-source relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB), NoSQL services (e.g., DynamoDB, DocumentDB), and specialized database engines (e.g., Neptune, ElastiCache)
• Translate business requirements into technical solutions that address the customer’s unique challenges in the competitive database landscape
• Drive database migration assessments, performance optimization engagements, and architecture reviews - applying technical judgment to evaluate trade-offs in scalability, reliability, cost optimization, and operational excellence
• Provide strategic guidance to customers through 1:1 advisory sessions and 1:many enablement workshops, driving database service adoption and ultimately revenue growth, by contributing to go-to-market strategy and creating reusable technical content (reference architectures, best practices)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, product, and engineering to gather customer feedback, influence database service roadmaps, and ensure customer requirements are translated into actionable product enhancements

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior System Development Engineer, Leo - Payload and Terminals
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). In this role, you will design, build and maintain the lab infrastructure. Your role will involve designing, integrating and providing continuous support for complex Radio Frequency (RF) satellite and ground based hardware in the loop (HIL) testing environments.

A key aspect of your position will be serving as a liaison between software teams and hardware teams. * Integration and continuous support of complex RF devices, testing equipment and Linux based software systems.
* Strong RF problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities with the added ability to work individually and as a member of a team.
* Experience managing software development, including integrating, troubleshooting and diagnosing RF related software bugs.
* Strong project management, communication skills and technical writing.
* Experience with RF testing equipment automation using SCPI and a various RF equipment Python libraries like PyVisa.

The successful applicant will be experienced in keeping technical infrastructure running smoothly and balancing high priority issues. - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust

descriptionHtml:

Would you like to be part of the AWS Internship Program, helping us build the data centers that run Amazon Web Services across Southeast Asia? Are you curious about how some of the largest, most complex construction projects in the region are delivered, from design review through to final handover? Do you want to apply what you have learned in engineering, construction management or project management to real, live projects in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia?

Cloud computing is changing how the world uses technology. Since 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. In this AWS Internship Program you will take on real projects, build skills you can use from day one, and be encouraged to build and innovate. You will be a supported member of our internship community, with access to mentoring, coaching and other learning opportunities.

As a Project Engineer (Intern), you will work alongside our Construction Managers from our Singapore office, supporting the delivery of live projects and new builds across four markets: Kuala Lumpur (KUL), Bangkok (BKK), Jakarta (CGK) and Singapore (SIN). This is a multi-site support role: your day to day is remote coordination with site teams, vendors and partner teams from a single base in Singapore, with periodic travel to the regional sites when a milestone, a handover or an issue genuinely needs someone on the ground. You will see the full project lifecycle and be trusted with real responsibility from early on. This internship is structured with a clear pathway to a permanent role, and we are keen to convert strong performers into a full-time position at the end of the programme. Your work will include:

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Software Development Manager to lead the One EU Listing initiative, a transformative program that fundamentally redefines how product selection enters the European catalog. One EU Listing inverts this model: one EU ASIN with 10 language variants, born as an EU-wide entity from inception and available across all eligible marketplaces from Day 1, with no expansion step required. The SDM III will play the role of a technology leader, coordinating across multiple engineering teams, product managers, compliance, and seller experience stakeholders to eliminate cross-listing friction and unlock the massive EU selection opportunity, with 90% of Buyable ASINs being Pan-EU eligible, the opportunity is significant, yet only 15-50% of the 25MM available ASINs exist across EU5/EU10 today.

title: Area Security Manager , Amazon Corporate Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Corporate Security is looking for an experienced, self-motivated, corporate security leader who embodies Amazon’s Leadership Principles, in particular, Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust, and Bias for Action, to join the team as an Area Security Manager for the Southeast America area.

The Area Security Manager reports to a Regional Security Manager, who leads a team of security experts. The Area Security Manager is responsible for implementation of all elements of the Corporate Security program at all Amazon corporate locations in their area of responsibility. The Area Security Manager supports the Regional Security Manager with delivery and oversight of the day-to-day security operations at multiple sites across multiple locations in a highly ambiguous and dynamically fluid environment. The Area Security Manager conducts security assessments, ensures that the corporate sites meet or exceed all requisite security standards, and manages incidents and supporting crisis response. Finally, the Area Security Manager provides security consultancy to local business leadership, develops plans to mitigate gaps in security controls, and manages the guarding and access control programs.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver best-in-class security services focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors.

Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of sites and customers with unique requirements.

Implement and improve security plans, policies, and programs.
Coordinate security incident response.

Respond to customer security concerns.

Monitor the external threat environments in the defined area and take measures to minimize security risk to the business to the dynamic security environment.

Successfully align ACS metrics, goals, and strategic direction across the geographic area to support the overall team and organizational mission.
Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners.

Communicate accurately and in a timely manner with stakeholders at the tactical and strategic level.

descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente e 100% presencial, baseada em VCP3 – Cajamar, SP. A posição não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil para serem elegíveis para consideração.

Na Amazon, trabalhamos para ser a empresa mais centrada no cliente do mundo. Para isso, buscamos pessoas talentosas, motivadas e que tenham paixão por operações, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Key job responsibilities
- Apoiar a execução dos programas de saúde e segurança, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todos os associados.

- Coordenar as atividades operacionais do turno, acompanhando o cumprimento das rotinas, padrões de trabalho e prioridades de produção.

- Monitorar indicadores de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e performance operacional, identificando desvios e apoiando a implementação de ações corretivas.

- Garantir que os associados estejam devidamente treinados e executando suas atividades conforme os padrões e procedimentos definidos.

- Participar ativamente de iniciativas de melhoria contínua, identificação de desperdícios e otimização de processos.

- Apoiar auditorias, controles de qualidade e aderência aos padrões operacionais da Amazon.

A day in the life
Na operação de Print on Demand, você e sua equipe serão responsáveis por transformar pedidos de clientes em livros produzidos sob demanda, acompanhando diferentes etapas do processo de manufatura até que o produto esteja pronto para seguir para a rede de fulfillment.

No dia a dia, você estará próximo ao time e à operação, acompanhando a execução do plano do turno, monitorando indicadores, apoiando os associados, identificando barreiras e trabalhando com outras lideranças e áreas de suporte para garantir uma operação segura, eficiente e consistente.

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in mechanical engineering or related field. Experience developing hardware and spacecraft that have been to space, and which successfully operated as intended. title: Automation Engineering Apprentice - East Midlands (48-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered what it's like to orchestrate a symphony of robots? Picture yourself at the controls of one of the world's most sophisticated automated networks - where thousands of robots work in perfect harmony, artificial intelligence makes split-second decisions, and breakthrough technology comes to life. This isn't science fiction. This is Amazon, and it could be your everyday workspace as an Automation Apprentice.

Our fulfilment centres are like living, breathing cities of automation: hundreds of autonomous robots collaborating to fulfil customer orders, AI and machine-learning systems making real-time decisions, conveyor systems spanning miles, robotic arms handling packages with incredible precision, and automated storage and retrieval systems redefining what efficiency looks like. As an Automation Apprentice within our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team, you'll be hands-on with technology most people only read about, working alongside industry pioneers. This isn't just maintenance - it's being part of a team that innovates, improves, and reimagines automation technology every single day, with the chance to see your own ideas come to life in real-world applications.

Are you the person who took things apart to see how they worked? Maybe you built a PC, fixed everyone's tech, loved robotics club or Lego Technic, tinkered with a car or bike, or found physics, electronics or design and technology just clicked. Or maybe you've spent a few years in a hands-on role and want to step up into cutting-edge automation. You don't need to be an engineer already - what matters is curiosity about how things work, a logical, problem-solving mind, and the patience to figure out why something's gone wrong and put it right. If that sounds like you, this could be the start of something extraordinary.

A day in the life can involve:
- Supporting maintenance and fault-finding on automated systems and robotics
- Using diagnostic tools to keep conveyors and sortation equipment running smoothly
- Planning preventative maintenance and safety checks
- Collaborating with engineers to develop new process improvements and energy-efficient solutions

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience across:
- Advanced robotics systems, controls, and industrial automation programming
- Smart sensor technology and IoT integration
- Predictive maintenance and performance optimisation through data analytics
- Safety systems for human-robot collaboration
- Machine learning applications and wider Industry 4.0 technologies

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Within this 48-month programme, you'll work towards the Level 6 Control Technical Support Apprenticeship, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. title: Network Security Engineer, ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security is looking for Security Engineers who can drive and improve Identity outcomes across the network for the largest cloud provider in the world. AWS is architected to be the most flexible and secure cloud computing environment available today. Our core infrastructure is built to satisfy the security requirements for the government, global banks, and other high-sensitivity organizations but the challenge doesn’t end there as each day we work to raise the bar for our customers. The security engineers within our team are instrumental in helping drive the Identity approaches and outcomes that affect the delivery of AWS next-generation networks with automation and scale as AWS continues its global expansion.

A Security Engineer in Amazon will be strong in multiple security domains and sought out for advice on technical issues. Efficient time management skills are required along with the ability to deliver results in the face of uncertainty. Engineers in this role must show exemplary judgment in making technical trade-offs between short versus long term security and business goals. They must also demonstrate resilience and navigate difficult situations with composure and tact. The successful candidate must be one that can handle several difficult challenges and problems, and can make risk-based assessments founded on data and facts.

This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon's world class technical team, working with some of the best and brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere. The right candidate must thrive in high-pressure situations, think like both an attacker and defender, and drive relevant teams to take the right actions in the right time frames to mitigate risks.

The successful candidate will have a good mix of deep technical knowledge and a demonstrated background in network security and software systems, specifically with Identity and Access Management (IAM). We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of cryptography, network security, software security, security operations and incident response.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Author, tune, and maintain network detection content to ensure high-fidelity coverage and low false-positive rates.
- Triage, investigate, and drive security incidents to resolution across the operational network.
- Build and operate detection-as-code pipelines, including IDS/IPS and syslog-based rule engines.
- Apply AI/ML-powered anomaly detection and alert prioritization to automate and improve triage.
- Integrate threat intelligence and conduct forensic and root-cause analysis.
- Establish and track operational metrics for detection coverage, on-call health, and incident response readiness.
- Partner across Infrastructure Security teams to close detection gaps and reduce mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-respond.

A day in the life
Your day starts in the detection pipeline: you review overnight alerts from the IDS/IPS and syslog rule engines, separate signal from noise, and open an investigation into an anomaly the ML models flagged. You pull network telemetry and forensic data to establish root cause, then drive the incident through to resolution. Midday, you tune a noisy detection rule as code, push it through the pipeline, and integrate a new threat-intelligence feed. In the afternoon, you update detection-coverage metrics and partner with a neighboring Infrastructure Security team to close a gap, keeping a classified network defensible around the clock.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
