title: Sr Strategic Category Manager, Switch Portfolio, Networking
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Networking team is looking for a driven, organized, and collaborative Strategic Category Manager for Switches Portfolio. The Strategic Category Manager will be a strategic thinker responsible for developing strategic operations that enable a highly robust, and resilient supply chain to fuel the exponential growth across AWS data centers. In this role, you will lead the organization while diving deep into the technologies and operations both from a product and supply chain perspective. The ideal candidate will have a large-scale technical supply chain management background, be detail-oriented, skilled at global supply chain strategies, and excel in creative problem solving, negotiations and program management. This role requires the ability to manage multiple parallel programs across different lifecycle stages. The successful candidate must be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with high attention to detail, and a proven ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Candidates must have excellent analytical capabilities, particularly in Finance, program management experience, be comfortable diving deep into data, have strong writing skills, lead executive-level reviews, and communicate clearly and effectively to all levels of the company, both in writing and in meetings. The ideal candidate will not only raise the bar on delivering a best-in-class process to manage a complex supply chain and procurement operation, but is also a person who actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of using data to influence decision makers.


Key job responsibilities
• Establish category sourcing strategies for the Switch category and gain alignment on the vision/roadmap with senior leadership
• Develop category expertise and depth, including: knowledge of industry, sub categories, supply base, benchmarks and indices as well as industry leaders, laggards, and niche players
• Analyze category details to proactively ensure continuity of supply, and exploit emerging opportunities that benefit Amazon
• Lead complex and cross-functional projects
• Serve as a key member of the AWS Infrastructure supply chain team in helping to define and deliver key processes to manage complex supply chain strategies.
• Build robust and scalable sourcing processes that interface with many critical components within AWS' server architecture
• Manage complex financial and legal requirements and lead key inventory activities that will impact our supply chain.
• Produce written recommendations and insights for key stakeholders to help shape solution design.


A day in the life
Our environment is fast-paced and requires someone who is hard-working, meticulous and energetic, who gets things done at an effective pace, gets results, and is comfortable working with tight deadlines and changing priorities

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.


Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.


Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.


Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.


A Little About the Team
The Networking team is made up of global category managers (GCM), global supply managers (GSM), and product lifecycle managers (PLM) who manage the broad base of networking suppliers and internal amazon initiatives that help build the AWS cloud. We drive supply continuity, cost optimization, and technology introduction for networking hardware. We are located throughout multiple regional hubs in the united states and work with suppliers and business partners globally. We are a mix of industry experts and those aspiring to grow our industry expertise. We all bring something valuable to the table from our unique backgrounds; we highlight and celebrate our diverse backgrounds and leverage them to our collective benefit as a team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 5+ years of supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
- Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex modeling, pivot tables, Power Query, macros/VBA) with demonstrated ability to automate repetitive supply chain processes

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- 2+ years of data center experience, or experience in networking
- Experience working with contract manufacturers and managing sub-tier allocation across multiple manufacturing sites

title: Commissioning Program Manager (Standardization & Compliance), APJC Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
Do you have experience leading standards and compliance programs? Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning is looking for a Commissioning Program Manager, Standardization & Compliance. In this role, you will define commissioning standards, measure compliance through clear metrics, drive improvement plans, and build training that makes commissioning execution more consistent.

Your work directly supports a team of experienced commissioning professionals who deliver data center capacity across APAC. You will set the standards for how commissioning is done in the region, and you'll work with AMER and EMEA teams to shape global practice. We work backwards from our customers, and we deliver with speed without compromising Safety, Quality, Time, and Cost.

Key job responsibilities
Standardization Program Management
- Define commissioning execution standards, using technical judgment to separate must-haves from nice-to-haves
- Develop new programs, standards, and processes that improve execution consistency, guided by defined metrics
- Share analysis with business stakeholders, explain its value, and propose changes

Compliance Program Management
- Develop audit mechanisms and compliance metrics to measure adherence to commissioning standards and keep data accurate
- Partner with analysts to automate data extraction and analysis that tests hypotheses
- Define new metrics and use the results to drive change
- Present in leadership operational and business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), and call out areas that need immediate action
- Own quarterly improvement roadmaps, using technical knowledge of AWS data center requirements to improve business metrics

Operational Excellence
- Identify process gaps, measure their impact, propose actions, track results, and iterate
- Find training gaps, and create SOPs and training that improve compliance with standards
- Simplify commissioning processes by removing steps that don't add value
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to make the deliverables Commissioning receives and provides more consistent
- Work with APAC, AMER, and EMEA counterparts to drive global alignment

A day in the life
A process is only as strong as its weakest link. You will use your technical knowledge to find and strengthen those weak links, and to build the foundation of AWS commissioning standards. You will work with analysts to test hypotheses with data and use what you find to reduce project risk to Safety, Quality, Time, and Cost globally.

Consistent execution is what makes a process succeed. You will bring your industry knowledge and experience to develop best-in-class practices and build training and other methods that help teams execute consistently. You will have the backbone to tell the business, with data, where it can improve. You will partner with peers on solutions that keep the business agile and able to deliver high-quality builds consistently.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We deliver the critical power, cooling, and mechanical infrastructure that keeps AWS servers, storage, and networking running, so our customers always have access to the innovation they rely on.

The AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning team is an independent critical infrastructure validation team within the Data Center Capacity Delivery organization. Our electrical, mechanical, and controls engineers, project managers, operators, and analysts provide rigorous engineering and operational review and testing of designs, equipment, and construction practices across APAC.

We bridge the gap between what a design requires and what operations need. Our success is measured by meeting business demand and delivering infrastructure that delights our customers. We believe that "Tomorrow's Quality is Today's Validation."

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors a Women's Leadership Program that supports the growth and development of female builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

- 7+ years of commissioning experience
- 7+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects
- Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing and presenting business case analyses

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal Chief of Staff & Business Operations Lead for the Global Network Delivery (GND) organization. This is a senior individual contributor role and the strategic partner to the GND Director. You will set direction, not just run process: deciding with leadership what GND should commit to, how it resources those commitments, and how it represents them to VP leadership in AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS).

You will own the org's strategy narrative and goals portfolio, build the headcount and productivity case behind every plan, lead builder sentiment strategy, and connect the work of principals across GND into one coherent picture. You will challenge senior leaders, frame hard tradeoffs, and be measured on business outcomes, not on alignment or document quality.

Key job responsibilities
- Own GND's annual strategy document that sets direction for the business. Synthesize inputs across functions into a small set of bets with clear investment rationale.
- Hold a high bar on goals. Advise leaders on which goals should be up-leveled, down-leveled, added, or cut, identify missing priorities, and push back when goals are too safe or not measurable.
- When resources are constrained, frame the options and make a recommendation on what to fund, delay, or stop, with the data and judgment to defend it.
- Partner across GND to connect efforts that cut across the organization. Merge overlapping work, assign owners to gaps, and give leadership one view of cross-cutting programs.
- Design the leadership team's operating cadence and decision rights so staff time goes to strategy and decisions rather than status.

- Set the standard for operating plans, goals, and review mechanisms and make sure review findings feed back into goals and plans. Day-to-day operation of these mechanisms may be delegated.

Lead the accounting behind Amazon's biggest bets — our mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments. If you're a technical accounting expert who wants a seat at the table where deals get done, this is your role.

Join Amazon's Investments & M&A Accounting team as a Principal, where you'll own the accounting strategy for high-profile acquisitions and equity investments from diligence through integration. You'll partner directly with Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to shape how transactions land in Amazon's financial statements — and you'll bring clarity to some of the most complex, ambiguous problems in corporate accounting.

Represent accounting across the full M&A lifecycle, from pre-close diligence to post-close integration

Research and resolve the toughest technical accounting questions — business combinations, purchase accounting, valuations, and equity instruments

• Drive communication across diverse areas and leadership levels building trust. Bring clarity to complex and ambiguous situations

• Build relationships across multiple teams within Amazon to foster a collaborative and productive working relationship
• Identify and implement process improvement opportunities to reduce manual effort and increase controllership
• Support month-end accounting activities, including preparation/review of journal entries, account reconciliations, and SEC deliverables

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment ‘Planner’ will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.

In addition, this role may require international travels of up to 30%.

Key job responsibilities

1. Strategic Planning & Design Management
a. Contribute in developing comprehensive 6-8 months network implementation roadmaps aligned with AWS DC expansion targets
b. Create and optimize network position layouts and rack placement strategies for data centre floor space utilization
c. Review and contribute to High-Level Design (HLD) documentation
d. Coordinate with engineering teams to validate technical requirements and design specifications
e. Develop capacity planning models to ensure infrastructure scalability
f. Create standardized planning templates and methodologies for network implementations

2. Project & Resource Management
a. Lead end-to-end project planning for multiple concurrent network implementation initiatives
b. Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, milestones, and dependencies
c. Manage project scope, and quality parameters
d. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies
e. Improvise and optimize planning by incorporating lessons learnt of latest deployed projects, iteratively.
f. Coordinate across cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project deliverables
g. Track and report weekly project progress and/or otherwise informed to key stakeholders

3. Supply Chain & Inventory Planning
a. Develop project inventory forecasts and requirements
b. Optimize developed counts by utilizing prior surplus spares.
c. Coordinate with procurement teams for strategic resource acquisition
d. Manage vendor relationships and delivery schedules
e. Establish and stick to procurement timelines aligned with project schedules

4. Program Governance & Process Excellence
a. Establish and maintain project management frameworks and best practices
b. Develop sustainable and repeatable planning processes
c. Create and maintain project documentation and reporting standards
d. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in planning methodologies
e. Build and maintain stakeholder communication channels
f. Coordinate with regional teams for standardized planning approaches and optimized lesson learnt based iterative optimized planning.

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Knowledge of network design, protocols and troubleshooting
- Experience in project management
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

title: Business Intelligence Specialist, AMZL PSX
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join the Network Strategy & Innovation (NS&I) team within Amazon’s Last Mile Brazil organization, as part of the Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. This role owns the design, development, and maintenance of data intelligence solutions, automated mechanisms, and analytical frameworks that help shape the future of the AMZL Brazil network, covering capacity planning, inbound optimization, network design, and operational efficiency.

As an Individual Contributor, you will be a core part of the data and automation engine behind NS&I. You will build pipelines, dashboards, predictive models, and self-service tools that eliminate manual processes, anticipate network constraints, and provide real-time visibility into volume, capacity, cost, speed, and partner performance. You will also help identify and deliver AI-driven automations for operational processes, turning repetitive work into scalable mechanisms.

You will partner closely with Operations, Capacity Planning, Finance, Technology, and global network teams to turn complex data into actionable intelligence and support strategic decisions for the Brazil Last Mile network.

This role reports directly to the Network Strategy & Innovation Manager and works cross-functionally across the PSX organization and AMZL Brazil leadership.

This position is based out of an AMZL office.

If you are passionate about building intelligent data solutions, automating complex processes with AI, and using analytics to design a more efficient network, come join our team.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and ETL processes that support capacity planning, inbound optimization, network design, and operational reporting across the AMZL Brazil network
Develop and maintain SQL-based queries, views, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational, volume, and cost datasets
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms (QuickSight, Tableau, or equivalent) providing real-time visibility into volume, capacity utilization, cost, speed, inbound alignment, and partner performance
Create automated monitoring mechanisms that identify capacity constraints, inbound mismatches, and network anomalies before they impact operations and customers, reducing manual intervention
Develop self-service analytical tools that enable Operations, Capacity, and leadership teams to access insights without ad-hoc requests
Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI-driven automations for recurring reports and manual operational processes, driving efficiency gains across the AMZL Brazil network
Conduct deep-dive analyses on capacity trends, inbound patterns, network design scenarios, and operational productivity (e.g., TPH, DPPH) to support data-driven decision-making
Build predictive models and forecasting mechanisms that anticipate volume, capacity needs, and network bottlenecks
Build alerting and exception-handling mechanisms that proactively flag issues (e.g., capacity overload, inbound misalignment, productivity drops, unusual volume shifts)
Partner with Technology, Engineering, and global network teams to define data requirements, validate data sources, and ensure data quality and integrity
Support network design and expansion decisions by providing historical analysis, scenario modeling, and impact projections
Document all data solutions, pipelines, and mechanisms with clear technical specifications and operational runbooks
Present analytical findings and automation proposals to stakeholders and leadership, translating technical solutions into business value

About the team
The Business Intelligence Analyst sits within the Pricing & Payments team, part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience (PSX) organization. The Pricing & Payments function owns one of PSX's core pillars: "Pricing accuracy, incentive effectiveness, and payment reliability: ensuring financial health and trust across all delivery channels."

The team manages pricing models, payment cycles, incentive structures, and dispute resolution for +30 logistics partners across Brazil. - Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)

title: Senior Software Development Manager, EC2 Nitro Card Software, EC2 Core Compute
descriptionHtml:
To keep customer workloads secure and fast, Amazon EC2 Core Compute is hiring a Senior Software Development Manager to lead teams that build and run Nitro Card software. The Nitro Cards are one of the main building blocks of the AWS Nitro System, which all modern EC2 instances run on. These dedicated cards offload virtualization functions from the main server, so instances get practically all of the server's resources.

You will lead managers and engineers across every tenure level and keep growing as a leader of leaders. You will own part of the technical strategy for this software with the Principal Engineers. Your teams evolve this software in place across the EC2 fleet, with the goal that improvements reach customers without reboots or action on their part. Customers rely on the Nitro System to keep their instances isolated from each other and from AWS operators. That is why security is the top priority in every decision you and your teams make.

You need to understand how virtualization works, from the hardware up to the instance, well enough to judge designs, risks, and trade-offs. You use data to make decisions and to know when your teams need you. We are looking for a leader of leaders who builds strong managers, trusts their teams, and raises the bar on operations. You are eager to take stretch goals and bleeding-edge challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Hire, develop, and promote managers and engineers across every tenure level. Raise the hiring bar, identify future leaders, and grow your managers into senior leaders.
- Own part of the technical strategy for Nitro Card software with the Principal Engineers. Turn that strategy into multi-year plans with specific yearly production deliverables, and shape your organization to deliver them. Build closed-loop mechanisms that show early when work is at risk.
- Raise the security bar of this software, including workload isolation.
- Bring this software to new EC2 platforms across Intel, AMD, and AWS Graviton processors, from design to launch. Balance time to market, performance, and cost, with security as the top priority in every decision.
- Drive safe, continuous deployment to the global EC2 fleet. Make sure your teams keep performance consistent through the life of the host.
- Lead your teams through the deepest and most challenging investigations, within the security model of the Nitro System. Turn each root cause into a lasting change in design or process.
- Help improve how we operate, maintain, monitor, and automate this software. Use AI tools to the extent the work calls for, so your teams deliver faster and with higher quality.
- Partner with hardware, virtualization, and launch teams across AWS to align roadmaps and influence how the Nitro System evolves. Write the plans and narratives that senior leadership uses to decide where we invest.

A day in the life
Customer instances depend on Nitro Card software, so your week starts with your managers and a review of how that software runs across the fleet. People take a large part of your time, as you coach and support your managers and help their engineers grow. You review the most important designs with Principal Engineers and your managers, and you use data to decide where to invest. When a hard production issue comes up, you support your teams through the investigation and make sure the fix and the lesson last. You also write the plans that align your teams and their partners on what comes next.

About the team
Customers trust Amazon EC2 with their workloads, and EC2 Core Compute builds platforms on the AWS Nitro System to keep that trust. We launch the C, M, R, X, and T instance families on Intel, AMD, and AWS Graviton processors. These families span general-purpose, compute-optimized, memory-optimized, and burstable instances. Our teams build and run data plane software, from the Nitro Hypervisor to the software that presents processors, memory, and devices to each instance. This role leads teams that build Nitro Card software, and together we help shape the Nitro System as a whole. Our teams build the virtualization security that keeps customer workloads isolated and protected. Flex variants give customers a lower price when workloads do not always need peak performance. Bare metal variants let workloads that need a non-virtualized environment move to AWS. Teams in Berlin, Seattle, and other locations around the globe contribute to every launch.

We hold to the principles that security is our top priority, performance never regresses for customers, and improvements reach customers without action on their part.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of engineering experience
- 5+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- 2+ years of experience managing software development managers
- 10+ years of planning, designing, developing, and delivering software experience
- Experience leading the operations of software in production, including deployment, on-call, and incident response

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading organizations that build software for embedded systems, offload cards, or other dedicated infrastructure hardware in production
- Experience leading teams that build systems software, such as firmware or device software
- Experience leading organizations that operate software across a large fleet with safe, continuous deployment and live updates that preserve running customer workloads
- Understanding of virtualization security, including workload isolation
- Experience partnering with hardware and firmware teams to deliver new server platforms to production
- Experience setting a multi-year technical strategy with specific yearly production deliverables, in partnership with Principal Engineers or architects
- Experience building mechanisms that use operational data to find root causes and drive lasting design or process changes across multiple teams
- Experience using AI tools to improve how teams design, build, test, and operate software

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Teleoperation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be the technical lead for robot teleoperation and remote assistance. Teleoperation is how we collect the demonstrations our robot learning models are trained on, and how robots in the field get help instead of stopping. You will own the architecture across the on-robot teleoperation service, the robot-to-operator link, the operator applications, and the cloud services behind remote operation. You will lead designs across applied science, whole-body control, safety, and cloud teams, and help build the team.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the teleoperation architecture, from the robot to the operator station to the cloud, and lead the engineers building it
- Take teleoperation from the local network to remote operators over the internet, Wi-Fi, and cellular networks we don't control, where latency is high and hard to predict
- Work out with the teams how operators and autonomy share control, and keep the robot safe when the link fails
- Work with applied scientists on what operators see and control, from high-level guidance like pointing at an object to direct control
- Partner with our cloud platform team so operators anywhere can securely connect to robots that need help, and each request reaches an available operator
- Set the test strategy for teleoperation, so latency and reliability are checked with network emulation, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests before anything reaches a deployed robot
- Work directly with operators to find what slows them down, and measure operator efficiency, such as robots per operator and time to resolve a request
- Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and drive build-versus-buy evaluations

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelors or Master's degree, or 10+ years in CS, ME, EE or related field experience
- Experience designing and shipping software for remotely operating or assisting robots or other machines in real time, such as teleoperation, remote assistance, or operator tools

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience leading teleoperation, remote operation, or remote assistance systems for robots or autonomous vehicles in production
- Experience designing and shipping software for physical robots, autonomous vehicles, or other real-time embedded systems
- Experience with low-latency video and real-time communication over wide-area and cellular networks (e.g., WebRTC, QUIC, relay servers, congestion control, adaptive bitrate, hardware video encoding)
- Experience designing robot control that tolerates communication delay, such as shared autonomy, supervisory control, predictive displays, or latency compensation
- Experience with VR or XR operator interfaces (e.g., OpenXR, Unity), haptic feedback, or retargeting human motion to robot arms and hands Experience integrating with robot safety systems and designing fail-safe behavior, such as watchdogs, safe stops, and link-loss handling Experience integrating robots or connected devices with cloud services for remote access, such as video relays or session management
- Experience with robotics middleware like ROS 2, DDS, LCM, or Zenoh
- Experience building data pipelines for robot learning from demonstrations and interventions (e.g. imitation learning)
- Experience using AI coding assistants and agents to speed up development, with sound judgment about reviewing and verifying their output
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of leading technical work across science and engineering teams

title: Security Engineer III, Customer Service Security
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to protect customers at a global scale while seeing the direct impact of your work? The Customer Service Security team at Amazon is looking for a Systems Security Engineer who thrives in ambiguity and is passionate about engineering solutions that reduce security risk across customer service operations. With billions of customer contacts per year spanning more than 40 countries, the security challenges here are complex and the stakes are real.

In this role, you will partner directly with business teams to identify security risks, design pragmatic controls, and build solutions that simultaneously improve security outcomes, customer experiences, and associate experiences. You will own security architecture decisions, lead risk mitigation discussions, and construct frameworks that enable others to apply your work in a repeatable way. If you are a self-starter who can navigate undefined problems and turn them into scalable security solutions, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead security reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments for customer service systems, identifying pragmatic approaches to mitigate risks while enabling teams to launch securely.
- Design and build security controls and engineering solutions that protect customer data and empower secure customer contacts at scale.
- Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to understand emerging risks and define security strategies where none yet exist.
- Create security frameworks, runbooks, and rubrics for new problem domains that enable other engineers to apply consistent, repeatable security practices.
- Communicate security risk and design decisions clearly in writing to both technical and non-technical audiences, and mentor other security engineers on best practices.

A day in the life
You will operate independently, engaging directly with business and engineering teams to uncover security risks that do not come with predefined solutions. On a given day you might be conducting a threat model for a new customer contact workflow, writing a security framework that other teams will adopt, or reviewing architecture proposals to ensure they meet the security bar. Much of your time is spent navigating ambiguity — translating business context into concrete security requirements and building the path forward. You will balance proactive roadmap-driven work with responding to emerging security concerns as they arise.

About the team
The CS Security team is dedicated to reducing security risk across Amazon's customer service organization. We engineer solutions that keep customer data secure while enabling fast, high-quality customer and associate experiences at massive scale. Our work touches billions of customer contacts annually across more than 40 countries, giving you the opportunity to build relationships across the company and scale your solutions globally. We are investing in new engineering capabilities to make every customer contact more secure, and this is an exciting time to join as we shape that future.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 5+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- 4+ years of (non-internship) scripting, programming, and security code review in common programming languages experience
- Knowledge of at least two of the following programming languages: Scala, Java, Python, C/C++, or Go
- Experience working in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans
- Experience (non-internship) in industry-based security vulnerabilities identification, attack patterns, and remediation techniques
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

title: Solutions Architect I, Amazon Selling Partner API, Selling Partner Dev Servi-VAR
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a motivated and technically skilled Solutions Architect to work with customers, generating attention and support for Amazon Selling Partner API.
As a customer advisor, the Solutions Architect will help organizations understand the opportunities to develop and integrate with Selling Partner APIs. You will have the opportunity to help drive adoption of SP-API within organizations ranging from new start-ups to mid-sized customers. You should be comfortable building technical credibility with API Developers, Solution Architects, and Product Managers.
The ability to link technology with measurable business value is important to a solutions architect role. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think about business, products, and technical challenges.

Key job responsibilities
- Support customers in building secure applications, software and services on the Selling Partner API
- Help ensure Selling Partner API solutions comply with acceptable use policies, security standards, and best practices
- Contribute to technical products that support secure API development such as code samples and documentation
- Provide technical support and guidance for security controls to API developers
- Write code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for our developer community
- Work with customers to understand how they are using our API services, and provide feedback to development teams
- Act as a technical liaison between customer, support & engineering, and business teams

A day in the life
The Solutions Architect team supporting the Selling Partner API (SP-API) is responsible for helping external developers, ISVs, and partners successfully build API applications. In a typical week, you will engage with customers—guiding them through API best practices, authentication workflows, and integration patterns across Orders, Catalog, Fulfillment, and Notifications APIs. You will help partners understand how to automate inventory management, streamline order processing, and build selling experiences. Working with internal Amazon teams and leveraging knowledge of SP-API capabilities, you'll help craft reliable, compliant solutions that address our partners' business challenges. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.

About the team
Our global Solutions Architecture team enables technology Solution Providers to build on Selling Partner API. Selling Partner API is an integrated web service API that helps Amazon Selling Partners programmatically exchange data on listings, orders, payments, reports, and more.

- 2+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 1+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 4+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

title: Area Manager II - Tracy, CA
descriptionHtml:
Lead a frontline team inside one of Amazon's most advanced robotics fulfillment centers.

As an Area Manager at our Tracy, CA site (OAK4), you own a shift and a team — you'll directly shape how millions of customer orders move safely, accurately, and on time. This isn't a desk job; it's a leadership proving ground where your decisions have same-day impact and your team looks to you to set the tone.

Our Operations network delivers for Amazon customers every day across three major workflows: First Mile (where product is housed and ready for order), Middle Mile (where the order is hauled to your area), and Last Mile (when the product is delivered to the customer's door). All workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our dedication to the customer.


What you'll gain
You'll run a shift inside one of Amazon's most advanced robotics (AR) sortable fulfillment centers — a high-tech operation where your team works alongside automation to move products at scale. This is hands-on experience you can't get just anywhere: leading people in a fast-paced, tech-forward environment, driving process improvement, and building operational expertise that's valued across the industry. You'll sharpen skills in people leadership, data-driven decision-making, safety and quality management, and continuous improvement.

Life at OAK4
OAK4 is a high-tech robotics (AR) sortable fulfillment center — a 1M+ sq ft operation where associates work alongside automation to move products smaller than a microwave. It's a modern, tech-forward floor: a place to build real Lean / process-improvement expertise and lead in a innovative operations environment.

Why Tracy, CA?
Tracy gives you Bay Area access without Bay Area housing prices — sitting at the crossroads of I-205, I-580, and I-5 with easy reach to the Bay and Sacramento. Expect roughly 73% sunny days a year, above-average schools, low crime, parks, farmers markets, and local wine country. A great fit for families and anyone who wants more space for their money.

What you'll do
- Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly team — your leadership is the difference-maker
- Own safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises for your area
- Partner with Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, and Human Resources to hit business goals
- Drive continuous improvement and solve problems in real time on the floor

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- A Bachelor's degree or International Equivalent, OR 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience, OR 6+ years of Military Experience

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees
- Experience with process improvements (Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma)
- Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
- Industry experience in: retail, F&B, military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production or distribution environments.
